verses.tr: evāgniṃ sahasyaṃ1 vasiṣṭho rāyaskāmo viśvapsnyasya staut iṣaṃ rayiṃ paprathadvājamasme yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Thus hath Vasistha praised victorious Agni, yearning for wealth that giveth all subsistence. May he bestow on us food, strength, and riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र वो यज्ञेषु देवयन्तो अर्चन्द्यावा नमोभिः पृथिवी इषध्यै ।
येषां ब्रह्माण्यसमानि विप्रा विष्वग्वियन्ति वनिनो न शाखाः॥
verses.tr: pra vo yajñeṣu devayanto arcandyāvā namobhiḥ pṛthivī iṣadhyai yeṣāṃ brahmāṇyasamāni viprā viṣvagviyanti vanino na śākhāḥ
verses.en: Sing out the pious at your sacrifices to move with adorations Earth and Heaven- The Holy Singers, whose unmatched devotions, like a tree's branches, part in all directions.

verses.sa:
प्र यज्ञ एतु हेत्वो न सप्तिरुद्यच्छध्वं समनसो घृताचीः ।
स्तृणीत बर्हिरध्वराय साधूर्ध्वा शोचींषि देवयून्यस्थुः॥
verses.tr: pra yajña etu hetvo na saptirudyacchadhvaṃ samanaso ghṛtācīḥ stṛṇīta barhiradhvarāya sādhūrdhvā śocīṃṣi devayūnyasthuḥ
verses.en: Let sacrifice proceed like some fleet courser: with one accord lift ye on high the ladles. Strew sacred grass meet for the solenm service: bright flames that love the Gods have mounted upward.

verses.sa:
आ पुत्रासो न मातरं विभृत्राः सानौ देवासो बर्हिषः सदन्तु ।
आ विश्वाची विदथ्यामनक्त्वग्ने मा नो देवताता मृधस्कः॥
verses.tr: ā putrāso na mātaraṃ vibhṛtrāḥ sānau devāso barhiṣaḥ sadantu ā viśvācī vidathyāmanaktvagne mā no devatātā mṛdhaskaḥ
verses.en: Like babes in arms reposing on their mother, let the Gods sit upon the grass's summit. Let general fire make bright the flame of worship: scorn us not, Agni, in the Gods' assembly.

verses.sa:
ते सीषपन्त जोषमा यजत्रा ऋतस्य धाराः सुदुघा दुहानाः ।
ज्येष्ठं वो अद्य मह आ वसूनामा गन्तन समनसो यति ष्ठ॥
verses.tr: te sīṣapanta joṣamā yajatrā ṛtasya dhārāḥ sudughā duhānāḥ jyeṣṭhaṃ vo adya maha ā vasūnāmā gantana samanaso yati ṣṭha
verses.en: Gladly the Gods have let themselves be honoured, milking the copious streams of holy Order. The highest might to-day is yours, the Vasithas': come ye, as many as ye are, one-minded.

verses.sa:
एवा नो अग्ने विक्ष्वा दशस्य त्वया वयं सहसावन्नास्क्राः ।
राया युजा सधमादो अरिष्टा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: evā no agne vikṣvā daśasya tvayā vayaṃ sahasāvannāskrāḥ rāyā yujā sadhamādo ariṣṭā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: So, Agni, send us wealth among the people: may we be closely knit to thee, O Victor, Unharmed, and rich, and taking joy together. Preserve us evermore, ye gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रां वः प्रथममश्विनोषसमग्निं समिद्धं भगमूतये हुवे ।
इन्द्रं विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिमादित्यान्द्यावापृथिवी अपः स्वः॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāṃ vaḥ prathamamaśvinoṣasamagniṃ samiddhaṃ bhagamūtaye huve indraṃ viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatimādityāndyāvāpṛthivī apaḥ svaḥ
verses.en: I CALL on Dadhikras, the first, to give you aid, the Asvins, Bhaga, Dawn, and Agni kindled well, Indra, and Visnu, Pusan, Brahmanaspati, Adityas, Heaven and Earth, the Waters, and the Light.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रामु नमसा बोधयन्त उदीराणा यज्ञमुपप्रयन्तः ।
इळां देवीं बर्हिषि सादयन्तोऽश्विना विप्रा सुहवा हुवेम॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāmu namasā bodhayanta udīrāṇā yajñamupaprayantaḥ iḻāṃ devīṃ barhiṣi sādayanto'śvinā viprā suhavā huvema
verses.en: When, rising, to the sacrifice we hasten, awaking Dadhikras with adorations. Seating on sacred grass the Goddess Ila. let us invoke the sage swift-hearing Asvins.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रावाणं बुबुधानो अग्निमुप ब्रुव उषसं सूर्यं गाम् ।
ब्रध्नं मंश्चतोर्वरुणस्य बभ्रुं ते विश्वास्मद्दुरिता यावयन्तु॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvāṇaṃ bubudhāno agnimupa bruva uṣasaṃ sūryaṃ gām bradhnaṃ maṃścatorvaruṇasya babhruṃ te viśvāsmadduritā yāvayantu
verses.en: While I am thus arousing Dadhikravan I speak to Agni, Earth, and Dawn, and Surya, The red, the brown of Varuna ever mindful: may they ward off from us all grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रावा प्रथमो वाज्यर्वाऽग्रे रथानां भवति प्रजानन् ।
संविदान उषसा सूर्येणाऽऽदित्येभिर्वसुभिरङ्गिरोभिः॥
verses.tr: dadhikrāvā prathamo vājyarvā'gre rathānāṃ bhavati prajānan saṃvidāna uṣasā sūryeṇā''dityebhirvasubhiraṅgirobhiḥ
verses.en: Foremost is Dadhikravan, vigorous courser; in forefront of the cars, his way he knoweth, Closely allied with Surya and with Morning, Adityas, and Angirases, and Vasus.

verses.sa:
आ नो दधिक्राः पथ्यामनक्त्वृतस्य पन्थामन्वेतवा उ ।
शृणोतु नो दैव्यं शर्धो अग्निः शृण्वन्तु विश्वे महिषा अमूराः॥
verses.tr: ā no dadhikrāḥ pathyāmanaktvṛtasya panthāmanvetavā u śṛṇotu no daivyaṃ śardho agniḥ śṛṇvantu viśve mahiṣā amūrāḥ
verses.en: May Dadhikras prepare the way we travel that we may pass along the path of Order. May Agni bear us, and the Heavenly Army: hear us all Mighty Ones whom none deceiveth.

verses.sa:
आ देवो यातु सविता सुरत्नोऽन्तरिक्षप्रा वहमानो अश्वैः ।
हस्ते दधानो नर्या पुरूणि निवेशयञ्च प्रसुवञ्च भूम॥
verses.tr: ā devo yātu savitā suratno'ntarikṣaprā vahamāno aśvaiḥ haste dadhāno naryā purūṇi niveśayañca prasuvañca bhūma
verses.en: May the God Savitar, rich in goodly treasures, filling the region, borne by steeds, come hither, In his hand holding much that makes men happy, lulling to slumber and arousing creatures.

verses.sa:
उदस्य बाहू शिथिरा बृहन्ता हिरण्यया दिवो अन्ताँ अनष्टाम् ।
नूनं सो अस्य महिमा पनिष्ट सूरश्चिदस्मा अनु दादपस्याम्॥
verses.tr: udasya bāhū śithirā bṛhantā hiraṇyayā divo antāṃ anaṣṭām nūnaṃ so asya mahimā paniṣṭa sūraścidasmā anu dādapasyām
verses.en: Golden, sublime, and easy in their motion, his arms extend unto the bounds of heaven. Now shall that mightiness of his he lauded: even Surya yields to him in active vigour.

verses.sa:
स घा नो देवः सविता सहावा ऽऽसाविषद्वसुपतिर्वसूनि ।
विश्रयमाणो अमतिमुरूचीं मर्तभोजनमध रासते नः॥
verses.tr: sa ghā no devaḥ savitā sahāvā ''sāviṣadvasupatirvasūni viśrayamāṇo amatimurūcīṃ martabhojanamadha rāsate naḥ
verses.en: May this God Savitar, the Strong and Mighty, the Lord of precious wealth, vouchsafe us treasures. May he, advancing his far-spreading lustre, bestow on us the food that feedeth mortals.

verses.sa:
इमा गिरः सवितारं सुजिह्वं पूर्णगभस्तिमीळते सुपाणिम् ।
चित्रं वयो बृहदस्मे दधातु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: imā giraḥ savitāraṃ sujihvaṃ pūrṇagabhastimīḻate supāṇim citraṃ vayo bṛhadasme dadhātu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: These songs praise Savitar whose tongue is pleasant, praise him whose arms are full, whose hands are lovely. High vital strength, and manifold, may he grant us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
इमा रुद्राय स्थिरधन्वने गिरः क्षिप्रेषवे देवाय स्वधाव्ने ।
अषाळ्हाय सहमानाय वेधसे तिग्मायुधाय भरता शृणोतु नः॥
verses.tr: imā rudrāya sthiradhanvane giraḥ kṣipreṣave devāya svadhāvne aṣāḻhāya sahamānāya vedhase tigmāyudhāya bharatā śṛṇotu naḥ
verses.en: To Rudra bring these songs, whose bow is firm and strong, the self-dependent God with swiftly-flying shafts, The Wise, the Conqueror whom none may overcome, armed with sharp-pointed weapons: may he hear our call.

verses.sa:
स हि क्षयेण क्षम्यस्य जन्मनः साम्राज्येन दिव्यस्य चेतति ।
अवन्नवन्तीरुप नो दुरश्चरानमीवो रुद्र जासु नो भव॥
verses.tr: sa hi kṣayeṇa kṣamyasya janmanaḥ sāmrājyena divyasya cetati avannavantīrupa no duraścarānamīvo rudra jāsu no bhava
verses.en: He through his lordship thinks on beings of the earth, on heavenly beings through his high imperial sway. Come willingly to our doors that gladly welcome thee, and heal all sickness, Rudra., in our families.

verses.sa:
या ते दिद्युदवसृष्टा दिवस्परि क्ष्मया चरति परि सा वृणक्तु नः ।
सहस्रं ते स्वपिवात भेषजा मा नस्तोकेषु तनयेषु रीरिषः॥
verses.tr: yā te didyudavasṛṣṭā divaspari kṣmayā carati pari sā vṛṇaktu naḥ sahasraṃ te svapivāta bheṣajā mā nastokeṣu tanayeṣu rīriṣaḥ
verses.en: May thy bright arrow which, shot down by thee from heaven, flieth upon the earth, pass us uninjured by. Thou, very gracious God, bast thousand medicines: inflict no evil on our sons or progeny.

verses.sa:
मा नो वधी रुद्र मा परा दा मा ते भूम प्रसितौ हीळितस्य ।
आ नो भज बर्हिषि जीवशंसे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: mā no vadhī rudra mā parā dā mā te bhūma prasitau hīḻitasya ā no bhaja barhiṣi jīvaśaṃse yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Slay us not, nor abandon us, O Rudra let not thy noose, when thou art angry, seize us. Give us trimmed grass and fame among the living. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आपो यं वः प्रथमं देवयन्त इन्द्रपानमूर्मिमकृण्वतेळः ।
तं वो वयं शुचिमरिप्रमद्य घृतप्रुषं मधुमन्तं वनेम॥
verses.tr: āpo yaṃ vaḥ prathamaṃ devayanta indrapānamūrmimakṛṇvateḻaḥ taṃ vo vayaṃ śucimaripramadya ghṛtapruṣaṃ madhumantaṃ vanema
verses.en: May we obtain this day from you, O Waters, that wave of pure refreshment, which the pious Made erst the special beverage of Indra, bright, stainless, rich in sweets and dropping fatness.

verses.sa:
तमूर्मिमापो मधुमत्तमं वोऽपां नपादवत्वाशुहेमा ।
यस्मिन्निन्द्रो वसुभिर्मादयाते तमश्याम देवयन्तो वो अद्य॥
verses.tr: tamūrmimāpo madhumattamaṃ vo'pāṃ napādavatvāśuhemā yasminnindro vasubhirmādayāte tamaśyāma devayanto vo adya
verses.en: May the Floods' Offspring, he whose course is rapid, protect that wave most rich in sweets, O Waters, That shall make Indra and the Vasus joyful. This may we gain from you to-day, we pious.

verses.sa:
शतपवित्राः स्वधया मदन्तीर्देवीर्देवानामपि यन्ति पाथः ।
ता इन्द्रस्य न मिनन्ति व्रतानि सिन्धुभ्यो हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोत॥
verses.tr: śatapavitrāḥ svadhayā madantīrdevīrdevānāmapi yanti pāthaḥ tā indrasya na minanti vratāni sindhubhyo havyaṃ ghṛtavajjuhota
verses.en: All-purifying, joying in their nature, to paths of Gods the Goddesses move onward. They never violate the laws of Indra. Present the oil-rich offering to the Rivers.

verses.sa:
याः सूर्यो रश्मिभिराततान याभ्य इन्द्रो अरदद्गातुमूर्मिम् ।
ते सिन्धवो वरिवो धातना नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: yāḥ sūryo raśmibhirātatāna yābhya indro aradadgātumūrmim te sindhavo varivo dhātanā no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Whom Surya with his bright beams hath attracted, and Indra dug the path for them to travel, May these Streams give us ample room and freedom. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
ऋभुक्षणो वाजा मादयध्वमस्मे नरो मघवानः सुतस्य ।
आ वोऽर्वाचः क्रतवो न यातां विभ्वो रथं नर्यं वर्तयन्तु॥
verses.tr: ṛbhukṣaṇo vājā mādayadhvamasme naro maghavānaḥ sutasya ā vo'rvācaḥ kratavo na yātāṃ vibhvo rathaṃ naryaṃ vartayantu
verses.en: Ye liberal Heroes, Vajas and Rbhuksans, come and delight you with our flowing Soma. May your strength, Vibhus, as ye come to meet us, turn hitherward your car that brings men profit.

verses.sa:
ऋभुॠभुभिरभि वः स्याम विभ्वो विभुभिः शवसा शवांसि ।
वाजो अस्माँ अवतु वाजसाताविन्द्रेण युजा तरुषेम वृत्रम्॥
verses.tr: ṛbhuṝbhubhirabhi vaḥ syāma vibhvo vibhubhiḥ śavasā śavāṃsi vājo asmāṃ avatu vājasātāvindreṇa yujā taruṣema vṛtram
verses.en: May we as Rbhu with your Rbhus conquer strength with our strength, as Vibhus with the Vibhus. May Vaja aid us in the fight for booty, and helped by Indra may we quell the foeman.

verses.sa:
ते चिद्धि पूर्वीरभि सन्ति शासा विश्वाँ अर्य उपरताति वन्वन् । इ
न्द्रो विभ्वाँ ऋभुक्षा वाजो अर्यः शत्रोर्मिथत्या कृणवन्वि नृम्णम्॥
verses.tr: te ciddhi pūrvīrabhi santi śāsā viśvāṃ arya uparatāti vanvan i ndro vibhvāṃ ṛbhukṣā vājo aryaḥ śatrormithatyā kṛṇavanvi nṛmṇam
verses.en: For they rule many tribes with high dominion, and conquer all their foes in close encounter. May Indra, Vibhvan, Vaja, and Rbhuksan destroy by turns the wicked foeman's valour.

verses.sa:
नू देवासो वरिवः कर्तना नो भूत नो विश्वेऽवसे सजोषाः ।
समस्मे इषं वसवो ददीरन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū devāso varivaḥ kartanā no bhūta no viśve'vase sajoṣāḥ samasme iṣaṃ vasavo dadīranyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now, Deities, give us ample room and freedom: be all of you, one-minded, our protection. So let the Vasus grant us strength and vigour. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
समुद्रज्येष्ठाः सलिलस्य मध्यात्पुनाना यन्त्यनिविशमानाः ।
इन्द्रो या वज्री वृषभो रराद ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु॥
verses.tr: samudrajyeṣṭhāḥ salilasya madhyātpunānā yantyaniviśamānāḥ indro yā vajrī vṛṣabho rarāda tā āpo devīriha māmavantu
verses.en: Forth from the middle of the flood the Waters-their chief the Sea-flow cleansing, never sleeping. Indra, the Bull, the Thunderer, dug their channels: here let those Waters, Goddesses, protect me.

verses.sa:
या आपो दिव्या उत वा स्रवन्ति खनित्रिमा उत वा याः स्वयंजाः ।
समुद्रार्था याः शुचयः पावकास्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yā āpo divyā uta vā sravanti khanitrimā uta vā yāḥ svayaṃjāḥ samudrārthā yāḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu
verses.en: Waters which come from heaven, or those that wander dug from the earth, or flowing free by nature, Bright, purifying, speeding to the Ocean, here let those Waters. Goddesses, protect me.

verses.sa:
यासां राजा वरुणो याति मध्ये सत्यानृते अवपश्यञ्जनानाम् ।
मधुश्चुतः शुचयो याः पावकास्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāsāṃ rājā varuṇo yāti madhye satyānṛte avapaśyañjanānām madhuścutaḥ śucayo yāḥ pāvakāstā āpo devīriha māmavantu
verses.en: Those amid whom goes Varuna the Sovran, he who discriminates men's truth and falsehood- Distilling meath, the bright, the purifying, here let those Waters, Goddesses, protect me.

verses.sa:
यासु राजा वरुणो यासु सोमो विश्वे देवा यासूर्जं मदन्ति ।
वैश्वानरो यास्वग्निः प्रविष्टस्ता आपो देवीरिह मामवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāsu rājā varuṇo yāsu somo viśve devā yāsūrjaṃ madanti vaiśvānaro yāsvagniḥ praviṣṭastā āpo devīriha māmavantu
verses.en: They from whom Varuna the King, and Soma, and all the Deities drink strength and vigour, They into whom Vaisvanara Agni entered, here let those Waters, Goddesses, protect Me.

verses.sa:
आ मां मित्रावरुणेह रक्षतं कुलाययद्विश्वयन्मा न आ गन् ।
अजकावं दुर्दृशीकं तिरो दधे मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः॥
verses.tr: ā māṃ mitrāvaruṇeha rakṣataṃ kulāyayadviśvayanmā na ā gan ajakāvaṃ durdṛśīkaṃ tiro dadhe mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ
verses.en: O MITRA-VARUNA, guard and protect me here: let not that come to me which nests within and swells. I drive afar the scorpion hateful to the sight: let not the winding worm touch me and wound my foot.

verses.sa:
यद्विजामन्परुषि वन्दनं भुवदष्ठीवन्तौ परि कुल्फौ च देहत् ।
अग्निष्टच्छोचन्नप बाधतामितो मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः॥
verses.tr: yadvijāmanparuṣi vandanaṃ bhuvadaṣṭhīvantau pari kulphau ca dehat agniṣṭacchocannapa bādhatāmito mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ
verses.en: Eruption that appears upon the twofold joints, and that which overspreads the ankles and the knees, May the refulgent Agni banish far away let not the winding worm touch me and wound my foot.

verses.sa:
यच्छल्मलौ भवति यन्नदीषु यदोषधीभ्यः परि जायते विषम् ।
विश्वे देवा निरितस्तत्सुवन्तु मा मां पद्येन रपसा विदत्त्सरुः॥
verses.tr: yacchalmalau bhavati yannadīṣu yadoṣadhībhyaḥ pari jāyate viṣam viśve devā niritastatsuvantu mā māṃ padyena rapasā vidattsaruḥ
verses.en: The poison that is formed upon the Salmali, that which is found in streams, that which the plants produce, All this may all the Gods banish and drive away: let not the winding worm touch me and wound my foot.

verses.sa:
याः प्रवतो निवत उद्वत उदन्वतीरनुदकाश्च याः ।
ता अस्मभ्यं पयसा पिन्वमानाः शिवा देवीरशिपदा भवन्तु सर्वा नद्यो अशिमिदा भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: yāḥ pravato nivata udvata udanvatīranudakāśca yāḥ tā asmabhyaṃ payasā pinvamānāḥ śivā devīraśipadā bhavantu sarvā nadyo aśimidā bhavantu
verses.en: The steep declivities, the valleys, and the heights, the channels full of water, and the waterless- May those who swell with water, gracious Goddesses, never afflict us with the Sipada disease, may all the rivers keep us free from Simida.

verses.sa:
आदित्यानामवसा नूतनेन सक्षीमहि शर्मणा शंतमेन ।
अनागास्त्वे अदितित्वे तुरास इमं यज्ञं दधतु श्रोषमाणाः॥
verses.tr: ādityānāmavasā nūtanena sakṣīmahi śarmaṇā śaṃtamena anāgāstve adititve turāsa imaṃ yajñaṃ dadhatu śroṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: Through the Adityas' most auspicious shelter, through their most recent succour may we conquer. May they, the Mighty, giving ear, establish this sacrifice, to make us free and sinless.

verses.sa:
आदित्यासो अदितिर्मादयन्तां मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो रजिष्ठाः ।
अस्माकं सन्तु भुवनस्य गोपाः पिबन्तु सोममवसे नो अद्य॥
verses.tr: ādityāso aditirmādayantāṃ mitro aryamā varuṇo rajiṣṭhāḥ asmākaṃ santu bhuvanasya gopāḥ pibantu somamavase no adya
verses.en: Let Aditi rejoice and the Adityas, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, most righteous. May they, the Guardians of the world, protect us, and, to show favour, drink this day our Soma.

verses.sa:
आदित्या विश्वे मरुतश्च विश्वे देवाश्च विश्व ऋभवश्च विश्वे ।
इन्द्रो अग्निरश्विना तुष्टुवाना यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ādityā viśve marutaśca viśve devāśca viśva ṛbhavaśca viśve indro agniraśvinā tuṣṭuvānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: All Universal Deities, the Maruts, all the Adityas, yea, and all the Rbhus, Indra, and Agni, and the Asvins, lauded. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आदित्यासो अदितयः स्याम पूर्देवत्रा वसवो मर्त्यत्रा ।
सनेम मित्रावरुणा सनन्तो भवेम द्यावापृथिवी भवन्तः॥
verses.tr: ādityāso aditayaḥ syāma pūrdevatrā vasavo martyatrā sanema mitrāvaruṇā sananto bhavema dyāvāpṛthivī bhavantaḥ
verses.en: May we be free from every bond, Adityas! a castle among Gods and men, ye Vasus. Winning, may we win Varuna and Mitra, and, being, may we be, O Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो मामहन्त शर्म तोकाय तनयाय गोपाः ।
मा वो भुजेमान्यजातमेनो मा तत्कर्म वसवो यच्चयध्वे॥
verses.tr: mitrastanno varuṇo māmahanta śarma tokāya tanayāya gopāḥ mā vo bhujemānyajātameno mā tatkarma vasavo yaccayadhve
verses.en: May Varuna and Mitra grant this blessing, our Guardians, shelter to our seed and offspring. Let us not suffer for another's trespass. nor do the thing that ye, O Vasus, punish.

verses.sa:
तुरण्यवोऽङ्गिरसो नक्षन्त रत्नं देवस्य सवितुरियानाः ।
पिता च तन्नो महान्यजत्रो विश्वे देवाः समनसो जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: turaṇyavo'ṅgiraso nakṣanta ratnaṃ devasya savituriyānāḥ pitā ca tanno mahānyajatro viśve devāḥ samanaso juṣanta
verses.en: The ever-prompt Angirases, imploring riches from Savitar the God, obtained them. So may our Father who is great and holy, and all the Gods, accordant, grant this favour.

verses.sa:
प्र द्यावा यज्ञैः पृथिवी नमोभिः सबाध ईळे बृहती यजत्रे ।
ते चिद्धि पूर्वे कवयो गृणन्तः पुरो मही दधिरे देवपुत्रे॥
verses.tr: pra dyāvā yajñaiḥ pṛthivī namobhiḥ sabādha īḻe bṛhatī yajatre te ciddhi pūrve kavayo gṛṇantaḥ puro mahī dadhire devaputre
verses.en: As priest with solemn rites and adorations I worship Heaven and Earth, the High and Holy. To them, great Parents of the Gods, have sages of ancient time, singing, assigned precedence.

verses.sa:
प्र पूर्वजे पितरा नव्यसीभिर्गीर्भिः कृणुध्वं सदने ऋतस्य ।
आ नो द्यावापृथिवी दैव्येन जनेन यातं महि वां वरूथम्॥
verses.tr: pra pūrvaje pitarā navyasībhirgīrbhiḥ kṛṇudhvaṃ sadane ṛtasya ā no dyāvāpṛthivī daivyena janena yātaṃ mahi vāṃ varūtham
verses.en: With newest hymns set in the seat of Order, those the Two Parents, born before all others, Come, Heaven and Earth, with the Celestial People, hither to us, for strong is your protection.

verses.sa:
उतो हि वां रत्नधेयानि सन्ति पुरूणि द्यावापृथिवी सुदासे ।
अस्मे धत्तं यदसदस्कृधोयु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: uto hi vāṃ ratnadheyāni santi purūṇi dyāvāpṛthivī sudāse asme dhattaṃ yadasadaskṛdhoyu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Yea, Heaven and Earth, ye hold in your possession full many a treasure for the liberal giver. Grant us that wealth which comes in free abundance. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

sections.label: To Vastoshpati, lord of the house
sections.name: Mandala 7, hymn 54

verses.sa:
वास्तोष्पते प्रति जानीह्यस्मान्त्स्वावेशो अनमीवो भवा नः ।
यत्त्वेमहे प्रति तन्नो जुषस्व शं नो भव द्विपदे शं चतुष्पदे॥
verses.tr: vāstoṣpate prati jānīhyasmāntsvāveśo anamīvo bhavā naḥ yattvemahe prati tanno juṣasva śaṃ no bhava dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade
verses.en: Acknowledge us, O Guardian of the Homestead: bring no disease, and give us happy entrance. Whate'er we ask of thee, be pleased to grant it, and prosper thou quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sa:
वास्तोष्पते प्रतरणो न एधि गयस्फानो गोभिरश्वेभिरिन्दो ।
अजरासस्ते सख्ये स्याम पितेव पुत्रान्प्रति नो जुषस्व॥
verses.tr: vāstoṣpate prataraṇo na edhi gayasphāno gobhiraśvebhirindo ajarāsaste sakhye syāma piteva putrānprati no juṣasva
verses.en: Protector of the Home, be our promoter: increase our wealth in kine and steeds, O Indu. May we be ever-youthful in thy friendship: be pleased in us as in his sons a father.

verses.sa:
वास्तोष्पते शग्मया संसदा ते सक्षीमहि रण्वया गातुमत्या ।
पाहि क्षेम उत योगे वरं नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: vāstoṣpate śagmayā saṃsadā te sakṣīmahi raṇvayā gātumatyā pāhi kṣema uta yoge varaṃ no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Through thy dear fellowship that bringeth welfare, may we be victors, Guardian of the Dwelling! Protect our happiness in rest and labour. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

sections.label: To Vastoshpati, lord of the house
sections.name: Mandala 7, hymn 55

verses.sa: अमीवहा वास्तोष्पते विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् । सखा सुशेव एधि नः॥
verses.tr: amīvahā vāstoṣpate viśvā rūpāṇyāviśan sakhā suśeva edhi naḥ
verses.en: Vastospati, who killest all disease and wearest every form, Be an auspicious Friend to us.

verses.sa: यदर्जुन सारमेय दतः पिशङ्ग यच्छसे । वीव भ्राजन्त ऋष्टय उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतो नि षु स्वप॥
verses.tr: yadarjuna sārameya dataḥ piśaṅga yacchase vīva bhrājanta ṛṣṭaya upa srakveṣu bapsato ni ṣu svapa
verses.en: When, O bright Son of Sarama, thou showest, tawny-hued! thy teeth, They gleam like lances' points within thy mouth when thou wouldst bite; go thou to steep.

verses.sa: स्तेनं राय सारमेय तस्करं वा पुनःसर । स्तोतॄनिन्द्रस्य रायसि किमस्मान्दुच्छुनायसे नि षु स्वप॥
verses.tr: stenaṃ rāya sārameya taskaraṃ vā punaḥsara stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa
verses.en: Sarama's Son, retrace thy way: bark at the robber and the thief. At Indra's singers barkest thou? Why dust thou seek to terrify us? Go to sleep.

verses.sa: त्वं सूकरस्य दर्दृहि तव दर्दर्तु सूकरः । स्तोतॄनिन्द्रस्य रायसि किमस्मान्दुच्छुनायसे नि षु स्वप॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ sūkarasya dardṛhi tava dardartu sūkaraḥ stotṝnindrasya rāyasi kimasmānducchunāyase ni ṣu svapa
verses.en: Be on thy guard against the boar, and let the boar beware of thee. At Indra's singers barkest thou? Why dost thou seek to terrify us? Go to sleep.

verses.sa: सस्तु माता सस्तु पिता सस्तु श्वा सस्तु विश्पतिः । ससन्तु सर्वे ज्ञातयः सस्त्वयमभितो जनः॥
verses.tr: sastu mātā sastu pitā sastu śvā sastu viśpatiḥ sasantu sarve jñātayaḥ sastvayamabhito janaḥ
verses.en: Sleep mother, let the father sleep, sleep dog and master of the house. Let all the kinsmen sleep, sleep all the people who are round about.

verses.sa: य आस्ते यश्च चरति यश्च पश्यति नो जनः । तेषां सं हन्मो अक्षाणि यथेदं हर्म्यं तथा॥
verses.tr: ya āste yaśca carati yaśca paśyati no janaḥ teṣāṃ saṃ hanmo akṣāṇi yathedaṃ harmyaṃ tathā
verses.en: The man who sits, the man who walks, and whosoever looks on us, Of these we closely shut the eyes, even as we closely shut this house.

verses.sa: सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभो यः समुद्रादुदाचरत् । तेना सहस्येना वयं नि जनान्त्स्वापयामसि॥
verses.tr: sahasraśṛṅgo vṛṣabho yaḥ samudrādudācarat tenā sahasyenā vayaṃ ni janāntsvāpayāmasi
verses.en: The Bull who hath a thousand horns, who rises up from out the sea,- By him the Strong and Mighty One we lull and make the people sleep.

verses.sa: प्रोष्ठेशया वह्येशया नारीर्यास्तल्पशीवरीः । स्त्रियो याः पुण्यगन्धास्ताः सर्वाः स्वापयामसि॥
verses.tr: proṣṭheśayā vahyeśayā nārīryāstalpaśīvarīḥ striyo yāḥ puṇyagandhāstāḥ sarvāḥ svāpayāmasi
verses.en: The women sleeping in the court, lying without, or stretched on beds, The matrons with their odorous sweets these, one and all, we lull to sleep.

verses.sa: क ईं व्यक्ता नरः सनीळा रुद्रस्य मर्या अध स्वश्वाः॥
verses.tr: ka īṃ vyaktā naraḥ sanīḻā rudrasya maryā adha svaśvāḥ
verses.en: Who are these radiant men in serried rank, Rudra's young heroes borne by noble steeds?

verses.sa: नकिर्ह्येषां जनूंषि वेद ते अङ्ग विद्रे मिथो जनित्रम् ॥१॥
verses.tr: nakirhyeṣāṃ janūṃṣi veda te aṅga vidre mitho janitram 1
verses.en: Verily no one knoweth whence they sprang: they, and they only, know each other's birth.

verses.sa: अभि स्वपूभिर्मिथो वपन्त वातस्वनसः श्येना अस्पृध्रन्॥
verses.tr: abhi svapūbhirmitho vapanta vātasvanasaḥ śyenā aspṛdhran
verses.en: They strew each other with their blasts, these Hawks: they strove together, roaring like the wind.

verses.sa: एतानि धीरो निण्या चिकेत पृश्निर्यदूधो मही जभार ॥२॥
verses.tr: etāni dhīro niṇyā ciketa pṛśniryadūdho mahī jabhāra 2
verses.en: A sage was he who knew these mysteries, what in her udder mighty Prsni bore.

verses.sa: सा विट् सुवीरा मरुद्भिरस्तु सनात्सहन्ती पुष्यन्ती नृम्णम्॥
verses.tr: sā viṭ suvīrā marudbhirastu sanātsahantī puṣyantī nṛmṇam
verses.en: Ever victorious, through the Maruts, be this band of Heroes, nursing manly strength,

verses.sa: यामं येष्ठाः शुभा शोभिष्ठाः श्रिया सम्मिश्ला ओजोभिरुग्राः ॥३॥
verses.tr: yāmaṃ yeṣṭhāḥ śubhā śobhiṣṭhāḥ śriyā sammiślā ojobhirugrāḥ 3
verses.en: Most bright in splendour, fleetest on their way, close-knit to glory, strong with varied power.

verses.sa: उग्रं व ओजः स्थिरा शवांस्यधा मरुद्भिर्गणस्तुविष्मान्॥
verses.tr: ugraṃ va ojaḥ sthirā śavāṃsyadhā marudbhirgaṇastuviṣmān
verses.en: Yea, mighty is your power and firm your strength: so, potent, with the Maruts, be the band.

verses.sa: शुभ्रो वः शुष्मः क्रुध्मी मनांसि धुनिर्मुनिरिव शर्धस्य धृष्णोः ॥४॥
verses.tr: śubhro vaḥ śuṣmaḥ krudhmī manāṃsi dhunirmuniriva śardhasya dhṛṣṇoḥ 4
verses.en: Bright is your spirit, wrathful are your minds: your bold troop's minstrel is like one inspired.

verses.sa: सनेम्यस्मद्युयोत दिद्युं मा वो दुर्मतिरिह प्रणङ्नः॥
verses.tr: sanemyasmadyuyota didyuṃ mā vo durmatiriha praṇaṅnaḥ
verses.en: Ever avert your blazing shaft from us, and let not your displeasure reach us here

verses.sa: प्रिया वो नाम हुवे तुराणामा यत्तृपन्मरुतो वावशानाः ॥५॥
verses.tr: priyā vo nāma huve turāṇāmā yattṛpanmaruto vāvaśānāḥ 5
verses.en: Your dear names, conquering Maruts, we invoke, calling aloud till we are satisfied.

verses.sa: स्वायुधास इष्मिणः सुनिष्का उत स्वयं तन्व१ः शुम्भमानाः ॥६॥
verses.tr: svāyudhāsa iṣmiṇaḥ suniṣkā uta svayaṃ tanva1ḥ śumbhamānāḥ 6
verses.en: Well-armed, impetuous in their haste, they deck themselves, their forms, with oblations: to you, the pure, ornaments made of gold.

verses.sa:
शुची वो हव्या मरुतः शुचीनां शुचिं हिनोम्यध्वरं शुचिभ्यः ।
ऋतेन सत्यमृतसाप आयञ्छुचिजन्मानः शुचयः पावकाः॥
verses.tr: śucī vo havyā marutaḥ śucīnāṃ śuciṃ hinomyadhvaraṃ śucibhyaḥ ṛtena satyamṛtasāpa āyañchucijanmānaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ
verses.en: Pure, Maruts, pure yourselves, are your oblations: to you, the pure, pure sacrifice I offer. By Law they came to truth, the Law's observers, bright by their birth, and pure, and sanctifying.

verses.sa:
अंसेष्वा मरुतः खादयो वो वक्षःसु रुक्मा उपशिश्रियाणाः ।
वि विद्युतो न वृष्टिभी रुचाना अनु स्वधामायुधैर्यच्छमानाः॥
verses.tr: aṃseṣvā marutaḥ khādayo vo vakṣaḥsu rukmā upaśiśriyāṇāḥ vi vidyuto na vṛṣṭibhī rucānā anu svadhāmāyudhairyacchamānāḥ
verses.en: Your rings, O Maruts, rest upon your shoulders, and chains of gold are twined upon your bosoms. Gleaming with drops of rain, like lightning-flashes, after your wont ye whirl about your weapons.

verses.sa:
प्र बुध्न्या व ईरते महांसि प्र नामानि प्रयज्यवस्तिरध्वम् ।
सहस्रियं दम्यं भागमेतं गृहमेधीयं मरुतो जुषध्वम्॥
verses.tr: pra budhnyā va īrate mahāṃsi pra nāmāni prayajyavastiradhvam sahasriyaṃ damyaṃ bhāgametaṃ gṛhamedhīyaṃ maruto juṣadhvam
verses.en: Wide in the depth of air spread forth your glories, far, most adorable, ye bear your titles. Maruts, accept this thousandfold allotment of household sacrifice and household treasure.

verses.sa:
यदि स्तुतस्य मरुतो अधीथेत्था विप्रस्य वाजिनो हवीमन् ।
मक्षू रायः सुवीर्यस्य दात नू चिद्यमन्य आदभदरावा॥
verses.tr: yadi stutasya maruto adhīthetthā viprasya vājino havīman makṣū rāyaḥ suvīryasya dāta nū cidyamanya ādabhadarāvā
verses.en: If, Maruts, ye regard the praise recited here at this mighty singer invocation, Vouchsafe us quickly wealth with noble heroes, wealth which no man uho hateth us may injure.

verses.sa:
अत्यासो न ये मरुतः स्वञ्चो यक्षदृशो न शुभयन्त मर्याः ।
ते हर्म्येष्ठाः शिशवो न शुभ्रा वत्सासो न प्रक्रीळिनः पयोधाः॥
verses.tr: atyāso na ye marutaḥ svañco yakṣadṛśo na śubhayanta maryāḥ te harmyeṣṭhāḥ śiśavo na śubhrā vatsāso na prakrīḻinaḥ payodhāḥ
verses.en: The Maruts, fleet as coursers, while they deck them like youths spectators of a festal meeting, Linger, like beauteous colts, about the dwelling, like frisking calves, these who pour down the water.

verses.sa:
दशस्यन्तो नो मरुतो मृळन्तु वरिवस्यन्तो रोदसी सुमेके ।
आरे गोहा नृहा वधो वो अस्तु सुम्नेभिरस्मे वसवो नमध्वम्॥
verses.tr: daśasyanto no maruto mṛḻantu varivasyanto rodasī sumeke āre gohā nṛhā vadho vo astu sumnebhirasme vasavo namadhvam
verses.en: So may the Maruts help us and be gracious, bringing free room to lovely Earth and Heaven. Far be your bolt that slayeth men and cattle. Ye Vasus, turn yourselves to us with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ वो होता जोहवीति सत्तः सत्राचीं रातिं मरुतो गृणानः ।
य ईवतो वृषणो अस्ति गोपाः सो अद्वयावी हवते व उक्थैः॥
verses.tr: ā vo hotā johavīti sattaḥ satrācīṃ rātiṃ maruto gṛṇānaḥ ya īvato vṛṣaṇo asti gopāḥ so advayāvī havate va ukthaiḥ
verses.en: The priest, when seated, loudly calls you, Maruts, praising in song your universal bounty. He, Bulls! who hath so much in his possession, free from duplicity, with hymns invokes you.

verses.sa:
इमे तुरं मरुतो रामयन्तीमे सहः सहस आ नमन्ति ।
इमे शंसं वनुष्यतो नि पान्ति गुरु द्वेषो अररुषे दधन्ति॥
verses.tr: ime turaṃ maruto rāmayantīme sahaḥ sahasa ā namanti ime śaṃsaṃ vanuṣyato ni pānti guru dveṣo araruṣe dadhanti
verses.en: These Maruts bring the swift man to a stand-still, and strength with mightier strength they break and humble These guard the singer from the man who hates him and lay their sore displeasure on the wicked.

verses.sa:
इमे रध्रं चिन्मरुतो जुनन्ति भृमिं चिद्यथा वसवो जुषन्त ।
अप बाधध्वं वृषणस्तमांसि धत्त विश्वं तनयं तोकमस्मे॥
verses.tr: ime radhraṃ cinmaruto junanti bhṛmiṃ cidyathā vasavo juṣanta apa bādhadhvaṃ vṛṣaṇastamāṃsi dhatta viśvaṃ tanayaṃ tokamasme
verses.en: These Maruts rouse even the poor and needy: the Vasus love him as an active champion. Drive to a distance, O ye Bulls, the darkness: give us full store of children and descendants.

verses.sa:
मा वो दात्रान्मरुतो निरराम मा पश्चाद्दघ्म रथ्यो विभागे ।
आ नः स्पार्हे भजतना वसव्ये३ यदीं सुजातं वृषणो वो अस्ति॥
verses.tr: mā vo dātrānmaruto nirarāma mā paścāddaghma rathyo vibhāge ā naḥ spārhe bhajatanā vasavye3 yadīṃ sujātaṃ vṛṣaṇo vo asti
verses.en: Never, O Maruts, may we lose your bounty, nor, car-borne Lords! be hindmost when ye deal it. Give us a share in that delightful treasure, the genuine wealth that, Bulls! is your possession.

verses.sa:
सं यद्धनन्त मन्युभिर्जनासः शूरा यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु ।
अध स्मा नो मरुतो रुद्रियासस्त्रातारो भूत पृतनास्वर्यः॥
verses.tr: saṃ yaddhananta manyubhirjanāsaḥ śūrā yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu adha smā no maruto rudriyāsastrātāro bhūta pṛtanāsvaryaḥ
verses.en: What time the men in fury rush together for running streams, for pastures, and for houses. Then, O ye Maruts, ye who spring from Rudra, be our protectors in the strife with foemen.

verses.sa:
भूरि चक्र मरुतः पित्र्याण्युक्थानि या वः शस्यन्ते पुरा चित् ।
मरुद्भिरुग्रः पृतनासु साळ्हा मरुद्भिरित्सनिता वाजमर्वा॥
verses.tr: bhūri cakra marutaḥ pitryāṇyukthāni yā vaḥ śasyante purā cit marudbhirugraḥ pṛtanāsu sāḻhā marudbhiritsanitā vājamarvā
verses.en: Full many a deed ye did for our forefathers worthy of lauds which, even of old, they sang you. lle strong man, with the Maruts, wins in battle, the charger, with the Maruts, gains the booty.

verses.sa:
अस्मे वीरो मरुतः शुष्म्यस्तु जनानां यो असुरो विधर्ता ।
अपो येन सुक्षितये तरेमाऽध स्वमोको अभि वः स्याम॥
verses.tr: asme vīro marutaḥ śuṣmyastu janānāṃ yo asuro vidhartā apo yena sukṣitaye taremā'dha svamoko abhi vaḥ syāma
verses.en: Ours, O ye Maruts, be the vigorous Hero, the Lord Divine of men, the strong Sustainer, With whom to fair lands we may cross the waters, and dwell in our own home with you beside us.

verses.sa:
तन्न इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निराप ओषधीर्वनिनो जुषन्त ।
शर्मन्त्स्याम मरुतामुपस्थे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: tanna indro varuṇo mitro agnirāpa oṣadhīrvanino juṣanta śarmantsyāma marutāmupasthe yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May Indra, Mitra, Varuna and Agni, Waters, and Plants, and Trees accept our praises. May we find shelter in the Marut's bosom. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
मध्वो वो नाम मारुतं यजत्राः प्र यज्ञेषु शवसा मदन्ति ।
ये रेजयन्ति रोदसी चिदुर्वी पिन्वन्त्युत्सं यदयासुरुग्राः॥
verses.tr: madhvo vo nāma mārutaṃ yajatrāḥ pra yajñeṣu śavasā madanti ye rejayanti rodasī cidurvī pinvantyutsaṃ yadayāsurugrāḥ
verses.en: Yea, through the power of your sweet juice, ye Holy! the Marut host is glad at sacrifices. They cause even spacious heaven and earth to tremble, they make the spring flow when they come, the Mighty.

verses.sa:
निचेतारो हि मरुतो गृणन्तं प्रणेतारो यजमानस्य मन्म ।
अस्माकमद्य विदथेषु बर्हिरा वीतये सदत पिप्रियाणाः॥
verses.tr: nicetāro hi maruto gṛṇantaṃ praṇetāro yajamānasya manma asmākamadya vidatheṣu barhirā vītaye sadata pipriyāṇāḥ
verses.en: The Maruts watch the man who sings their praises, promoters of the thought of him who worships. Seat you on sacred grass in our assembly, this day, with friendly minds, to share the banquet.

verses.sa:
नैतावदन्ये मरुतो यथेमे भ्राजन्ते रुक्मैरायुधैस्तनूभिः ।
आ रोदसी विश्वपिशः पिशानाः समानमञ्ज्यञ्जते शुभे कम्॥
verses.tr: naitāvadanye maruto yatheme bhrājante rukmairāyudhaistanūbhiḥ ā rodasī viśvapiśaḥ piśānāḥ samānamañjyañjate śubhe kam
verses.en: No others gleam so brightly as these Maruts with their own forms, their golden gauds, their weapons. With all adornments, decking earth and heaven, they heighten, for bright show, their common splendour.

verses.sa:
ऋधक्सा वो मरुतो दिद्युदस्तु यद्व आगः पुरुषता कराम ।
मा वस्तस्यामपि भूमा यजत्रा अस्मे वो अस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा॥
verses.tr: ṛdhaksā vo maruto didyudastu yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma mā vastasyāmapi bhūmā yajatrā asme vo astu sumatiścaniṣṭhā
verses.en: Far from us be your blazing dart, O Maruts, when we, through human frailty, sin against you. Let us not he exposed to that, ye Holy! May your most loving favour still attend us.

verses.sa:
कृते चिदत्र मरुतो रणन्ताऽनवद्यासः शुचयः पावकाः ।
प्र णोऽवत सुमतिभिर्यजत्राः प्र वाजेभिस्तिरत पुष्यसे नः॥
verses.tr: kṛte cidatra maruto raṇantā'navadyāsaḥ śucayaḥ pāvakāḥ pra ṇo'vata sumatibhiryajatrāḥ pra vājebhistirata puṣyase naḥ
verses.en: May even what we have done delight the Maruts, the blameless Ones, the bright, the purifying. Further us, O ye Holy, with your kindness: advance us mightily that we may prosper.

verses.sa:
उत स्तुतासो मरुतो व्यन्तु विश्वेभिर्नामभिर्नरो हवींषि । द
दात नो अमृतस्य प्रजायै जिगृत रायः सूनृता मघानि॥
verses.tr: uta stutāso maruto vyantu viśvebhirnāmabhirnaro havīṃṣi da dāta no amṛtasya prajāyai jigṛta rāyaḥ sūnṛtā maghāni
verses.en: And may the Maruts, praised by all their titles, Heroes, enjoy the taste of our oblations. Give us of Amrta for the sake of offspring: awake the excellent fair stores of riches.

verses.sa:
आ स्तुतासो मरुतो विश्व ऊती अच्छा सूरीन्त्सर्वताता जिगात ।
ये नस्त्मना शतिनो वर्धयन्ति यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ā stutāso maruto viśva ūtī acchā sūrīntsarvatātā jigāta ye nastmanā śatino vardhayanti yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Hither, ye Maruts, praised, with all your succours, with all felicity come to our princes, Who, of themselves, a hundredfold increase us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्र साकमुक्षे अर्चता गणाय यो दैव्यस्य धाम्नस्तुविष्मान् ।
उत क्षोदन्ति रोदसी महित्वा नक्षन्ते नाकं निॠतेरवंशात्॥
verses.tr: pra sākamukṣe arcatā gaṇāya yo daivyasya dhāmnastuviṣmān uta kṣodanti rodasī mahitvā nakṣante nākaṃ niṝteravaṃśāt
verses.en: Sing to the troop that pours down rain in common, the Mighty Company of celestial nature. They make the world-halves tremble with their greatness: from depths of earth and sky they reach to heaven.

verses.sa:
जनूश्चिद्वो मरुतस्त्वेष्येण भीमासस्तुविमन्यवोऽयासः ।
प्र ये महोभिरोजसोत सन्ति विश्वो वो यामन्भयते स्वर्दृक्॥
verses.tr: janūścidvo marutastveṣyeṇa bhīmāsastuvimanyavo'yāsaḥ pra ye mahobhirojasota santi viśvo vo yāmanbhayate svardṛk
verses.en: Yea, your birth, Maruts, was with wild commotion, ye who move swiftly, fierce in wrath, terrific. Ye all-surpassing in your might and vigour, each looker on the light fears at your coming.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वयो मघवद्भ्यो दधात जुजोषन्निन्मरुतः सुष्टुतिं नः ।
गतो नाध्वा वि तिराति जन्तुं प्र णः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेत॥
verses.tr: bṛhadvayo maghavadbhyo dadhāta jujoṣanninmarutaḥ suṣṭutiṃ naḥ gato nādhvā vi tirāti jantuṃ pra ṇaḥ spārhābhirūtibhistireta
verses.en: Give ample vital power unto our princes let our fair praises gratify the Maruts. As the way travelled helpeth people onward, so further us with your delightful succours.

verses.sa:
युष्मोतो विप्रो मरुतः शतस्वी युष्मोतो अर्वा सहुरिः सहस्री ।
युष्मोतः सम्राळुत हन्ति वृत्रं प्र तद्वो अस्तु धूतयो देष्णम्॥
verses.tr: yuṣmoto vipro marutaḥ śatasvī yuṣmoto arvā sahuriḥ sahasrī yuṣmotaḥ samrāḻuta hanti vṛtraṃ pra tadvo astu dhūtayo deṣṇam
verses.en: Your favoured singer counts his wealth by hundreds: the strong steed whom ye favour wins a thousand. The Sovran whom ye aid destroys the foeman. May this your gift, ye Shakers, be distinguished.

verses.sa:
ताँ आ रुद्रस्य मीळ्हुषो विवासे कुविन्नंसन्ते मरुतः पुनर्नः ।
यत्सस्वर्ता जिहीळिरे यदाविरव तदेन ईमहे तुराणाम्॥
verses.tr: tāṃ ā rudrasya mīḻhuṣo vivāse kuvinnaṃsante marutaḥ punarnaḥ yatsasvartā jihīḻire yadāvirava tadena īmahe turāṇām
verses.en: I call, as such, the Sons of bounteous Rudra: will not the Maruts turn again to us-ward? What secret sin or open stirs their anger, that we implore the Swift Ones to forgive us.

verses.sa:
प्र सा वाचि सुष्टुतिर्मघोनामिदं सूक्तं मरुतो जुषन्त ।
आराच्चिद्द्वेषो वृषणो युयोत यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: pra sā vāci suṣṭutirmaghonāmidaṃ sūktaṃ maruto juṣanta ārācciddveṣo vṛṣaṇo yuyota yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: This eulogy of the Bounteous hath been spoken: accept, ye Maruts, this our hymn of praises. Ye Bulls, keep those who hate us at a distance. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रगाथः = ( विषमा बृहती, समा सतोबृहती ), ७-८, ९-११ गायत्री, १२ अनुष्टुप्  ।
यं त्रायध्व इदमिदं देवासो यं च नयथ। तस्मा अग्ने वरुण मित्रार्यमन्मरुतः शर्म यच्छत॥
verses.tr: pragāthaḥ = ( viṣamā bṛhatī, samā satobṛhatī ), 7-8, 9-11 gāyatrī, 12 anuṣṭup yaṃ trāyadhva idamidaṃ devāso yaṃ ca nayatha tasmā agne varuṇa mitrāryamanmarutaḥ śarma yacchata
verses.en: Whom SO ye rescue here and there, whom so ye guide, O Deities, To him give shelter, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, ye Maruts, and thou Aryaman.

verses.sa:
युष्माकं देवा अवसाहनि प्रिय ईजानस्तरति द्विषः ।
प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति॥
verses.tr: yuṣmākaṃ devā avasāhani priya ījānastarati dviṣaḥ pra sa kṣayaṃ tirate vi mahīriṣo yo vo varāya dāśati
verses.en: Through your kind favour, Gods, on some auspicious day, the worshipper subdues his foes. That man increases home and strengthening ample food who brings you offerings as ye list.

verses.sa: नहि वश्चरमं चन वसिष्ठः परिमंसते । अस्माकमद्य मरुतः सुते सचा विश्वे पिबत कामिनः॥
verses.tr: nahi vaścaramaṃ cana vasiṣṭhaḥ parimaṃsate asmākamadya marutaḥ sute sacā viśve pibata kāminaḥ
verses.en: Vasistha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all. O Maruts, of our Soma juice effused to-day drink all of you with eager haste.

verses.sa:
नहि व ऊतिः पृतनासु मर्धति यस्मा अराध्वं नरः ।
अभि व आवर्त्सुमतिर्नवीयसी तूयं यात पिपीषवः॥
verses.tr: nahi va ūtiḥ pṛtanāsu mardhati yasmā arādhvaṃ naraḥ abhi va āvartsumatirnavīyasī tūyaṃ yāta pipīṣavaḥ
verses.en: Your succour in the battle injures not the man to whom ye, Heroes, grant your gifts. May your most recent favour turn to us again. Come quickly, ye who fain would drink.

verses.sa:
ओ षु घृष्विराधसो यातनान्धांसि पीतये ।
इमा वो हव्या मरुतो ररे हि कं मो ष्व१न्यत्र गन्तन॥
verses.tr: o ṣu ghṛṣvirādhaso yātanāndhāṃsi pītaye imā vo havyā maruto rare hi kaṃ mo ṣva1nyatra gantana
verses.en: Come hitherward to drink the juice, O ye whose bounties give you joy. These offerings are for you, these, Maruts, I present. Go not to any place but this.

verses.sa:
आ च नो बर्हिः सदताविता च नः स्पार्हाणि दातवे वसु ।
अस्रेधन्तो मरुतः सोम्ये मधौ स्वाहेह मादयाध्वै॥
verses.tr: ā ca no barhiḥ sadatāvitā ca naḥ spārhāṇi dātave vasu asredhanto marutaḥ somye madhau svāheha mādayādhvai
verses.en: Sit on our sacred grass, be graciously inclined to give the wealth for which we long, To take delight, ye Maruts, Friends of all, with Svaha, in sweet Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सस्वश्चिद्धि तन्व१ः शुम्भमाना आ हंसासो नीलपृष्ठा अपप्तन् ।
विश्वं शर्धो अभितो मा नि षेद नरो न रण्वाः सवने मदन्तः॥
verses.tr: sasvaściddhi tanva1ḥ śumbhamānā ā haṃsāso nīlapṛṣṭhā apaptan viśvaṃ śardho abhito mā ni ṣeda naro na raṇvāḥ savane madantaḥ
verses.en: Decking the beauty of their forms in secret the Swans with purple backs have flown down hither. Around me all the Company hath settled, like joyous Heroes glad in our libation.

verses.sa:
यो नो मरुतो अभि दुर्हृणायुस्तिरश्चित्तानि वसवो जिघांसति ।
द्रुहः पाशान्प्रति स मुचीष्ट तपिष्ठेन हन्मना हन्तना तम्॥
verses.tr: yo no maruto abhi durhṛṇāyustiraścittāni vasavo jighāṃsati druhaḥ pāśānprati sa mucīṣṭa tapiṣṭhena hanmanā hantanā tam
verses.en: Maruts, the man whose wrath is hard to master, he who would slay us ere we think, O Vasus, May he be tangled in the toils of mischief; smite ye him down with your most flaming weapon.

verses.sa: सांतपना इदं हविर्मरुतस्तज्जुजुष्टन । युष्माकोती रिशादसः॥
verses.tr: sāṃtapanā idaṃ havirmarutastajjujuṣṭana yuṣmākotī riśādasaḥ
verses.en: O Maruts, ye consuming Gods, enjoy this offering brought for you, To help us, ye who slay the foe.

verses.sa: गृहमेधास आ गत मरुतो माप भूतन । युष्माकोती सुदानवः॥
verses.tr: gṛhamedhāsa ā gata maruto māpa bhūtana yuṣmākotī sudānavaḥ
verses.en: Sharers of household sacrifice, come, Maruts, stay not far away, That ye may help us, Bounteous Ones.

verses.sa: इहेह वः स्वतवसः कवयः सूर्यत्वचः । यज्ञं मरुत आ वृणे॥
verses.tr: iheha vaḥ svatavasaḥ kavayaḥ sūryatvacaḥ yajñaṃ maruta ā vṛṇe
verses.en: Here, Self-strong Maruts, yea, even here. ye Sages with your sunbright skins I dedicate your sacrifice.

verses.sa: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम् । उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥
verses.tr: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanam urvārukamiva bandhanānmṛtyormukṣīya māmṛtāt
verses.en: Tryambaka we worship, sweet augmenter of prosperity. As from its stem the cucumber, so may I be released from death, not reft of immortality.

verses.sa:
यदद्य सूर्य ब्रवोऽनागा उद्यन्मित्राय वरुणाय सत्यम् ।
वयं देवत्रादिते स्याम तव प्रियासो अर्यमन्गृणन्तः॥
verses.tr: yadadya sūrya bravo'nāgā udyanmitrāya varuṇāya satyam vayaṃ devatrādite syāma tava priyāso aryamangṛṇantaḥ
verses.en: When thou, O Sun, this day, arising sinless, shalt speak the truth to Varuna and Mitra, O Aditi, may all the Deities love us, and thou, O Aryaman, while we are singing.

verses.sa:
एष स्य मित्रावरुणा नृचक्षा उभे उदेति सूर्यो अभि ज्मन् ।
विश्वस्य स्थातुर्जगतश्च गोपा ऋजु मर्तेषु वृजिना च पश्यन्॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya mitrāvaruṇā nṛcakṣā ubhe udeti sūryo abhi jman viśvasya sthāturjagataśca gopā ṛju marteṣu vṛjinā ca paśyan
verses.en: Looking on man, O Varuna and Mitra, this Sun ascendeth up by both the pathways, Guardian of all things fixt, of all that moveth, beholding good and evil acts of mortals.

verses.sa:
अयुक्त सप्त हरितः सधस्थाद्या ईं वहन्ति सूर्यं घृताचीः ।
धामानि मित्रावरुणा युवाकुः सं यो यूथेव जनिमानि चष्टे॥
verses.tr: ayukta sapta haritaḥ sadhasthādyā īṃ vahanti sūryaṃ ghṛtācīḥ dhāmāni mitrāvaruṇā yuvākuḥ saṃ yo yūtheva janimāni caṣṭe
verses.en: He from their home hath yoked the Seven gold Coursers who, dropping oil and fatness, carry Surya. Yours, Varuna and Mitra, he surveyeth the worlds and living creatures like a herdsman.

verses.sa:
उद्वां पृक्षासो मधुमन्तो अस्थुरा सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णः ।
यस्मा आदित्या अध्वनो रदन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सजोषाः॥
verses.tr: udvāṃ pṛkṣāso madhumanto asthurā sūryo aruhacchukramarṇaḥ yasmā ādityā adhvano radanti mitro aryamā varuṇaḥ sajoṣāḥ
verses.en: Your coursers rich in store of sweets have mounted: to the bright ocean Surya hath ascended, For whom the Adityas make his pathway ready, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna, accordant.

verses.sa:
इमे चेतारो अनृतस्य भूरेर्मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणो हि सन्ति ।
इम ऋतस्य वावृधुर्दुरोणे शग्मासः पुत्रा अदितेरदब्धाः॥
verses.tr: ime cetāro anṛtasya bhūrermitro aryamā varuṇo hi santi ima ṛtasya vāvṛdhurduroṇe śagmāsaḥ putrā aditeradabdhāḥ
verses.en: For these, even Aryaman, Varuna and Mitra, are the chastisers of all guile and falsehood. These, Aditi's Sons, infallible and mighty, have waxen in the home of law Eternal.

verses.sa:
इमे मित्रो वरुणो दूळभासोऽचेतसं चिच्चितयन्ति दक्षैः ।
अपि क्रतुं सुचेतसं वतन्तस्तिरश्चिदंहः सुपथा नयन्ति॥
verses.tr: ime mitro varuṇo dūḻabhāso'cetasaṃ ciccitayanti dakṣaiḥ api kratuṃ sucetasaṃ vatantastiraścidaṃhaḥ supathā nayanti
verses.en: These, Mitra, Varuna whom none deceiveth, with great power quicken even the fool to wisdom, And, wakening, moreover, thoughtful insight, lead it by easy paths o'er grief and trouble.

verses.sa:
इमे दिवो अनिमिषा पृथिव्याश्चिकित्वांसो अचेतसं नयन्ति ।
प्रव्राजे चिन्नद्यो गाधमस्ति पारं नो अस्य विष्पितस्य पर्षन्॥
verses.tr: ime divo animiṣā pṛthivyāścikitvāṃso acetasaṃ nayanti pravrāje cinnadyo gādhamasti pāraṃ no asya viṣpitasya parṣan
verses.en: They ever vigilant, with eyes that close not, caring for heaven and earth, lead on the thoughtless. Even in the river's bed there is a shallow. across this broad expanse may they conduct us.

verses.sa:
यद्गोपावददितिः शर्म भद्रं मित्रो यच्छन्ति वरुणः सुदासे ।
तस्मिन्ना तोकं तनयं दधाना मा कर्म देवहेळनं तुरासः॥
verses.tr: yadgopāvadaditiḥ śarma bhadraṃ mitro yacchanti varuṇaḥ sudāse tasminnā tokaṃ tanayaṃ dadhānā mā karma devaheḻanaṃ turāsaḥ
verses.en: When Aditi and Varuna and Mitra, like guardians, give Sudas their friendly shelter, Granting him sons and lineal succession, let us not, bold ones! move the Gods to anger.

verses.sa:
अव वेदिं होत्राभिर्यजेत रिपः काश्चिद्वरुणध्रुतः सः ।
परि द्वेषोभिरर्यमा वृणक्तूरुं सुदासे वृषणा उ लोकम्॥
verses.tr: ava vediṃ hotrābhiryajeta ripaḥ kāścidvaruṇadhrutaḥ saḥ pari dveṣobhiraryamā vṛṇaktūruṃ sudāse vṛṣaṇā u lokam
verses.en: May he with ofierings purify the altar from any stains of Varuna's reviler. Aryaman save us us all those who hate us: give room and freedom to Sudas, ye Mighty.

verses.sa:
सस्वश्चिद्धि समृतिस्त्वेष्येषामपीच्येन सहसा सहन्ते ।
युष्मद्भिया वृषणो रेजमाना दक्षस्य चिन्महिना मृळता नः॥
verses.tr: sasvaściddhi samṛtistveṣyeṣāmapīcyena sahasā sahante yuṣmadbhiyā vṛṣaṇo rejamānā dakṣasya cinmahinā mṛḻatā naḥ
verses.en: Hid from our eyes is their resplendent meeting: by their mysterious might they hold dominion. Heroes! we cry trembling in fear before you, even in the greatness of your power have mercy.

verses.sa:
यो ब्रह्मणे सुमतिमायजाते वाजस्य सातौ परमस्य रायः ।
सीक्षन्त मन्युं मघवानो अर्य उरु क्षयाय चक्रिरे सुधातु॥
verses.tr: yo brahmaṇe sumatimāyajāte vājasya sātau paramasya rāyaḥ sīkṣanta manyuṃ maghavāno arya uru kṣayāya cakrire sudhātu
verses.en: He who wins favour for his prayer by worship, that he may gain him strength and highest riches, That good man's mind the Mighty Ones will follow: they have brought comfort to his spacious dwelling.

verses.sa:
इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि ।
विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: This priestly task, Gods! Varuna and Mitra! hath been performed for you at sacrifices. Convey us safely over every peril. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उद्वां चक्षुर्वरुण सुप्रतीकं देवयोरेति सूर्यस्ततन्वान् ।
अभि यो विश्वा भुवनानि चष्टे स मन्युं मर्त्येष्वा चिकेत॥
verses.tr: udvāṃ cakṣurvaruṇa supratīkaṃ devayoreti sūryastatanvān abhi yo viśvā bhuvanāni caṣṭe sa manyuṃ martyeṣvā ciketa
verses.en: O VARUNA and Mitra, Surya spreading the beauteous light of you Twain Gods ariseth. He who beholdeth all existing creatures observeth well the zeal that is in mortals.

verses.sa:
प्र वां स मित्रावरुणावृतावा विप्रो मन्मानि दीर्घश्रुदियर्ति ।
यस्य ब्रह्माणि सुक्रतू अवाथ आ यत्क्रत्वा न शरदः पृणैथे॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ sa mitrāvaruṇāvṛtāvā vipro manmāni dīrghaśrudiyarti yasya brahmāṇi sukratū avātha ā yatkratvā na śaradaḥ pṛṇaithe
verses.en: The holy sage, renowned afar, directeth his hymns to you, O Varuna and Mitra,- He whose devotions, sapient Gods, ye favour so that ye fill, as 'twere, with power his autumns.

verses.sa:
प्रोरोर्मित्रावरुणा पृथिव्याः प्र दिव ऋष्वाद्बृहतः सुदानू ।
स्पशो दधाथे ओषधीषु विक्ष्वृधग्यतो अनिमिषं रक्षमाणा॥
verses.tr: prorormitrāvaruṇā pṛthivyāḥ pra diva ṛṣvādbṛhataḥ sudānū spaśo dadhāthe oṣadhīṣu vikṣvṛdhagyato animiṣaṃ rakṣamāṇā
verses.en: From the wide earth, O Varuna and Mitra from the great lofty heaven, ye, Bounteous Givers, - Have in the fields and houses set your warder-, who visit every spot and watch unceasing.

verses.sa:
शंसा मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम शुष्मो रोदसी बद्बधे महित्वा ।
अयन्मासा अयज्वनामवीराः प्र यज्ञमन्मा वृजनं तिराते॥
verses.tr: śaṃsā mitrasya varuṇasya dhāma śuṣmo rodasī badbadhe mahitvā ayanmāsā ayajvanāmavīrāḥ pra yajñamanmā vṛjanaṃ tirāte
verses.en: I praise the strength of Varuna and Mitra that strength, by mightiness, keeps both worlds asunder. Heroless pass the months of the ungodly he who loves sacrifice makes his home enduring.

verses.sa:
अमूरा विश्वा वृषणाविमा वां न यासु चित्रं ददृशे न यक्षम् ।
द्रुहः सचन्ते अनृता जनानां न वां निण्यान्यचिते अभूवन्॥
verses.tr: amūrā viśvā vṛṣaṇāvimā vāṃ na yāsu citraṃ dadṛśe na yakṣam druhaḥ sacante anṛtā janānāṃ na vāṃ niṇyānyacite abhūvan
verses.en: Steers, all infallible are these your people in whom no wondrous thing is seen, no worship. Guile follows close the men who are untruthful: no secrets may be hidden from your knowledge.

verses.sa:
समु वां यज्ञं महयं नमोभिर्हुवे वां मित्रावरुणा सबाधः ।
प्र वां मन्मान्यृचसे नवानि कृतानि ब्रह्म जुजुषन्निमानि॥
verses.tr: samu vāṃ yajñaṃ mahayaṃ namobhirhuve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sabādhaḥ pra vāṃ manmānyṛcase navāni kṛtāni brahma jujuṣannimāni
verses.en: I will exalt your sacrifice with homage: as priest, I, Mitra-Varuna, invoke you. May these new hymns and prayers that I have fashioned delight you to the profit of the singer.

verses.sa:
इयं देव पुरोहितिर्युवभ्यां यज्ञेषु मित्रावरुणावकारि ।
विश्वानि दुर्गा पिपृतं तिरो नो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ deva purohitiryuvabhyāṃ yajñeṣu mitrāvaruṇāvakāri viśvāni durgā pipṛtaṃ tiro no yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: This priestly task, Gods! Varuna and Mitra! hath been performed for you at sacrifices. Convey us safely over every peril. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उत्सूर्यो बृहदर्चींष्यश्रेत्पुरु विश्वा जनिम मानुषाणाम् ।
समो दिवा ददृशे रोचमानः क्रत्वा कृतः सुकृतः कर्तृभिर्भूत्॥
verses.tr: utsūryo bṛhadarcīṃṣyaśretpuru viśvā janima mānuṣāṇām samo divā dadṛśe rocamānaḥ kratvā kṛtaḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt
verses.en: Surya hath sent aloft his beams of splendour o'er all the tribes of men in countless places. Together with the heaven he shines apparent, formed by his Makers well with power and wisdom.

verses.sa:
स सूर्य प्रति पुरो न उद्गा एभिः स्तोमेभिरेतशेभिरेवैः ।
प्र नो मित्राय वरुणाय वोचोऽनागसो अर्यम्णे अग्नये च॥
verses.tr: sa sūrya prati puro na udgā ebhiḥ stomebhiretaśebhirevaiḥ pra no mitrāya varuṇāya voco'nāgaso aryamṇe agnaye ca
verses.en: So hast thou mounted up before us, Surya, through these our praises, with fleet dappled horses. Declare us free from all offence to Mitra, and Varuna, and Aryaman, and Agni.

verses.sa:
वि नः सहस्रं शुरुधो रदन्त्वृतावानो वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
यच्छन्तु चन्द्रा उपमं नो अर्कमा नः कामं पूपुरन्तु स्तवानाः॥
verses.tr: vi naḥ sahasraṃ śurudho radantvṛtāvāno varuṇo mitro agniḥ yacchantu candrā upamaṃ no arkamā naḥ kāmaṃ pūpurantu stavānāḥ
verses.en: May holy Agni, Varuna, and Mitra send down their riches upon us in thousands. May they, the Bright Ones, make our praise-song perfect, and, when we laud them, grant us all our wishes.

verses.sa:
द्यावाभूमी अदिते त्रासीथां नो ये वां जज्ञुः सुजनिमान ऋष्वे ।
मा हेळे भूम वरुणस्य वायोर्मा मित्रस्य प्रियतमस्य नृणाम्॥
verses.tr: dyāvābhūmī adite trāsīthāṃ no ye vāṃ jajñuḥ sujanimāna ṛṣve mā heḻe bhūma varuṇasya vāyormā mitrasya priyatamasya nṛṇām
verses.en: O undivided Heaven and Earth, preserve us, us, Lofty Ones! your nobIy-born descendants. Let us not anger Varuna, nor Vayu, nor him, the dearest Friend of mortals, Mitra.

verses.sa:
प्र बाहवा सिसृतं जीवसे न आ नो गव्यूतिमुक्षतं घृतेन ।
आ नो जने श्रवयतं युवाना श्रुतं मे मित्रावरुणा हवेमा॥
verses.tr: pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena ā no jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā
verses.en: Stretch forth your arms and let our lives be lengthened: with fatness dew the pastures of our cattle. Ye Youthful, make us famed among the people: hear, Mitra-Varuna, these mine invocations.

verses.sa:
नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधन्तु ।
सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman vouchsafe us freedom and room, for us and for our children. May we find paths all fair and good to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उद्वेति सुभगो विश्वचक्षाः साधारणः सूर्यो मानुषाणाम् ।
चक्षुर्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य देवश्चर्मेव यः समविव्यक्तमांसि॥
verses.tr: udveti subhago viśvacakṣāḥ sādhāraṇaḥ sūryo mānuṣāṇām cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasya devaścarmeva yaḥ samavivyaktamāṃsi
verses.en: Common to all mankind, auspicious Surya, he who beholdeth all, is mounting upward; The God, the eye of Varuna and Mitra, who rolled up darkness like a piece of leather.

verses.sa:
उद्वेति प्रसवीता जनानां महान्केतुरर्णवः सूर्यस्य ।
समानं चक्रं पर्याविवृत्सन्यदेतशो वहति धूर्षु युक्तः॥
verses.tr: udveti prasavītā janānāṃ mahānketurarṇavaḥ sūryasya samānaṃ cakraṃ paryāvivṛtsanyadetaśo vahati dhūrṣu yuktaḥ
verses.en: Surya's great ensign, restless as the billow, that urgeth men to action, is advancing: Onward he still would roll the wheel well-rounded, which Etasa, harnessed to the car-pole, moveth.

verses.sa:
विभ्राजमान उषसामुपस्थाद्रेभैरुदेत्यनुमद्यमानः ।
एष मे देवः सविता चच्छन्द यः समानं न प्रमिनाति धाम॥
verses.tr: vibhrājamāna uṣasāmupasthādrebhairudetyanumadyamānaḥ eṣa me devaḥ savitā cacchanda yaḥ samānaṃ na pramināti dhāma
verses.en: Refulgent from the bosom of the Mornings, he in Whom singers take delight ascendeth. This Savitar, God, is my chief joy and pleasure, who breaketh not the universal statute.

verses.sa:
दिवो रुक्म उरुचक्षा उदेति दूरेअर्थस्तरणिर्भ्राजमानः ।
नूनं जनाः सूर्येण प्रसूता अयन्नर्थानि कृणवन्नपांसि॥
verses.tr: divo rukma urucakṣā udeti dūrearthastaraṇirbhrājamānaḥ nūnaṃ janāḥ sūryeṇa prasūtā ayannarthāni kṛṇavannapāṃsi
verses.en: Golden, far-seeing, from the heaven he riseth: far is his goal, he hasteth on resplendent. Men, verily, inspirited by Surya speed to their aims and do the work assigned them.

verses.sa:
यत्रा चक्रुरमृता गातुमस्मै श्येनो न दीयन्नन्वेति पाथः ।
प्रति वां सूर उदिते विधेम नमोभिर्मित्रावरुणोत हव्यैः॥
verses.tr: yatrā cakruramṛtā gātumasmai śyeno na dīyannanveti pāthaḥ prati vāṃ sūra udite vidhema namobhirmitrāvaruṇota havyaiḥ
verses.en: Where the immortals have prepared his pathway he flieth through the region like a falcon. With homage and oblations will we serve you, O Mitra-Varuna, when the Sun hath risen.

verses.sa:
नू मित्रो वरुणो अर्यमा नस्त्मने तोकाय वरिवो दधन्तु ।
सुगा नो विश्वा सुपथानि सन्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū mitro varuṇo aryamā nastmane tokāya varivo dadhantu sugā no viśvā supathāni santu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now Mitra, Varuna, Aryaman vouchsafe us freedom and room, for us and for our children. May we find paths all fair and good to travel. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
दिवि क्षयन्ता रजसः पृथिव्यां प्र वां घृतस्य निर्णिजो ददीरन् ।
हव्यं नो मित्रो अर्यमा सुजातो राजा सुक्षत्रो वरुणो जुषन्त॥
verses.tr: divi kṣayantā rajasaḥ pṛthivyāṃ pra vāṃ ghṛtasya nirṇijo dadīran havyaṃ no mitro aryamā sujāto rājā sukṣatro varuṇo juṣanta
verses.en: Ye Twain who rule, in heaven and earth, the region, clothed be your clouds in robes of oil and fatness. May the imperial Varuna, and Mitra, and high-born Aryaman accept our presents.

verses.sa:
आ राजाना मह ऋतस्य गोपा सिन्धुपती क्षत्रिया यातमर्वाक् ।
इळां नो मित्रावरुणोत वृष्टिमव दिव इन्वतं जीरदानू॥
verses.tr: ā rājānā maha ṛtasya gopā sindhupatī kṣatriyā yātamarvāk iḻāṃ no mitrāvaruṇota vṛṣṭimava diva invataṃ jīradānū
verses.en: Kings, guards of mighty everlasting Order, come hitherward, ye Princes, Lords of Rivers. Send us from heaven, O Varuna and Mitra, rain and sweet food, ye who pour down your bounties.

verses.sa:
मित्रस्तन्नो वरुणो देवो अर्यः प्र साधिष्ठेभिः पथिभिर्नयन्तु ।
ब्रवद्यथा न आदरिः सुदास इषा मदेम सह देवगोपाः॥
verses.tr: mitrastanno varuṇo devo aryaḥ pra sādhiṣṭhebhiḥ pathibhirnayantu bravadyathā na ādariḥ sudāsa iṣā madema saha devagopāḥ
verses.en: May the dear God, and Varuna and Mitra conduct us by the most effective pathways, That foes may say unto Sudas our chieftain, May, we, too, joy in food with Gods to guard us.

verses.sa:
यो वां गर्तं मनसा तक्षदेतमूर्ध्वां धीतिं कृणवद्धारयच्च ।
उक्षेथां मित्रावरुणा घृतेन ता राजाना सुक्षितीस्तर्पयेथाम्॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ gartaṃ manasā takṣadetamūrdhvāṃ dhītiṃ kṛṇavaddhārayacca ukṣethāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtena tā rājānā sukṣitīstarpayethām
verses.en: Him who hath wrought for you this car in spirit, who makes the song rise upward and sustains it, Bedew with fatness, Varuna nd Mitra ye Kings, make glad the pleasant dwelling-places.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: To you this laud, O Varuna and Mitra is offered like bright Soma juice to Vayu. Favour our songs of praise, wake thought and spirit. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रति वां सूर उदिते सूक्तैर्मित्रं हुवे वरुणं पूतदक्षम् ।
ययोरसुर्य१मक्षितं ज्येष्ठं विश्वस्य यामन्नाचिता जिगत्नु॥
verses.tr: prati vāṃ sūra udite sūktairmitraṃ huve varuṇaṃ pūtadakṣam yayorasurya1makṣitaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ viśvasya yāmannācitā jigatnu
verses.en: With hymns I call you, when the Sun hath risen, Mitra, and Varuna whose thoughts are holy, Whose Power Divine, supreme and everlasting, comes with good heed at each man's supplication.

verses.sa:
ता हि देवानामसुरा तावर्या ता नः क्षितीः करतमूर्जयन्तीः ।
अश्याम मित्रावरुणा वयं वां द्यावा च यत्र पीपयन्नहा च॥
verses.tr: tā hi devānāmasurā tāvaryā tā naḥ kṣitīḥ karatamūrjayantīḥ aśyāma mitrāvaruṇā vayaṃ vāṃ dyāvā ca yatra pīpayannahā ca
verses.en: For they are Asuras of Gods, the friendly make, both of you, our lands exceeding fruitful. May we obtain you, Varuna and Mitra, wherever Heaven and Earth and days may bless us.

verses.sa:
ता भूरिपाशावनृतस्य सेतू दुरत्येतू रिपवे मर्त्याय ।
ऋतस्य मित्रावरुणा पथा वामपो न नावा दुरिता तरेम॥
verses.tr: tā bhūripāśāvanṛtasya setū duratyetū ripave martyāya ṛtasya mitrāvaruṇā pathā vāmapo na nāvā duritā tarema
verses.en: Bonds of the sinner, they bear many nooses: the wicked mortal hardly may escape them. Varuna-Mitra, may your path of Order bear us o'er trouble as a boat o'er waters.

verses.sa:
आ नो मित्रावरुणा हव्यजुष्टिं घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतमिळाभिः ।
प्रति वामत्र वरमा जनाय पृणीतमुद्नो दिव्यस्य चारोः॥
verses.tr: ā no mitrāvaruṇā havyajuṣṭiṃ ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatamiḻābhiḥ prati vāmatra varamā janāya pṛṇītamudno divyasya cāroḥ
verses.en: Come, taste our offering, Varuna and Mitra: bedew our pasture wil sweet food and fatness. Pour down in plenty here upon the people the choicest of your fair celestial water.

verses.sa:
एष स्तोमो वरुण मित्र तुभ्यं सोमः शुक्रो न वायवेऽयामि ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: eṣa stomo varuṇa mitra tubhyaṃ somaḥ śukro na vāyave'yāmi aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: To you this laud, O Varuna and Mitra, is offered, like bright Soma juice to Vayu. Favour our songs of praise, wake thought and spirit. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: प्र मित्रयोर्वरुणयोः स्तोमो न एतु शूष्यः । नमस्वान्तुविजातयोः॥
verses.tr: pra mitrayorvaruṇayoḥ stomo na etu śūṣyaḥ namasvāntuvijātayoḥ
verses.en: Let our strong hymn of praise go forth, the laud of Mitra-Varuna, With homage to that high-born Pair;

verses.sa: या धारयन्त देवाः सुदक्षा दक्षपितरा । असुर्याय प्रमहसा॥
verses.tr: yā dhārayanta devāḥ sudakṣā dakṣapitarā asuryāya pramahasā
verses.en: The Two exceeding wise, the Sons of Daksa, whom the gods ordained For lordship, excellently great.

verses.sa: ता नः स्तिपा तनूपा वरुण जरितॄणाम् । मित्र साधयतं धियः॥
verses.tr: tā naḥ stipā tanūpā varuṇa jaritṝṇām mitra sādhayataṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Such, Guardians of our homes and us, O Mitra-Varuna, fulfil The thoughts of those who sing your praise.

verses.sa: यदद्य सूर उदितेऽनागा मित्रो अर्यमा । सुवाति सविता भगः॥
verses.tr: yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā suvāti savitā bhagaḥ
verses.en: So when the Sun hath risen to-day, may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar send us forth.

verses.sa: सुप्रावीरस्तु स क्षयः प्र नु यामन्त्सुदानवः । ये नो अंहोऽतिपिप्रति॥
verses.tr: suprāvīrastu sa kṣayaḥ pra nu yāmantsudānavaḥ ye no aṃho'tipiprati
verses.en: May this our home be guarded well forward, ye Bounteous, on the way, Who bear us safely o'er distress.

verses.sa: उत स्वराजो अदितिरदब्धस्य व्रतस्य ये । महो राजान ईशते॥
verses.tr: uta svarājo aditiradabdhasya vratasya ye maho rājāna īśate
verses.en: And those Self-reigning, Aditi, whose statute is inviolate, The Kings who rule a vast domain.

verses.sa: प्रति वां सूर उदिते मित्रं गृणीषे वरुणम् । अर्यमणं रिशादसम्॥
verses.tr: prati vāṃ sūra udite mitraṃ gṛṇīṣe varuṇam aryamaṇaṃ riśādasam
verses.en: Soon as the Sun hath risen, to you, to Mitra-Varuna, I sing, And Aryaman who slays the foe.

verses.sa: राया हिरण्यया मतिरियमवृकाय शवसे । इयं विप्रा मेधसातये॥
verses.tr: rāyā hiraṇyayā matiriyamavṛkāya śavase iyaṃ viprā medhasātaye
verses.en: With wealth of gold may this my song bring unmolested power and might, And, Brahmans, gain the sacrifice.

verses.sa: ते स्याम देव वरुण ते मित्र सूरिभिः सह । इषं स्वश्च धीमहि॥
verses.tr: te syāma deva varuṇa te mitra sūribhiḥ saha iṣaṃ svaśca dhīmahi
verses.en: May we be thine, God Varuna, and with our princes, Mitra, thine. Food and Heaven's light will we obtain.

verses.sa: बहवः सूरचक्षसोऽग्निजिह्वा ऋतावृधः । त्रीणि ये येमुर्विदथानि धीतिभिर्विश्वानि परिभूतिभिः॥
verses.tr: bahavaḥ sūracakṣaso'gnijihvā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ trīṇi ye yemurvidathāni dhītibhirviśvāni paribhūtibhiḥ
verses.en: Many are they who strengthen Law, Sun-eyed, with Agni for their tongue, They who direct the three great gatherings with their thoughts, yea, all things with surpassing might.

verses.sa:
वि ये दधुः शरदं मासमादहर्यज्ञमक्तुं चादृचम् ।
अनाप्यं वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा क्षत्रं राजान आशत॥
verses.tr: vi ye dadhuḥ śaradaṃ māsamādaharyajñamaktuṃ cādṛcam anāpyaṃ varuṇo mitro aryamā kṣatraṃ rājāna āśata
verses.en: They who have stablished year and month and then the day, night, sacrifice and holy verse, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Kings, have won dominion which none else may gain.

verses.sa: तद्वो अद्य मनामहे सूक्तैः सूर उदिते । यदोहते वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः॥
verses.tr: tadvo adya manāmahe sūktaiḥ sūra udite yadohate varuṇo mitro aryamā yūyamṛtasya rathyaḥ
verses.en: So at the rising of the Sun we think of you with hymns to-day, Even as Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman deserve: ye are the charioteers of Law.

verses.sa:
ऋतावान ऋतजाता ऋतावृधो घोरासो अनृतद्विषः ।
तेषां वः सुम्ने सुच्छर्दिष्टमे नरः स्याम ये च सूरयः॥
verses.tr: ṛtāvāna ṛtajātā ṛtāvṛdho ghorāso anṛtadviṣaḥ teṣāṃ vaḥ sumne succhardiṣṭame naraḥ syāma ye ca sūrayaḥ
verses.en: True to Law, born in Law the strengtheners of Law, terrible, haters of the false, In their felicity which gives the best defense may we men and our princes dwell.

verses.sa: उदु त्यद्दर्शतं वपुर्दिव एति प्रतिह्वरे । यदीमाशुर्वहति देव एतशो विश्वस्मै चक्षसे अरम्॥
verses.tr: udu tyaddarśataṃ vapurdiva eti pratihvare yadīmāśurvahati deva etaśo viśvasmai cakṣase aram
verses.en: Uprises, on the slope of heaven, that marvel that attracts die sight As swift celestial Etasa bears it away, prepared for every eye to see.

verses.sa:
शीर्ष्णःशीर्ष्णो जगतस्तस्थुषस्पतिं समया विश्वमा रजः ।
सप्त स्वसारः सुविताय सूर्यं वहन्ति हरितो रथे॥
verses.tr: śīrṣṇaḥśīrṣṇo jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ samayā viśvamā rajaḥ sapta svasāraḥ suvitāya sūryaṃ vahanti harito rathe
verses.en: Lord of each single head, of fixt and moving things, equally through the whole expanse, The Seven sister Bays bear Surya on his car, to bring us wealth and happiness.

verses.sa: तच्चक्षुर्देवहितं शुक्रमुच्चरत् । पश्येम शरदः शतं जीवेम शरदः शतम्॥
verses.tr: taccakṣurdevahitaṃ śukramuccarat paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śatam
verses.en: A hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye, God-ordained, arise A hundred autumns may we live.

verses.sa: काव्येभिरदाभ्या ऽऽयातं वरुण द्युमत् । मित्रश्च सोमपीतये॥
verses.tr: kāvyebhiradābhyā ''yātaṃ varuṇa dyumat mitraśca somapītaye
verses.en: Infallible through your wisdom, come hither, resplendent Varuna, And Mitra, to the Soma draught.

verses.sa: दिवो धामभिर्वरुण मित्रश्चा यातमद्रुहा । पिबतं सोममातुजी॥
verses.tr: divo dhāmabhirvaruṇa mitraścā yātamadruhā pibataṃ somamātujī
verses.en: Come as the laws of Heaven ordain, Varuna, Mitra, void of guile: Press near and drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa: आ यातं मित्रावरुणा जुषाणावाहुतिं नरा । पातं सोममृतावृधा॥
verses.tr: ā yātaṃ mitrāvaruṇā juṣāṇāvāhutiṃ narā pātaṃ somamṛtāvṛdhā
verses.en: Come, Mitra, Varuna, accept, Heroes, our sacrificial gift: Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.

verses.sa:
अश्विनौ। त्रिष्टुप् ।
प्रति वां रथं नृपती जरध्यै हविष्मता मनसा यज्ञियेन ।
यो वां दूतो न धिष्ण्यावजीगरच्छा सूनुर्न पितरा विवक्मि॥
verses.tr: aśvinau triṣṭup prati vāṃ rathaṃ nṛpatī jaradhyai haviṣmatā manasā yajñiyena yo vāṃ dūto na dhiṣṇyāvajīgaracchā sūnurna pitarā vivakmi
verses.en: I WITH a holy heart that brings oblation will sing forth praise to meet your car, ye Princes, Which, Much-desired! hath wakened as your envoy. I call you hither as a son his parents.

verses.sa:
अशोच्यग्निः समिधानो अस्मे उपो अदृश्रन्तमसश्चिदन्ताः ।
अचेति केतुरुषसः पुरस्ताच्छ्रिये दिवो दुहितुर्जायमानः॥
verses.tr: aśocyagniḥ samidhāno asme upo adṛśrantamasaścidantāḥ aceti keturuṣasaḥ purastācchriye divo duhiturjāyamānaḥ
verses.en: Brightly hath Agni shone by us enkindled: the limits even of darkness were apparent. Eastward is seen the Banner of the Morning, the Banner born to give Heaven's Daughter glory.

verses.sa:
अभि वां नूनमश्विना सुहोता स्तोमैः सिषक्ति नासत्या विवक्वान् ।
पूर्वीभिर्यातं पथ्याभिरर्वाक्स्वर्विदा वसुमता रथेन॥
verses.tr: abhi vāṃ nūnamaśvinā suhotā stomaiḥ siṣakti nāsatyā vivakvān pūrvībhiryātaṃ pathyābhirarvāksvarvidā vasumatā rathena
verses.en: With hymns the deft priest is about you, Asvins, the eloquent priest attends you now, Nasatyas. Come by the paths that ye are wont to travel, on car that finds the light, laden with treasure.

verses.sa:
अवोर्वां नूनमश्विना युवाकुर्हुवे यद्वां सुते माध्वी वसूयुः ।
आ वां वहन्तु स्थविरासो अश्वाः पिबाथो अस्मे सुषुता मधूनि॥
verses.tr: avorvāṃ nūnamaśvinā yuvākurhuve yadvāṃ sute mādhvī vasūyuḥ ā vāṃ vahantu sthavirāso aśvāḥ pibātho asme suṣutā madhūni
verses.en: When, suppliant for your help, Lovers of Sweetness! I seeking wealth call you to our libation, Hitherward let your vigorous horses bear you: drink ye with us the well-pressed Soma juices.

verses.sa:
प्राचीमु देवाश्विना धियं मेऽमृध्रां सातये कृतं वसूयुम् ।
विश्वा अविष्टं वाज आ पुरंधीस्ता नः शक्तं शचीपती शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: prācīmu devāśvinā dhiyaṃ me'mṛdhrāṃ sātaye kṛtaṃ vasūyum viśvā aviṣṭaṃ vāja ā puraṃdhīstā naḥ śaktaṃ śacīpatī śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Bring forward, Asvins, Gods, to its fulfilment my never-wearied prayer that asks for riches. Vouchsafe us all high spirit in the combat, and with your powers, O Lords of Power, assist us.

verses.sa:
अविष्टं धीष्वश्विना न आसु प्रजावद्रेतो अह्रयं नो अस्तु ।
आ वां तोके तनये तूतुजानाः सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम॥
verses.tr: aviṣṭaṃ dhīṣvaśvinā na āsu prajāvadreto ahrayaṃ no astu ā vāṃ toke tanaye tūtujānāḥ suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema
verses.en: Favour us in these prayers of ours, O Asvins. May we have genial vigour, ne'er to fail us. So may we, strong in children and descendants, go, wealthy, to the banquet that awaits you.

verses.sa:
एष स्य वां पूर्वगत्वेव सख्ये निधिर्हितो माध्वी रातो अस्मे ।
अहेळता मनसा यातमर्वागश्नन्ता हव्यं मानुषीषु विक्षु॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya vāṃ pūrvagatveva sakhye nidhirhito mādhvī rāto asme aheḻatā manasā yātamarvāgaśnantā havyaṃ mānuṣīṣu vikṣu
verses.en: Lovers of Sweetness, we have brought this treasure to you as 'twere an envoy sent for friendship. Come unto us with spirits free from anger, in homes of men enjoying our oblation.

verses.sa:
एकस्मिन्योगे भुरणा समाने परि वां सप्त स्रवतो रथो गात् ।
न वायन्ति सुभ्वो देवयुक्ता ये वां धूर्षु तरणयो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: ekasminyoge bhuraṇā samāne pari vāṃ sapta sravato ratho gāt na vāyanti subhvo devayuktā ye vāṃ dhūrṣu taraṇayo vahanti
verses.en: With one, the same, intention, ye swift movers, o'er the Seven Rivers hath your chariot travelled. Yoked by the Gods, your strong steeds never weary while speeding forward at the pole they bear you.

verses.sa:
असश्चता मघवद्भ्यो हि भूतं ये राया मघदेयं जुनन्ति ।
प्र ये बन्धुं सूनृताभिस्तिरन्ते गव्या पृञ्चन्तो अश्व्या मघानि॥
verses.tr: asaścatā maghavadbhyo hi bhūtaṃ ye rāyā maghadeyaṃ junanti pra ye bandhuṃ sūnṛtābhistirante gavyā pṛñcanto aśvyā maghāni
verses.en: Exhaustless be your bounty to our princes who with their wealth incite the gift of riches, Who further friendship with their noble natures, combining wealth in kine with wealth in horses.

verses.sa:
नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ।
धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now hear, O Youthful Twain, mine invocation: come, Asvins, to the home where food aboundeth. Vouchsafe us wealth, do honour to our nobles. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: आ शुभ्रा यातमश्विना स्वश्वा गिरो दस्रा जुजुषाणा युवाकोः । हव्यानि च प्रतिभृता वीतं नः॥
verses.tr: ā śubhrā yātamaśvinā svaśvā giro dasrā jujuṣāṇā yuvākoḥ havyāni ca pratibhṛtā vītaṃ naḥ
verses.en: Come, radiant Asvins, with your noble horses: accept your servant's hymns, ye Wonder-Workers: Enjoy oblations which we bring to greet you.

verses.sa: प्र वामन्धांसि मद्यान्यस्थुररं गन्तं हविषो वीतये मे । तिरो अर्यो हवनानि श्रुतं नः॥
verses.tr: pra vāmandhāṃsi madyānyasthuraraṃ gantaṃ haviṣo vītaye me tiro aryo havanāni śrutaṃ naḥ
verses.en: The gladdening juices stand prepared before you: come quickly and partake of mine oblation. Pass by the calling of our foe and bear us.

verses.sa: प्र वां रथो मनोजवा इयर्ति तिरो रजांस्यश्विना शतोतिः । अस्मभ्यं सूर्यावसू इयानः॥
verses.tr: pra vāṃ ratho manojavā iyarti tiro rajāṃsyaśvinā śatotiḥ asmabhyaṃ sūryāvasū iyānaḥ
verses.en: Your chariot with a hundred aids, O Asvins, beareth you swift as thought across the regions, Speeding to us, O ye whose wealth is Surya.

verses.sa: अयं ह यद्वां देवया उ अद्रिरूर्ध्वो विवक्ति सोमसुद्युवभ्याम् । आ वल्गू विप्रो ववृतीत हव्यैः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ ha yadvāṃ devayā u adrirūrdhvo vivakti somasudyuvabhyām ā valgū vipro vavṛtīta havyaiḥ
verses.en: What time this stone of yours, the Gods' adorer, upraised, sounds forth for you as Soma-presser, Let the priest bring you, Fair Ones, through oblations.

verses.sa: चित्रं ह यद्वां भोजनं न्वस्ति न्यत्रये महिष्वन्तं युयोतम् । यो वामोमानं दधते प्रियः सन्॥
verses.tr: citraṃ ha yadvāṃ bhojanaṃ nvasti nyatraye mahiṣvantaṃ yuyotam yo vāmomānaṃ dadhate priyaḥ san
verses.en: The nourishment ye have is, truly, wondrous: ye gave thereof a quickening store to Atri, Who being dear to you, receives your favour.

verses.sa: उत त्यद्वां जुरते अश्विना भूच्च्यवानाय प्रतीत्यं हविर्दे । अधि यद्वर्प इतऊति धत्थः॥
verses.tr: uta tyadvāṃ jurate aśvinā bhūccyavānāya pratītyaṃ havirde adhi yadvarpa itaūti dhatthaḥ
verses.en: That gift, which all may gain, ye gave Cyavana, when he grew old, who offered you oblations, When ye bestowed on him enduring beauty.

verses.sa: उत त्यं भुज्युमश्विना सखायो मध्ये जहुर्दुरेवासः समुद्रे । निरीं पर्षदरावा यो युवाकुः॥
verses.tr: uta tyaṃ bhujyumaśvinā sakhāyo madhye jahurdurevāsaḥ samudre nirīṃ parṣadarāvā yo yuvākuḥ
verses.en: What time his wicked friends abandoned Bhujyu, O Asvins, in the middle of the ocean, Your horse delivered him, your faithful servant.

verses.sa:
वृकाय चिज्जसमानाय शक्तमुत श्रुतं शयवे हूयमाना ।
यावघ्न्यामपिन्वतमपो न स्तर्यं चिच्छक्त्यश्विना शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: vṛkāya cijjasamānāya śaktamuta śrutaṃ śayave hūyamānā yāvaghnyāmapinvatamapo na staryaṃ cicchaktyaśvinā śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Ye lent your aid to Vrka when exhausted, and listened when invoked to Sayu's calling. Ye made the cow pour forth her milk like water, and, Asvins, strengthened with your strength the barren.

verses.sa:
एष स्य कारुर्जरते सूक्तैरग्रे बुधान उषसां सुमन्मा ।
इषा तं वर्धदघ्न्या पयोभिर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: eṣa sya kārurjarate sūktairagre budhāna uṣasāṃ sumanmā iṣā taṃ vardhadaghnyā payobhiryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: With his fair hymns this singer, too, extols you, waking with glad thoughts at the break of morning. May the cow nourish him with milk to feed him. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो रोदसी बद्बधानो हिरण्ययो वृषभिर्यात्वश्वैः ।
घृतवर्तनिः पविभी रुचान इषां वोळ्हा नृपतिर्वाजिनीवान्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ ratho rodasī badbadhāno hiraṇyayo vṛṣabhiryātvaśvaiḥ ghṛtavartaniḥ pavibhī rucāna iṣāṃ voḻhā nṛpatirvājinīvān
verses.en: May your gold chariot, drawn by vigorous horses, come to us, blocking up the earth and heaven, Bright with its fellies while its way drops fatness, food-laden, rich in coursers, man's protector.

verses.sa:
स पप्रथानो अभि पञ्च भूमा त्रिवन्धुरो मनसा यातु युक्तः ।
विशो येन गच्छथो देवयन्तीः कुत्रा चिद्याममश्विना दधाना॥
verses.tr: sa paprathāno abhi pañca bhūmā trivandhuro manasā yātu yuktaḥ viśo yena gacchatho devayantīḥ kutrā cidyāmamaśvinā dadhānā
verses.en: Let it approach, yoked by the will, three-seated, extending far and wide o'er fivefold beings, Whereon ye visit God-adoring races, bending your course whither ye will, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
स्वश्वा यशसा यातमर्वाग्दस्रा निधिं मधुमन्तं पिबाथः ।
वि वां रथो वध्वा३ यादमानोऽन्तान्दिवो बाधते वर्तनिभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: svaśvā yaśasā yātamarvāgdasrā nidhiṃ madhumantaṃ pibāthaḥ vi vāṃ ratho vadhvā3 yādamāno'ntāndivo bādhate vartanibhyām
verses.en: Renowned, with noble horses, come ye hither: drink, Wondrous Pair, the cup that holds sweet juices. Your car whereon your Spouse is wont to travel marks with its track the farthest ends of heaven.

verses.sa:
युवोः श्रियं परि योषावृणीत सूरो दुहिता परितक्म्यायाम् ।
यद्देवयन्तमवथः शचीभिः परि घ्रंसमोमना वां वयो गात्॥
verses.tr: yuvoḥ śriyaṃ pari yoṣāvṛṇīta sūro duhitā paritakmyāyām yaddevayantamavathaḥ śacībhiḥ pari ghraṃsamomanā vāṃ vayo gāt
verses.en: When night was turning to the grey of morning the Maiden, Surya's Daughter, chose your splendour. When with your power and might ye aid the pious he comes through heat to life by your assistance.

verses.sa:
यो ह स्य वां रथिरा वस्त उस्रा रथो युजानः परियाति वर्तिः ।
तेन नः शं योरुषसो व्युष्टौ न्यश्विना वहतं यज्ञे अस्मिन्॥
verses.tr: yo ha sya vāṃ rathirā vasta usrā ratho yujānaḥ pariyāti vartiḥ tena naḥ śaṃ yoruṣaso vyuṣṭau nyaśvinā vahataṃ yajñe asmin
verses.en: O Chariot-borne, this car of yours invested with rays of light comes harnessed to our dwelling. Herewith, O Asvins, while the dawn is breaking, to this our sacrifice bring peace and blessing.

verses.sa:
नरा गौरेव विद्युतं तृषाणाऽस्माकमद्य सवनोप यातम् ।
पुरुत्रा हि वां मतिभिर्हवन्ते मा वामन्ये नि यमन्देवयन्तः॥
verses.tr: narā gaureva vidyutaṃ tṛṣāṇā'smākamadya savanopa yātam purutrā hi vāṃ matibhirhavante mā vāmanye ni yamandevayantaḥ
verses.en: Like the wild cattle thirsty for the lightning, Heroes, come nigh this day to our libations. Men call on you with hymns in many places, but let not other worshippers detain you.

verses.sa:
युवं भुज्युमवविद्धं समुद्र उदूहथुरर्णसो अस्रिधानैः ।
पतत्रिभिरश्रमैरव्यथिभिर्दंसनाभिरश्विना पारयन्ता॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ bhujyumavaviddhaṃ samudra udūhathurarṇaso asridhānaiḥ patatribhiraśramairavyathibhirdaṃsanābhiraśvinā pārayantā
verses.en: Bhujyu, abandoned in the midst of ocean, ye raised from out the water with your horses, Uninjured, winged, flagging not, undaunted, with deeds of wonder saving him, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
नू मे हवमा शृणुतं युवाना यासिष्टं वर्तिरश्विनाविरावत् ।
धत्तं रत्नानि जरतं च सूरीन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū me havamā śṛṇutaṃ yuvānā yāsiṣṭaṃ vartiraśvināvirāvat dhattaṃ ratnāni jarataṃ ca sūrīnyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Now hear, O Youthful Twain, mine invocation: come, Asvins, to the home where food aboundeth. Vouchsafe us wealth, do honour to our nobles. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ विश्ववाराश्विना गतं नः प्र तत्स्थानमवाचि वां पृथिव्याम् ।
अश्वो न वाजी शुनपृष्ठो अस्थादा यत्सेदथुर्ध्रुवसे न योनिम्॥
verses.tr: ā viśvavārāśvinā gataṃ naḥ pra tatsthānamavāci vāṃ pṛthivyām aśvo na vājī śunapṛṣṭho asthādā yatsedathurdhruvase na yonim
verses.en: Rich in all blessings, Asvins come ye hither: this place on earth is called your own possession, Like a strong horse with a fair back it standeth, whereon, as in a lap, ye seat you firmly.

verses.sa:
सिषक्ति सा वां सुमतिश्चनिष्ठाऽतापि घर्मो मनुषो दुरोणे ।
यो वां समुद्रान्त्सरितः पिपर्त्येतग्वा चिन्न सुयुजा युजानः॥
verses.tr: siṣakti sā vāṃ sumatiścaniṣṭhā'tāpi gharmo manuṣo duroṇe yo vāṃ samudrāntsaritaḥ pipartyetagvā cinna suyujā yujānaḥ
verses.en: This most delightful eulogy awaits you in the man's house drink-offering hath been heated, Which bringeth you over the seas and rivers, yoking as'twere two well-matched shining horses.

verses.sa:
यानि स्थानान्यश्विना दधाथे दिवो यह्वीष्वोषधीषु विक्षु ।
नि पर्वतस्य मूर्धनि सदन्तेषं जनाय दाशुषे वहन्ता॥
verses.tr: yāni sthānānyaśvinā dadhāthe divo yahvīṣvoṣadhīṣu vikṣu ni parvatasya mūrdhani sadanteṣaṃ janāya dāśuṣe vahantā
verses.en: Whatever dwellings ye possess, O Asvins, in fields of men or in the streams of heaven, Resting upon the summit of the mountain, or bringing food to him who gives oblation,

verses.sa:
चनिष्टं देवा ओषधीष्वप्सु यद्योग्या अश्नवैथे ऋषीणाम् ।
पुरूणि रत्ना दधतौ न्य१स्मे अनु पूर्वाणि चख्यथुर्युगानि॥
verses.tr: caniṣṭaṃ devā oṣadhīṣvapsu yadyogyā aśnavaithe ṛṣīṇām purūṇi ratnā dadhatau nya1sme anu pūrvāṇi cakhyathuryugāni
verses.en: Delight yourselves, ye Gods, in plants and waters when Rsis give them and ye find they suit You. Enriching us with treasures in abundance ye have looked back to former generations.

verses.sa:
शुश्रुवांसा चिदश्विना पुरूण्यभि ब्रह्माणि चक्षाथे ऋषीणाम् ।
प्रति प्र यातं वरमा जनायाऽस्मे वामस्तु सुमतिश्चनिष्ठा॥
verses.tr: śuśruvāṃsā cidaśvinā purūṇyabhi brahmāṇi cakṣāthe ṛṣīṇām prati pra yātaṃ varamā janāyā'sme vāmastu sumatiścaniṣṭhā
