verses.en: Asvins, though ye have heard them oft aforetime, regard the many prayers which Rsis offer. Come to the man even as his heart desireth: may we enjoy your most delightful favour.

verses.sa:
यो वां यज्ञो नासत्या हविष्मान्कृतब्रह्मा समर्यो३ भवाति ।
उप प्र यातं वरमा वसिष्ठमिमा ब्रह्माण्यृच्यन्ते युवभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ yajño nāsatyā haviṣmānkṛtabrahmā samaryo3 bhavāti upa pra yātaṃ varamā vasiṣṭhamimā brahmāṇyṛcyante yuvabhyām
verses.en: Come to the sacrifice offered you, Nasatyas, with men, oblations, and prayer duly uttered. Come to Vasistha as his heart desireth, for unto you these holy hymns are chanted.

verses.sa:
इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् ।
इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: This is the thought, this is the song, O Asvins: accept this hymn of ours, ye Steers, with favour. May these our prayers addressed to you come nigh you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
अप स्वसुरुषसो नग्जिहीते रिणक्ति कृष्णीररुषाय पन्थाम् ।
अश्वामघा गोमघा वां हुवेम दिवा नक्तं शरुमस्मद्युयोतम्॥
verses.tr: apa svasuruṣaso nagjihīte riṇakti kṛṣṇīraruṣāya panthām aśvāmaghā gomaghā vāṃ huvema divā naktaṃ śarumasmadyuyotam
verses.en: The Night retireth from the Dawn her Sister; the Dark one yieldeth to the Red her pathway. Let us invoke you rich in steeds and cattle - by day and night keep far from us the arrow.

verses.sa:
उपायातं दाशुषे मर्त्याय रथेन वाममश्विना वहन्ता ।
युयुतमस्मदनिराममीवां दिवा नक्तं माध्वी त्रासीथां नः॥
verses.tr: upāyātaṃ dāśuṣe martyāya rathena vāmamaśvinā vahantā yuyutamasmadanirāmamīvāṃ divā naktaṃ mādhvī trāsīthāṃ naḥ
verses.en: Bearing rich treasure in your car, O Asvins, come to the mortal who presents oblation. Keep at a distance penury and sickness; Lovers of Sweetness, day and night preserve us.

verses.sa:
आ वां रथमवमस्यां व्युष्टौ सुम्नायवो वृषणो वर्तयन्तु ।
स्यूमगभस्तिमृतयुग्भिरश्वैराश्विना वसुमन्तं वहेथाम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ rathamavamasyāṃ vyuṣṭau sumnāyavo vṛṣaṇo vartayantu syūmagabhastimṛtayugbhiraśvairāśvinā vasumantaṃ vahethām
verses.en: May your strong horses, seeking bliss, bring hither your chariot at the earliest flush of morning. With coursers yoked by Law drive hither, Asvins, your car whose reins are light, laden with treasure.

verses.sa:
यो वां रथो नृपती अस्ति वोळ्हा त्रिवन्धुरो वसुमाँ उस्रयामा ।
आ न एना नासत्योप यातमभि यद्वां विश्वप्स्न्यो जिगाति॥
verses.tr: yo vāṃ ratho nṛpatī asti voḻhā trivandhuro vasumāṃ usrayāmā ā na enā nāsatyopa yātamabhi yadvāṃ viśvapsnyo jigāti
verses.en: The chariot, Princes, that conveys you, moving at daylight, triple-seated, fraught with riches, Even with this come unto us, Nasatyas, that laden with all food it may approach us.

verses.sa:
युवं च्यवानं जरसोऽमुमुक्तं नि पेदव ऊहथुराशुमश्वम् ।
निरंहसस्तमसः स्पर्तमत्रिं नि जाहुषं शिथिरे धातमन्तः॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ cyavānaṃ jaraso'mumuktaṃ ni pedava ūhathurāśumaśvam niraṃhasastamasaḥ spartamatriṃ ni jāhuṣaṃ śithire dhātamantaḥ
verses.en: Ye freed Cyavana from old age and weakness: ye brought the courser fleet of food to Pedu. Ye rescued Atri from distress and darkness, and loosed for Jahusa the bonds that bound him.

verses.sa:
इयं मनीषा इयमश्विना गीरिमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् ।
इमा ब्रह्माणि युवयून्यग्मन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ manīṣā iyamaśvinā gīrimāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām imā brahmāṇi yuvayūnyagmanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: This is the thought, this is the song, O Asvins: accept this hymn of ours, ye Steers, With favour. May these our prayers addressed to you come nigh you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ गोमता नासत्या रथेनाऽश्वावता पुरुश्चन्द्रेण यातम् ।
अभि वां विश्वा नियुतः सचन्ते स्पार्हया श्रिया तन्वा शुभाना॥
verses.tr: ā gomatā nāsatyā rathenā'śvāvatā puruścandreṇa yātam abhi vāṃ viśvā niyutaḥ sacante spārhayā śriyā tanvā śubhānā
verses.en: Come, O Nasatyas, on your car resplendent, rich in abundant wealth of kine and horses. As harnessed steeds, all our laudations follow you whose forms shine with most delightful beauty.

verses.sa:
आ नो देवेभिरुप यातमर्वाक्सजोषसा नासत्या रथेन ।
युवोर्हि नः सख्या पित्र्याणि समानो बन्धुरुत तस्य वित्तम्॥
verses.tr: ā no devebhirupa yātamarvāksajoṣasā nāsatyā rathena yuvorhi naḥ sakhyā pitryāṇi samāno bandhuruta tasya vittam
verses.en: Come with the Gods associate, come ye hither to us, Nasatyas, with your car accordant. 'Twixt you and us there is ancestral friendship and common kin: remember and regard it.

verses.sa:
उदु स्तोमासो अश्विनोरबुध्रञ्जामि ब्रह्माण्युषसश्च देवीः ।
आविवासन्रोदसी धिष्ण्येमे अच्छा विप्रो नासत्या विवक्ति॥
verses.tr: udu stomāso aśvinorabudhrañjāmi brahmāṇyuṣasaśca devīḥ āvivāsanrodasī dhiṣṇyeme acchā vipro nāsatyā vivakti
verses.en: Awakened are the songs that praise the Asvins, the kindred prayers and the Celestial Mornings. Inviting those we long for, Earth and Heaven, the singer calleth these Nasatyas hither.

verses.sa:
वि चेदुच्छन्त्यश्विना उषासः प्र वां ब्रह्माणि कारवो भरन्ते ।
ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता देवो अश्रेद्बृहदग्नयः समिधा जरन्ते॥
verses.tr: vi ceducchantyaśvinā uṣāsaḥ pra vāṃ brahmāṇi kāravo bharante ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā devo aśredbṛhadagnayaḥ samidhā jarante
verses.en: What time the Dawns break forth in light, O Asvins, to you the poets offer their devotions. God Savitar hath sent aloft his splendour, and fires sing praises with the kindled fuel.

verses.sa:
आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् ।
आ विश्वतः पाञ्चजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Come from the west, come from the cast, Nasatyas, come, Asvins, from below and from above us. Bring wealth from all sides for the Fivefold People. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
अतारिष्म तमसस्पारमस्य प्रति स्तोमं देवयन्तो दधानाः ।
पुरुदंसा पुरुतमा पुराजाऽमर्त्या हवते अश्विना गीः॥
verses.tr: atāriṣma tamasaspāramasya prati stomaṃ devayanto dadhānāḥ purudaṃsā purutamā purājā'martyā havate aśvinā gīḥ
verses.en: We have o'erpassed the limit of this darkness while, worshipping the Gods, we sang their praises. The song invoketh both Immortal Asvins far-reaching, born of old, great WonderWorkers.

verses.sa:
न्यु प्रियो मनुषः सादि होता नासत्या यो यजते वन्दते च ।
अश्नीतं मध्वो अश्विना उपाक आ वां वोचे विदथेषु प्रयस्वान्॥
verses.tr: nyu priyo manuṣaḥ sādi hotā nāsatyā yo yajate vandate ca aśnītaṃ madhvo aśvinā upāka ā vāṃ voce vidatheṣu prayasvān
verses.en: And, O Nasatyas, man's dear Priest is seated, who brings to sacrifice and offers worship, Be near and taste the pleasant juice, O Asvins: with food, I call you to the sacrifices.

verses.sa:
अहेम यज्ञं पथामुराणा इमां सुवृक्तिं वृषणा जुषेथाम् ।
श्रुष्टीवेव प्रेषितो वामबोधि प्रति स्तोमैर्जरमाणो वसिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: ahema yajñaṃ pathāmurāṇā imāṃ suvṛktiṃ vṛṣaṇā juṣethām śruṣṭīveva preṣito vāmabodhi prati stomairjaramāṇo vasiṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: We choosing you, have let our worship follow its course: ye Steers, accept this hymn with favour. Obeying you as your appointed servant, Vasistha singing hath with lauds aroused you.

verses.sa:
उप त्या वह्नी गमतो विशं नो रक्षोहणा सम्भृता वीळुपाणी ।
समन्धांस्यग्मत मत्सराणि मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतं शिवेन॥
verses.tr: upa tyā vahnī gamato viśaṃ no rakṣohaṇā sambhṛtā vīḻupāṇī samandhāṃsyagmata matsarāṇi mā no mardhiṣṭamā gataṃ śivena
verses.en: And these Two Priests come nigh unto our people, united, demon-slayers, mighty-handed. The juices that exhilarate are mingled. Injure us not, but come with happy fortune.

verses.sa:
आ पश्चातान्नासत्या पुरस्तादाश्विना यातमधरादुदक्तात् ।
आ विश्वतः पाञ्चजन्येन राया यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ā paścātānnāsatyā purastādāśvinā yātamadharādudaktāt ā viśvataḥ pāñcajanyena rāyā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Come from the west, come from the cast, Nasatyas, come, Asvins, from below and from above us. Bring wealth from all sides for the Fivefold People. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
इमा उ वां दिविष्टय उस्रा हवन्ते अश्विना ।
अयं वामह्वेऽवसे शचीवसू विशंविशं हि गच्छथः॥
verses.tr: imā u vāṃ diviṣṭaya usrā havante aśvinā ayaṃ vāmahve'vase śacīvasū viśaṃviśaṃ hi gacchathaḥ
verses.en: These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house ye visit all.

verses.sa:
युवं चित्रं ददथुर्भोजनं नरा चोदेथां सूनृतावते ।
अर्वाग्रथं समनसा नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु॥
verses.tr: yuvaṃ citraṃ dadathurbhojanaṃ narā codethāṃ sūnṛtāvate arvāgrathaṃ samanasā ni yacchataṃ pibataṃ somyaṃ madhu
verses.en: O Heroes, ye bestow wonderful nourishment. send it to him whose songs are sweet Accordant, both of you, drive your car down to us, and drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ यातमुप भूषतं मध्वः पिबतमश्विना ।
दुग्धं पयो वृषणा जेन्यावसू मा नो मर्धिष्टमा गतम्॥
verses.tr: ā yātamupa bhūṣataṃ madhvaḥ pibatamaśvinā dugdhaṃ payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭamā gatam
verses.en: Approach ye and be near to us. drink, O ye Asvins, of the meath. Draw forth the milk, ye Mighty, rich in genuine wealth: injure us not, and come to us.

verses.sa:
अश्वासो ये वामुप दाशुषो गृहं युवां दीयन्ति बिभ्रतः ।
मक्षूयुभिर्नरा हयेभिरश्विना ऽऽदेवा यातमस्मयू॥
verses.tr: aśvāso ye vāmupa dāśuṣo gṛhaṃ yuvāṃ dīyanti bibhrataḥ makṣūyubhirnarā hayebhiraśvinā ''devā yātamasmayū
verses.en: The horses that convey you in their rapid flight down to the worshipper's abode, With these your speedy coursers, Heroes, Asvins, come, ye Gods, come well-inclined to us.

verses.sa:
अधा ह यन्तो अश्विना पृक्षः सचन्त सूरयः ।
ता यंसतो मघवद्भ्यो ध्रुवं यशश्छर्दिरस्मभ्यं नासत्या॥
verses.tr: adhā ha yanto aśvinā pṛkṣaḥ sacanta sūrayaḥ tā yaṃsato maghavadbhyo dhruvaṃ yaśaśchardirasmabhyaṃ nāsatyā
verses.en: Yea, verily, our princes seek the Asvins in pursuit of food. These shall give lasting glory to our liberal lords, and, both Nasatyas, shelter us.

verses.sa:
प्र ये ययुरवृकासो रथा इव नृपातारो जनानाम् ।
उत स्वेन शवसा शूशुवुर्नर उत क्षियन्ति सुक्षितिम्॥
verses.tr: pra ye yayuravṛkāso rathā iva nṛpātāro janānām uta svena śavasā śūśuvurnara uta kṣiyanti sukṣitim
verses.en: Those who have led the way, like cars, offending none, those who are guardians of the men- Also through their own might the heroes have grown strong, and dwell in safe and happy homes.

verses.sa:
व्यु१षा आवो दिविजा ऋतेनाऽऽविष्कृण्वाना महिमानमागात् ।
अप द्रुहस्तम आवरजुष्टमङ्गिरस्तमा पथ्या अजीगः॥
verses.tr: vyu1ṣā āvo divijā ṛtenā''viṣkṛṇvānā mahimānamāgāt apa druhastama āvarajuṣṭamaṅgirastamā pathyā ajīgaḥ
verses.en: Born in the heavens the Dawn hath flushed, and showing her majesty is come as Law ordaineth. She hath uncovered fiends and hateful darkness; best of Angirases, hath waked the pathways.

verses.sa:
महे नो अद्य सुविताय बोध्युषो महे सौभगाय प्र यन्धि ।
चित्रं रयिं यशसं धेह्यस्मे देवि मर्तेषु मानुषि श्रवस्युम्॥
verses.tr: mahe no adya suvitāya bodhyuṣo mahe saubhagāya pra yandhi citraṃ rayiṃ yaśasaṃ dhehyasme devi marteṣu mānuṣi śravasyum
verses.en: Rouse us this day to high and happy fortune: to great felicity, O Dawn, promote us. Vouchsafe us manifold and splendid riches, famed among mortals, man-befriending Goddess!

verses.sa:
एते त्ये भानवो दर्शतायाश्चित्रा उषसो अमृतास आगुः ।
जनयन्तो दैव्यानि व्रतान्यापृणन्तो अन्तरिक्षा व्यस्थुः॥
verses.tr: ete tye bhānavo darśatāyāścitrā uṣaso amṛtāsa āguḥ janayanto daivyāni vratānyāpṛṇanto antarikṣā vyasthuḥ
verses.en: See, lovely Morning's everlasting splendours, bright with their varied colours, have approached us. Filling the region of mid-air, producing the rites of holy worship, they have mounted.

verses.sa:
एषा स्या युजाना पराकात्पञ्च क्षितीः परि सद्यो जिगाति ।
अभिपश्यन्ती वयुना जनानां दिवो दुहिता भुवनस्य पत्नी॥
verses.tr: eṣā syā yujānā parākātpañca kṣitīḥ pari sadyo jigāti abhipaśyantī vayunā janānāṃ divo duhitā bhuvanasya patnī
verses.en: She yokes her chariot far away, and swiftly visits the lands where the Five Tribes are settled, Looking upon the works and ways of mortals, Daughter of Heaven, the world's Imperial Lady.

verses.sa:
वाजिनीवती सूर्यस्य योषा चित्रामघा राय ईशे वसूनाम् ।
ऋषिष्टुता जरयन्ती मघोन्युषा उच्छति वह्निभिर्गृणाना॥
verses.tr: vājinīvatī sūryasya yoṣā citrāmaghā rāya īśe vasūnām ṛṣiṣṭutā jarayantī maghonyuṣā ucchati vahnibhirgṛṇānā
verses.en: She who is rich in spoil, the Spouse of Surya, wondrously opulent, rules all wealth and treasures. Consumer of our youth, the seers extol her: lauded by priests rich Dawn shines out refulgent.

verses.sa:
प्रति द्युतानामरुषासो अश्वाश्चित्रा अदृश्रन्नुषसं वहन्तः ।
याति शुभ्रा विश्वपिशा रथेन दधाति रत्नं विधते जनाय॥
verses.tr: prati dyutānāmaruṣāso aśvāścitrā adṛśrannuṣasaṃ vahantaḥ yāti śubhrā viśvapiśā rathena dadhāti ratnaṃ vidhate janāya
verses.en: Apparent are the steeds of varied colour, the red steeds carrying resplendent Morning. On her all-lovely car she comes, the Fair One, and brings rich treasure for her faithful servant.

verses.sa:
सत्या सत्येभिर्महती महद्भिर्देवी देवेभिर्यजता यजत्रैः ।
रुजद्दृळ्हानि दददुस्रियाणां प्रति गाव उषसं वावशन्त॥
verses.tr: satyā satyebhirmahatī mahadbhirdevī devebhiryajatā yajatraiḥ rujaddṛḻhāni dadadusriyāṇāṃ prati gāva uṣasaṃ vāvaśanta
verses.en: True with the True and Mighty with the Mighty, with Gods a Goddess, Holy with the Holy, She brake strong fences down and gave the cattle: the kine were lowing as they greeted Morning.

verses.sa:
नू नो गोमद्वीरवद्धेहि रत्नमुषो अश्वावत्पुरुभोजो अस्मे ।
मा नो बर्हिः पुरुषता निदे कर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: nū no gomadvīravaddhehi ratnamuṣo aśvāvatpurubhojo asme mā no barhiḥ puruṣatā nide karyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: O Dawn, now give us wealth in kine and heroes, and horses, fraught with manifold enjoyment. Protect our sacred grass from man's reproaches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उदु ज्योतिरमृतं विश्वजन्यं विश्वानरः सविता देवो अश्रेत् ।
क्रत्वा देवानामजनिष्ट चक्षुराविरकर्भुवनं विश्वमुषाः॥
verses.tr: udu jyotiramṛtaṃ viśvajanyaṃ viśvānaraḥ savitā devo aśret kratvā devānāmajaniṣṭa cakṣurāvirakarbhuvanaṃ viśvamuṣāḥ
verses.en: Savitar God of all men hath sent upward his light, designed for all mankind, immortal. Through the Gods' power that Eye was first created. Dawn hath made all the universe apparent.

verses.sa:
प्र मे पन्था देवयाना अदृश्रन्नमर्धन्तो वसुभिरिष्कृतासः ।
अभूदु केतुरुषसः पुरस्तात्प्रतीच्यागादधि हर्म्येभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pra me panthā devayānā adṛśrannamardhanto vasubhiriṣkṛtāsaḥ abhūdu keturuṣasaḥ purastātpratīcyāgādadhi harmyebhyaḥ
verses.en: I see the paths which Gods are wont to travel, innocuous paths made ready by the Vasus. Eastward the flag of Dawn hath been uplifted; she hath come hither o'er the tops of houses.

verses.sa:
तानीदहानि बहुलान्यासन्या प्राचीनमुदिता सूर्यस्य ।
यतः परि जार इवाचरन्त्युषो ददृक्षे न पुनर्यतीव॥
verses.tr: tānīdahāni bahulānyāsanyā prācīnamuditā sūryasya yataḥ pari jāra ivācarantyuṣo dadṛkṣe na punaryatīva
verses.en: Great is, in truth, the number of the Mornings which were aforetime at the Sun's uprising. Since thou, O Dawn, hast been beheld repairing as to thy love, as one no more to leave him.

verses.sa:
त इद्देवानां सधमाद आसन्नृतावानः कवयः पूर्व्यासः ।
गूळ्हं ज्योतिः पितरो अन्वविन्दन्त्सत्यमन्त्रा अजनयन्नुषासम्॥
verses.tr: ta iddevānāṃ sadhamāda āsannṛtāvānaḥ kavayaḥ pūrvyāsaḥ gūḻhaṃ jyotiḥ pitaro anvavindantsatyamantrā ajanayannuṣāsam
verses.en: They were the Gods' companions at the banquet, the ancient sages true to Law Eternal. The Fathers found the light that lay in darkness, and with effectual words begat the Morning.

verses.sa:
समान ऊर्वे अधि संगतासः सं जानते न यतन्ते मिथस्ते ।
ते देवानां न मिनन्ति व्रतान्यमर्धन्तो वसुभिर्यादमानाः॥
verses.tr: samāna ūrve adhi saṃgatāsaḥ saṃ jānate na yatante mithaste te devānāṃ na minanti vratānyamardhanto vasubhiryādamānāḥ
verses.en: Meeting together in the same enclosure, they strive not, of one mind, one with another. They never break the Gods' eternal statutes, and injure none, in rivalry with Vasus.

verses.sa:
प्रति त्वा स्तोमैरीळते वसिष्ठा उषर्बुधः सुभगे तुष्टुवांसः ।
गवां नेत्री वाजपत्नी न उच्छोषः सुजाते प्रथमा जरस्व॥
verses.tr: prati tvā stomairīḻate vasiṣṭhā uṣarbudhaḥ subhage tuṣṭuvāṃsaḥ gavāṃ netrī vājapatnī na ucchoṣaḥ sujāte prathamā jarasva
verses.en: Extolling thee, Blest Goddess, the Vasisthas, awake at early mom, with lauds implore thee. Leader of kine and Queen of all that strengthens, shine, come as first to us, O high-born Morning.

verses.sa:
एषा नेत्री राधसः सूनृतानामुषा उच्छन्ती रिभ्यते वसिष्ठैः ।
दीर्घश्रुतं रयिमस्मे दधाना यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: eṣā netrī rādhasaḥ sūnṛtānāmuṣā ucchantī ribhyate vasiṣṭhaiḥ dīrghaśrutaṃ rayimasme dadhānā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: She bringeth bounty and sweet charm of voices. The flushing Dawn is sung by the Vasisthas, Giving us riches famed to distant places. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
उपो रुरुचे युवतिर्न योषा विश्वं जीवं प्रसुवन्ती चरायै ।
अभूदग्निः समिधे मानुषाणामकर्ज्योतिर्बाधमाना तमांसि॥
verses.tr: upo ruruce yuvatirna yoṣā viśvaṃ jīvaṃ prasuvantī carāyai abhūdagniḥ samidhe mānuṣāṇāmakarjyotirbādhamānā tamāṃsi
verses.en: She hath shone brightly like a youthful woman, stirring to motion every living creature. Agni hath come to feed on mortal? fuel. She hath made light and chased away the darkness.

verses.sa:
विश्वं प्रतीची सप्रथा उदस्थाद्रुशद्वासो बिभ्रती शुक्रमश्वैत् ।
हिरण्यवर्णा सुदृशीकसंदृग्गवां माता नेत्र्यह्नामरोचि॥
verses.tr: viśvaṃ pratīcī saprathā udasthādruśadvāso bibhratī śukramaśvait hiraṇyavarṇā sudṛśīkasaṃdṛggavāṃ mātā netryahnāmaroci
verses.en: Turned to this All, far-spreading, she hath risen and shone in brightness with white robes about her. She hath beamed forth lovely with golden colours, Mother of kine, Guide of the days she bringeth.

verses.sa:
देवानां चक्षुः सुभगा वहन्ती श्वेतं नयन्ती सुदृशीकमश्वम् ।
उषा अदर्शि रश्मिभिर्व्यक्ता चित्रामघा विश्वमनु प्रभूता॥
verses.tr: devānāṃ cakṣuḥ subhagā vahantī śvetaṃ nayantī sudṛśīkamaśvam uṣā adarśi raśmibhirvyaktā citrāmaghā viśvamanu prabhūtā
verses.en: Bearing the Gods' own Eye, auspicious Lady, leading her Courser white and fair to look on, Distinguished by her bean-is Dawn shines apparent, come forth to all the world with wondrous treasure.

verses.sa:
अन्तिवामा दूरे अमित्रमुच्छोर्वीं गव्यूतिमभयं कृधी नः ।
यावय द्वेष आ भरा वसूनि चोदय राधो गृणते मघोनि॥
verses.tr: antivāmā dūre amitramucchorvīṃ gavyūtimabhayaṃ kṛdhī naḥ yāvaya dveṣa ā bharā vasūni codaya rādho gṛṇate maghoni
verses.en: Draw nigh with wealth and dawn away the foeman: prepare for us wide pasture free from danger. Drive away those who hate us, bring us riches: pour bounty, opulent Lady, on the singer.

verses.sa:
अस्मे श्रेष्ठेभिर्भानुभिर्वि भाह्युषो देवि प्रतिरन्ती न आयुः ।
इषं च नो दधती विश्ववारे गोमदश्वावद्रथवच्च राधः॥
verses.tr: asme śreṣṭhebhirbhānubhirvi bhāhyuṣo devi pratirantī na āyuḥ iṣaṃ ca no dadhatī viśvavāre gomadaśvāvadrathavacca rādhaḥ
verses.en: Send thy most excellent beams to shine and light us, giving us lengthened days, O Dawn, O Goddess, Granting us food, thou who hast all things precious, and bounty rich in chariots, kine, and horses.

verses.sa:
यां त्वा दिवो दुहितर्वर्धयन्त्युषः सुजाते मतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।
सास्मासु धा रयिमृष्वं बृहन्तं यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: yāṃ tvā divo duhitarvardhayantyuṣaḥ sujāte matibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ sāsmāsu dhā rayimṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: O Usas, nobly-born, Daughter of Heaven, whom the Vasisthas with their hymns make mighty, Bestow thou on us vast and glorious riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रति केतवः प्रथमा अदृश्रन्नूर्ध्वा अस्या अञ्जयो वि श्रयन्ते ।
उषो अर्वाचा बृहता रथेन ज्योतिष्मता वाममस्मभ्यं वक्षि॥
verses.tr: prati ketavaḥ prathamā adṛśrannūrdhvā asyā añjayo vi śrayante uṣo arvācā bṛhatā rathena jyotiṣmatā vāmamasmabhyaṃ vakṣi
verses.en: We have beheld her earliest lights approaching: her many glories part, on high, asunder. On car sublime, refulgent, wending hither, O Usas, bring the Wealth that makes us happy.

verses.sa:
प्रति षीमग्निर्जरते समिद्धः प्रति विप्रासो मतिभिर्गृणन्तः ।
उषा याति ज्योतिषा बाधमाना विश्वा तमांसि दुरिताप देवी॥
verses.tr: prati ṣīmagnirjarate samiddhaḥ prati viprāso matibhirgṛṇantaḥ uṣā yāti jyotiṣā bādhamānā viśvā tamāṃsi duritāpa devī
verses.en: The fire well-kindIed sings aloud to greet her, and with their hymns the priests are chaming welcome. Usas approaches in her splendour, driving all evil darkness far away, the Goddess.

verses.sa:
एता उ त्याः प्रत्यदृश्रन्पुरस्ताज्ज्योतिर्यच्छन्तीरुषसो विभातीः ।
अजीजनन्त्सूर्यं यज्ञमग्निमपाचीनं तमो अगादजुष्टम्॥
verses.tr: etā u tyāḥ pratyadṛśranpurastājjyotiryacchantīruṣaso vibhātīḥ ajījanantsūryaṃ yajñamagnimapācīnaṃ tamo agādajuṣṭam
verses.en: Apparent eastward are those lights of Morning, sending out lustre, as they rise, around them. She hath brought forth Sun, sacrifice, and Agni, and far away hath fled detested darkness.

verses.sa:
अचेति दिवो दुहिता मघोनी विश्वे पश्यन्त्युषसं विभातीम् ।
आस्थाद्रथं स्वधया युज्यमानमा यमश्वासः सुयुजो वहन्ति॥
verses.tr: aceti divo duhitā maghonī viśve paśyantyuṣasaṃ vibhātīm āsthādrathaṃ svadhayā yujyamānamā yamaśvāsaḥ suyujo vahanti
verses.en: Rich Daughter of the Sky, we all behold her, yea, all men look on Dawn as she is breaking. Her car that moves self-harnessed hath she mounted, the car drawn onward by her well-yoked horses.

verses.sa:
प्रति त्वाद्य सुमनसो बुधन्ताऽस्माकासो मघवानो वयं च ।
तिल्विलायध्वमुषसो विभातीर्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: prati tvādya sumanaso budhantā'smākāso maghavāno vayaṃ ca tilvilāyadhvamuṣaso vibhātīryūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Inspired with loving thoughts this day to greet thee, we and our wealthy nobles have awakened. Show yourselves fruitful, Dawns, as ye are rising. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
व्यु१षा आवः पथ्या३ जनानां पञ्च क्षितीर्मानुषीर्बोधयन्ती ।
सुसंदृग्भिरुक्षभिर्भानुमश्रेद्वि सूर्यो रोदसी चक्षसावः॥
verses.tr: vyu1ṣā āvaḥ pathyā3 janānāṃ pañca kṣitīrmānuṣīrbodhayantī susaṃdṛgbhirukṣabhirbhānumaśredvi sūryo rodasī cakṣasāvaḥ
verses.en: Rousing the lands where men's Five Tribes are settled, Dawn hath disclosed the pathways of the people. She hath sent out her sheen with beauteous oxen. The Sun with light hath opened earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
व्यञ्जते दिवो अन्तेष्वक्तून्विशो न युक्ता उषसो यतन्ते ।
सं ते गावस्तम आ वर्तयन्ति ज्योतिर्यच्छन्ति सवितेव बाहू॥
verses.tr: vyañjate divo anteṣvaktūnviśo na yuktā uṣaso yatante saṃ te gāvastama ā vartayanti jyotiryacchanti saviteva bāhū
verses.en: They paint their bright rays on the sky's far limits. the Dawns come on like tribes arrayed for battle. Thy cattle, closely shutting up the darkness, as Savitar spreads his arms, give forth their lustre.

verses.sa:
अभूदुषा इन्द्रतमा मघोन्यजीजनत्सुविताय श्रवांसि ।
वि दिवो देवी दुहिता दधात्यङ्गिरस्तमा सुकृते वसूनि॥
verses.tr: abhūduṣā indratamā maghonyajījanatsuvitāya śravāṃsi vi divo devī duhitā dadhātyaṅgirastamā sukṛte vasūni
verses.en: Wealthy, most like to Indra, Dawn hath risen, and brought forth lauds that shall promote our welfare. Daughter of Heaven, a Goddess, she distributes, best of Angirases, treasures to the pious.

verses.sa:
तावदुषो राधो अस्मभ्यं रास्व यावत्स्तोतृभ्यो अरदो गृणाना ।
यां त्वा जज्ञुर्वृषभस्या रवेण वि दृळ्हस्य दुरो अद्रेरौर्णोः॥
verses.tr: tāvaduṣo rādho asmabhyaṃ rāsva yāvatstotṛbhyo arado gṛṇānā yāṃ tvā jajñurvṛṣabhasyā raveṇa vi dṛḻhasya duro adreraurṇoḥ
verses.en: Bestow on us, O Dawn, that ample bounty which thou didst send to those who sang thy praises; Thou whom with bellowings of a bull they quickened: thou didst unbar the firm-set mountain's portals.

verses.sa:
देवंदेवं राधसे चोदयन्त्यस्मद्र्यक्सूनृता ईरयन्ती ।
व्युच्छन्ती नः सनये धियो धा यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: devaṃdevaṃ rādhase codayantyasmadryaksūnṛtā īrayantī vyucchantī naḥ sanaye dhiyo dhā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Impelling every God to grant his bounty sending to us the charm of pleasant voices, Vouchsafe us thoughts, for profit, as thou breakest. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्तोमेभिरुषसं वसिष्ठा गीर्भिर्विप्रासः प्रथमा अबुध्रन् ।
विवर्तयन्तीं रजसी समन्ते आविष्कृण्वतीं भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: prati stomebhiruṣasaṃ vasiṣṭhā gīrbhirviprāsaḥ prathamā abudhran vivartayantīṃ rajasī samante āviṣkṛṇvatīṃ bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: The priests, Vasisthas, are the first awakened to welcome Usas with their songs and praises, Who makes surrounding regions part asunder, and shows apparent all existing creatures.

verses.sa:
एषा स्या नव्यमायुर्दधाना गूढ्वी तमो ज्योतिषोषा अबोधि ।
अग्र एति युवतिरह्रयाणा प्राचिकितत्सूर्यं यज्ञमग्निम्॥
verses.tr: eṣā syā navyamāyurdadhānā gūḍhvī tamo jyotiṣoṣā abodhi agra eti yuvatirahrayāṇā prācikitatsūryaṃ yajñamagnim
verses.en: Giving fresh life when she hath hid the darkness, this Dawn hath wakened there with new-born lustre. Youthful and unrestrained she cometh forward: she hath turned thoughts to Sun and fire and worship.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीर्गोमतीर्न उषासो वीरवतीः सदमुच्छन्तु भद्राः ।
घृतं दुहाना विश्वतः प्रपीता यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May blessed Mornings shine on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यु अदर्श्यायत्यु१च्छन्ती दुहिता दिवः ।
अपो महि व्ययति चक्षसे तमो ज्योतिष्कृणोति सूनरी॥
verses.tr: pratyu adarśyāyatyu1cchantī duhitā divaḥ apo mahi vyayati cakṣase tamo jyotiṣkṛṇoti sūnarī
verses.en: Advancing, sending forth her rays, the Daughter of the Sky is seen. Uncovering, that we may see, the mighty gloom, the friendly Lady makes the light.

verses.sa:
उदुस्रियाः सृजते सूर्यः सचाँ उद्यन्नक्षत्रमर्चिवत् ।
तवेदुषो व्युषि सूर्यस्य च सं भक्तेन गमेमहि॥
verses.tr: udusriyāḥ sṛjate sūryaḥ sacāṃ udyannakṣatramarcivat taveduṣo vyuṣi sūryasya ca saṃ bhaktena gamemahi
verses.en: The Sun ascending, the refulgent Star, pours down his beams together with the Dawn. O Dawn, at thine arising, and the Sun's, may we attain the share allotted us.

verses.sa:
प्रति त्वा दुहितर्दिव उषो जीरा अभुत्स्महि ।
या वहसि पुरु स्पार्हं वनन्वति रत्नं न दाशुषे मयः॥
verses.tr: prati tvā duhitardiva uṣo jīrā abhutsmahi yā vahasi puru spārhaṃ vananvati ratnaṃ na dāśuṣe mayaḥ
verses.en: Promptly we woke to welcome thee, O Usas, Daughter of the Sky, Thee, Bounteous One, who bringest all we long to have, and to the offerer health and wealth.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्ती या कृणोषि मंहना महि प्रख्यै देवि स्वर्दृशे ।
तस्यास्ते रत्नभाज ईमहे वयं स्याम मातुर्न सूनवः॥
verses.tr: ucchantī yā kṛṇoṣi maṃhanā mahi prakhyai devi svardṛśe tasyāste ratnabhāja īmahe vayaṃ syāma māturna sūnavaḥ
verses.en: Thou, dawning, workest fain to light the great world, yea, heaven, Goddess! that it may be seen. We yearn to be thine own, Dealer of Wealth: may we be to this Mother like her sons.

verses.sa:
तच्चित्रं राध आ भरोषो यद्दीर्घश्रुत्तमम् ।
यत्ते दिवो दुहितर्मर्तभोजनं तद्रास्व भुनजामहै॥
verses.tr: taccitraṃ rādha ā bharoṣo yaddīrghaśruttamam yatte divo duhitarmartabhojanaṃ tadrāsva bhunajāmahai
verses.en: Bring us that wondrous bounty, Dawn, that shall be famed most far away. What, Child of Heaven, thou hast of nourishment for man, bestow thou on us to enjoy.

verses.sa:
श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनं वाजाँ अस्मभ्यं गोमतः ।
चोदयित्री मघोनः सूनृतावत्युषा उच्छदप स्रिधः॥
verses.tr: śravaḥ sūribhyo amṛtaṃ vasutvanaṃ vājāṃ asmabhyaṃ gomataḥ codayitrī maghonaḥ sūnṛtāvatyuṣā ucchadapa sridhaḥ
verses.en: Give to our princes opulence and immortal fame, and strength in herds of kine to us. May she who prompts the wealthy, Lady of sweet strains, may Usas dawn our foes away.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा युवमध्वराय नो विशे जनाय महि शर्म यच्छतम् ।
दीर्घप्रयज्युमति यो वनुष्यति वयं जयेम पृतनासु दूढ्यः॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā yuvamadhvarāya no viśe janāya mahi śarma yacchatam dīrghaprayajyumati yo vanuṣyati vayaṃ jayema pṛtanāsu dūḍhyaḥ
verses.en: Grant us your strong protection, Indra-Varuna, our people, and our family, for sacrifice. May we subdue in fight our evil-hearted foes, him who attacks the man steadfast in lengthened rites.

verses.sa:
सम्राळन्यः स्वराळन्य उच्यते वां महान्ताविन्द्रावरुणा महावसू ।
विश्वे देवासः परमे व्योमनि सं वामोजो वृषणा सं बलं दधुः॥
verses.tr: samrāḻanyaḥ svarāḻanya ucyate vāṃ mahāntāvindrāvaruṇā mahāvasū viśve devāsaḥ parame vyomani saṃ vāmojo vṛṣaṇā saṃ balaṃ dadhuḥ
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, mighty and very rich One of you is called Monarch and One Autocrat. All Gods in the most lofty region of the air have, O ye Steers, combined all power and might in you.

verses.sa:
अन्वपां खान्यतृन्तमोजसा सूर्यमैरयतं दिवि प्रभुम् ।
इन्द्रावरुणा मदे अस्य मायिनोऽपिन्वतमपितः पिन्वतं धियः॥
verses.tr: anvapāṃ khānyatṛntamojasā sūryamairayataṃ divi prabhum indrāvaruṇā made asya māyino'pinvatamapitaḥ pinvataṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Ye with your strength have pierced the fountains of the floods: the Sun have ye brought forward as the Lord in heaven. Cheered by this magic draught ye, Indra-Varuna, made the dry places stream, made songs of praise flow forth.

verses.sa:
युवामिद्युत्सु पृतनासु वह्नयो युवां क्षेमस्य प्रसवे मितज्ञवः ।
ईशाना वस्व उभयस्य कारव इन्द्रावरुणा सुहवा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: yuvāmidyutsu pṛtanāsu vahnayo yuvāṃ kṣemasya prasave mitajñavaḥ īśānā vasva ubhayasya kārava indrāvaruṇā suhavā havāmahe
verses.en: In battels and in frays we ministering priests, kneeling upon our knees for furtherance of our weal, Invoke you, only you, the Lords of twofold wealth, you prompt to hear, we bards, O Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा यदिमानि चक्रथुर्विश्वा जातानि भुवनस्य मज्मना ।
क्षेमेण मित्रो वरुणं दुवस्यति मरुद्भिरुग्रः शुभमन्य ईयते॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā yadimāni cakrathurviśvā jātāni bhuvanasya majmanā kṣemeṇa mitro varuṇaṃ duvasyati marudbhirugraḥ śubhamanya īyate
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, as ye created all these creatures of the world by your surpassing might, In peace and quiet Mitra waits on Varuna, the Other, awful, with the Maruis seeks renown.

verses.sa:
महे शुल्काय वरुणस्य नु त्विष ओजो मिमाते ध्रुवमस्य यत्स्वम् ।
अजामिमन्यः श्नथयन्तमातिरद्दभ्रेभिरन्यः प्र वृणोति भूयसः॥
verses.tr: mahe śulkāya varuṇasya nu tviṣa ojo mimāte dhruvamasya yatsvam ajāmimanyaḥ śnathayantamātiraddabhrebhiranyaḥ pra vṛṇoti bhūyasaḥ
verses.en: That Varuna's high worth may shine preeminent, these Twain have measured each his proper power and might. The One subdueth the destructive enemy; the Other with a few furthereth many a man.

verses.sa:
न तमंहो न दुरितानि मर्त्यमिन्द्रावरुणा न तपः कुतश्चन ।
यस्य देवा गच्छथो वीथो अध्वरं न तं मर्तस्य नशते परिह्वृतिः॥
verses.tr: na tamaṃho na duritāni martyamindrāvaruṇā na tapaḥ kutaścana yasya devā gacchatho vītho adhvaraṃ na taṃ martasya naśate parihvṛtiḥ
verses.en: No trouble, no misfortune, Indra-Varuna, no woe from any side assails the mortal man Whose sacrifice, O Gods, ye visit and enjoy: ne'er doth the crafty guile of mortal injure him.

verses.sa:
अर्वाङ्नरा दैव्येनावसा गतं शृणुतं हवं यदि मे जुजोषथः ।
युवोर्हि सख्यमुत वा यदाप्यं मार्डीकमिन्द्रावरुणा नि यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: arvāṅnarā daivyenāvasā gataṃ śṛṇutaṃ havaṃ yadi me jujoṣathaḥ yuvorhi sakhyamuta vā yadāpyaṃ mārḍīkamindrāvaruṇā ni yacchatam
verses.en: With your divine protection, Heroes, come to us: mine invocation hear, if ye be pleased therewith. Bestow ye upon us, O Indra-Varuna, your friendship and your kinship and your favouring grace.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमिन्द्रावरुणा भरेभरे पुरोयोधा भवतं कृष्ट्योजसा ।
यद्वां हवन्त उभये अध स्पृधि नरस्तोकस्य तनयस्य सातिषु॥
verses.tr: asmākamindrāvaruṇā bharebhare puroyodhā bhavataṃ kṛṣṭyojasā yadvāṃ havanta ubhaye adha spṛdhi narastokasya tanayasya sātiṣu
verses.en: In battle after battle, Indra-Varuna, be ye our Champions, ye who are the peoples' strength, When both opposing bands invoke you for the fight, and men that they may gain offspring and progeny.

verses.sa:
अस्मे इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा द्युम्नं यच्छन्तु महि शर्म सप्रथः ।
अवध्रं ज्योतिरदितेॠतावृधो देवस्य श्लोकं सवितुर्मनामहे॥
verses.tr: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ avadhraṃ jyotiraditeṝtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe
verses.en: May Indra, Varuna, Mitra, and Aryaman vouchsafe us glory and great shelter spreading far. We think of the beneficent light of Aditi, and Savitar's song of praise, the God who strengthens Law.

verses.sa:
युवां नरा पश्यमानास आप्यं प्राचा गव्यन्तः पृथुपर्शवो ययुः ।
दासा च वृत्रा हतमार्याणि च सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणावसावतम्॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ narā paśyamānāsa āpyaṃ prācā gavyantaḥ pṛthuparśavo yayuḥ dāsā ca vṛtrā hatamāryāṇi ca sudāsamindrāvaruṇāvasāvatam
verses.en: Looking to you and your alliance, O ye Men, armed with broad axes they went forward, fain for spoil. Ye smote and slew his Dasa and his Aryan enemies, and helped Sudas with favour, Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
यत्रा नरः समयन्ते कृतध्वजो यस्मिन्नाजा भवति किं चन प्रियम् ।
यत्रा भयन्ते भुवना स्वर्दृशस्तत्रा न इन्द्रावरुणाधि वोचतम्॥
verses.tr: yatrā naraḥ samayante kṛtadhvajo yasminnājā bhavati kiṃ cana priyam yatrā bhayante bhuvanā svardṛśastatrā na indrāvaruṇādhi vocatam
verses.en: Where heroes come together with their banners raised, in the encounter where is naught for us to love, Where all things that behold the light are terrified, there did ye comfort us, O Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
सं भूम्या अन्ता ध्वसिरा अदृक्षतेन्द्रावरुणा दिवि घोष
आरुहत् । अस्थुर्जनानामुप मामरातयोऽर्वागवसा हवनश्रुता गतम्॥
verses.tr: saṃ bhūmyā antā dhvasirā adṛkṣatendrāvaruṇā divi ghoṣa āruhat asthurjanānāmupa māmarātayo'rvāgavasā havanaśrutā gatam
verses.en: The boundaries of earth were seen all dark with dust: O Indra-Varuna, the shout went up to heaven. The enmities of the people compassed me about. Ye heard my calling and ye came to me with help.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा वधनाभिरप्रति भेदं वन्वन्ता प्र सुदासमावतम् ।
ब्रह्माण्येषां शृणुतं हवीमनि सत्या तृत्सूनामभवत्पुरोहितिः॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇā vadhanābhiraprati bhedaṃ vanvantā pra sudāsamāvatam brahmāṇyeṣāṃ śṛṇutaṃ havīmani satyā tṛtsūnāmabhavatpurohitiḥ
verses.en: With your resistless weapons, Indra-Varuna, ye conquered Bheda and ye gave Sudas your aid. Ye heard the prayers of these amid the cries of war: effectual was the service of the Trtsus' priest.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणावभ्या तपन्ति माघान्यर्यो वनुषामरातयः ।
युवं हि वस्व उभयस्य राजथोऽध स्मा नोऽवतं पार्ये दिवि॥
verses.tr: indrāvaruṇāvabhyā tapanti māghānyaryo vanuṣāmarātayaḥ yuvaṃ hi vasva ubhayasya rājatho'dha smā no'vataṃ pārye divi
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, the wickedness of foes and mine assailants' hatred sorely trouble me. Ye Twain are Lords of riches both of earth and heaven: so grant to us your aid on the decisive day.

verses.sa:
युवां हवन्त उभयास आजिष्विन्द्रं च वस्वो वरुणं च सातये ।
यत्र राजभिर्दशभिर्निबाधितं प्र सुदासमावतं तृत्सुभिः सह॥
verses.tr: yuvāṃ havanta ubhayāsa ājiṣvindraṃ ca vasvo varuṇaṃ ca sātaye yatra rājabhirdaśabhirnibādhitaṃ pra sudāsamāvataṃ tṛtsubhiḥ saha
verses.en: The men of both the hosts invoked you in the fight, Indra and Varuna, that they might win the wealth, What time ye helped Sudas, with all the Trtsu folk, when the Ten Kings had pressed him down in their attack.

verses.sa:
दश राजानः समिता अयज्यवः सुदासमिन्द्रावरुणा न युयुधुः ।
सत्या नृणामद्मसदामुपस्तुतिर्देवा एषामभवन्देवहूतिषु॥
verses.tr: daśa rājānaḥ samitā ayajyavaḥ sudāsamindrāvaruṇā na yuyudhuḥ satyā nṛṇāmadmasadāmupastutirdevā eṣāmabhavandevahūtiṣu
verses.en: Ten Kings who worshipped not, O Indra-Varuna, confederate, in war prevailed not o'er Sudas. True was the boast of heroes sitting at the feast: so at their invocations Gods were on their side.

verses.sa:
दाशराज्ञे परियत्ताय विश्वतः सुदास इन्द्रावरुणावशिक्षतम् ।
श्वित्यञ्चो यत्र नमसा कपर्दिनो धिया धीवन्तो असपन्त तृत्सवः॥
verses.tr: dāśarājñe pariyattāya viśvataḥ sudāsa indrāvaruṇāvaśikṣatam śvityañco yatra namasā kapardino dhiyā dhīvanto asapanta tṛtsavaḥ
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, ye gave Sudas your aid when the Ten Kings in battle compassed him about, There where the white-robed Trtsus with their braided hair, skilled in song worshipped you with homage and with hymn.

verses.sa:
वृत्राण्यन्यः समिथेषु जिघ्नते व्रतान्यन्यो अभि रक्षते सदा ।
हवामहे वां वृषणा सुवृक्तिभिरस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा शर्म यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: vṛtrāṇyanyaḥ samitheṣu jighnate vratānyanyo abhi rakṣate sadā havāmahe vāṃ vṛṣaṇā suvṛktibhirasme indrāvaruṇā śarma yacchatam
verses.en: One of you Twain destroys the Vrtras in the fight, the Other evermore maintains his holy Laws. We call on you, ye Mighty, with our hymns of praise. Vouchsafe us your protection, Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
अस्मे इन्द्रो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा द्युम्नं यच्छन्तु महि शर्म सप्रथः ।
अवध्रं ज्योतिरदितेॠतावृधो देवस्य श्लोकं सवितुर्मनामहे॥
verses.tr: asme indro varuṇo mitro aryamā dyumnaṃ yacchantu mahi śarma saprathaḥ avadhraṃ jyotiraditeṝtāvṛdho devasya ślokaṃ saviturmanāmahe
verses.en: May Indra, Varuna, Mitra, and Aryaman vouchsafe us glory and great shelter spreading far. We think of the beneficent light of Aditi, and Savitar's song of praise, the God who strengthens Law.

verses.sa:
आ वां राजानावध्वरे ववृत्यां हव्येभिरिन्द्रावरुणा नमोभिः ।
प्र वां घृताची बाह्वोर्दधाना परि त्मना विषुरूपा जिगाति॥
verses.tr: ā vāṃ rājānāvadhvare vavṛtyāṃ havyebhirindrāvaruṇā namobhiḥ pra vāṃ ghṛtācī bāhvordadhānā pari tmanā viṣurūpā jigāti
verses.en: Kings, Indra-Varuna, I would turn you hither to this our sacrifice with gifts and homage. Held in both arms the ladle, dropping fatness, goes of itself to you whose forms are varied.

verses.sa:
युवो राष्ट्रं बृहदिन्वति द्यौर्यौ सेतृभिररज्जुभिः सिनीथः ।
परि नो हेळो वरुणस्य वृज्या उरुं न इन्द्रः कृणवदु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: yuvo rāṣṭraṃ bṛhadinvati dyauryau setṛbhirarajjubhiḥ sinīthaḥ pari no heḻo varuṇasya vṛjyā uruṃ na indraḥ kṛṇavadu lokam
verses.en: Dyaus quickens and promotes your high dominion who bind with bonds not wrought of rope or cordage. Far from us still be Varuna's displeasure may Indra give us spacious room to dwell in.

verses.sa:
कृतं नो यज्ञं विदथेषु चारुं कृतं ब्रह्माणि सूरिषु प्रशस्ता ।
उपो रयिर्देवजूतो न एतु प्र णः स्पार्हाभिरूतिभिस्तिरेतम्॥
verses.tr: kṛtaṃ no yajñaṃ vidatheṣu cāruṃ kṛtaṃ brahmāṇi sūriṣu praśastā upo rayirdevajūto na etu pra ṇaḥ spārhābhirūtibhistiretam
verses.en: Make ye our sacrifice fair amid the assemblies: make ye our prayers approved among our princes. May God-sent riches come for our possession: further ye us with your delightful succours.

verses.sa:
अस्मे इन्द्रावरुणा विश्ववारं रयिं धत्तं वसुमन्तं पुरुक्षुम् ।
प्र य आदित्यो अनृता मिनात्यमिता शूरो दयते वसूनि॥
verses.tr: asme indrāvaruṇā viśvavāraṃ rayiṃ dhattaṃ vasumantaṃ purukṣum pra ya ādityo anṛtā minātyamitā śūro dayate vasūni
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, vouchsafe us riches with store of treasure, food, and every blessing; For the Aditya, banisher of falsehood, the Hero, dealeth wealth in boundless plenty.

verses.sa:
इयमिन्द्रं वरुणमष्ट मे गीः प्रावत्तोके तनये तूतुजाना ।
सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May this my song reach Varuna and Indra, and, strongly urging, win me sons and offspring. To the Gods' banquet may we go with riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
पुनीषे वामरक्षसं मनीषां सोममिन्द्राय वरुणाय जुह्वत् ।
घृतप्रतीकामुषसं न देवीं ता नो यामन्नुरुष्यतामभीके॥
verses.tr: punīṣe vāmarakṣasaṃ manīṣāṃ somamindrāya varuṇāya juhvat ghṛtapratīkāmuṣasaṃ na devīṃ tā no yāmannuruṣyatāmabhīke
verses.en: For you I deck a harmless hymn, presenting the Soma juice to Varuna and Indra- A hymn that shines like heavenly Dawn with fatness. May they be near us on the march and guard us.

verses.sa:
स्पर्धन्ते वा उ देवहूये अत्र येषु ध्वजेषु दिद्यवः पतन्ति ।
युवं ताँ इन्द्रावरुणावमित्रान्हतं पराचः शर्वा विषूचः॥
verses.tr: spardhante vā u devahūye atra yeṣu dhvajeṣu didyavaḥ patanti yuvaṃ tāṃ indrāvaruṇāvamitrānhataṃ parācaḥ śarvā viṣūcaḥ
verses.en: Here where the arrows fall amid the banners both hosts invoke the Gods in emulation. O Indra-Varuna, smite back those-our foemen, yea, smite them with your shaft to every quarter.

verses.sa:
आपश्चिद्धि स्वयशसः सदःसु देवीरिन्द्रं वरुणं देवता धुः ।
कृष्टीरन्यो धारयति प्रविक्ता वृत्राण्यन्यो अप्रतीनि हन्ति॥
verses.tr: āpaściddhi svayaśasaḥ sadaḥsu devīrindraṃ varuṇaṃ devatā dhuḥ kṛṣṭīranyo dhārayati praviktā vṛtrāṇyanyo apratīni hanti
verses.en: Self-lucid in their seats, e'en heavenly Waters endowed with Godhead Varuna and Indra. One of these holds the folk distinct and sundered, the Other smites and slays resistless foemen.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतुॠतचिदस्तु होता य आदित्य शवसा वां नमस्वान् ।
आववर्तदवसे वां हविष्मानसदित्स सुविताय प्रयस्वान्॥
verses.tr: sa sukratuṝtacidastu hotā ya āditya śavasā vāṃ namasvān āvavartadavase vāṃ haviṣmānasaditsa suvitāya prayasvān
verses.en: Wise be the priest and skilled in Law Eternal, who with his sacred gifts and oration. Brings you to aid us with your might, Adityas: let him have viands to promote his welfare.

verses.sa:
इयमिन्द्रं वरुणमष्ट मे गीः प्रावत्तोके तनये तूतुजाना ।
सुरत्नासो देववीतिं गमेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: iyamindraṃ varuṇamaṣṭa me gīḥ prāvattoke tanaye tūtujānā suratnāso devavītiṃ gamema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: May this my song reach Varuna and Indra, and, strongly urging, win me sons and offspring. To the Gods' banquet may we go with riches. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods with blessings.

verses.sa:
धीरा त्वस्य महिना जनूंषि वि यस्तस्तम्भ रोदसी चिदुर्वी ।
प्र नाकमृष्वं नुनुदे बृहन्तं द्विता नक्षत्रं पप्रथच्च भूम॥
verses.tr: dhīrā tvasya mahinā janūṃṣi vi yastastambha rodasī cidurvī pra nākamṛṣvaṃ nunude bṛhantaṃ dvitā nakṣatraṃ paprathacca bhūma
verses.en: Wise, verily, are creatures through his greatness who stayed ever, spacious heaven and earth asunder; Who urged the high and mighty sky to motion, the Star of old, and spread the earth before him.

verses.sa:
उत स्वया तन्वा३ सं वदे तत्कदा न्व१न्तर्वरुणे भुवानि ।
किं मे हव्यमहृणानो जुषेत कदा मृळीकं सुमना अभि ख्यम्॥
verses.tr: uta svayā tanvā3 saṃ vade tatkadā nva1ntarvaruṇe bhuvāni kiṃ me havyamahṛṇāno juṣeta kadā mṛḻīkaṃ sumanā abhi khyam
verses.en: With mine own heart I commune on the question how Varuna and I may be united. What gift of mine will he accept unangered? When may I calmly look and find him gracious?

verses.sa:
पृच्छे तदेनो वरुण दिदृक्षूपो एमि चिकितुषो विपृच्छम् ।
समानमिन्मे कवयश्चिदाहुरयं ह तुभ्यं वरुणो हृणीते॥
verses.tr: pṛcche tadeno varuṇa didṛkṣūpo emi cikituṣo vipṛccham samānaminme kavayaścidāhurayaṃ ha tubhyaṃ varuṇo hṛṇīte
verses.en: Fain to know this in I question others: I seek the wise, O Varuna, and ask them. This one same answer even the sages gave me, "Surely this Varuna is angry with thee."

verses.sa:
किमाग आस वरुण ज्येष्ठं यत्स्तोतारं जिघांससि सखायम् ।
प्र तन्मे वोचो दूळभ स्वधावोऽव त्वानेना नमसा तुर इयाम्॥
verses.tr: kimāga āsa varuṇa jyeṣṭhaṃ yatstotāraṃ jighāṃsasi sakhāyam pra tanme voco dūḻabha svadhāvo'va tvānenā namasā tura iyām
verses.en: What, Varuna, hath been my chief transgression, that thou wouldst slay the friend who sings thy praises? Tell me, Unconquerable Lord, and quickly sinless will I approach thee with mine homage.

verses.sa:
अव द्रुग्धानि पित्र्या सृजा नोऽव या वयं चकृमा तनूभिः ।
अव राजन्पशुतृपं न तायुं सृजा वत्सं न दाम्नो वसिष्ठम्॥
verses.tr: ava drugdhāni pitryā sṛjā no'va yā vayaṃ cakṛmā tanūbhiḥ ava rājanpaśutṛpaṃ na tāyuṃ sṛjā vatsaṃ na dāmno vasiṣṭham
verses.en: Free us from sins committed by our fathers, from those wherein we have ourselves offended. O King, loose, like a thief who feeds the cattle, as from the cord a calf, set free Vasistha.

verses.sa:
न स स्वो दक्षो वरुण ध्रुतिः सा सुरा मन्युर्विभीदको अचित्तिः ।
अस्ति ज्यायान्कनीयस उपारे स्वप्नश्चनेदनृतस्य प्रयोता॥
verses.tr: na sa svo dakṣo varuṇa dhrutiḥ sā surā manyurvibhīdako acittiḥ asti jyāyānkanīyasa upāre svapnaścanedanṛtasya prayotā
verses.en: Not our own will betrayed us, but seduction, thoughtlessness, Varuna wine, dice, or anger. The old is near to lead astray the younger: even sleep removeth not all evil-doing.

verses.sa:
अरं दासो न मीळ्हुषे कराण्यहं देवाय भूर्णयेऽनागाः ।
अचेतयदचितो देवो अर्यो गृत्सं राये कवितरो जुनाति॥
verses.tr: araṃ dāso na mīḻhuṣe karāṇyahaṃ devāya bhūrṇaye'nāgāḥ acetayadacito devo aryo gṛtsaṃ rāye kavitaro junāti
verses.en: Slave like may I do service to the Bounteous, serve, free from sin, the God inclined to anger. This gentle Lord gives wisdom to the simple: the wiser God leads on the wise to riches.

verses.sa:
अयं सु तुभ्यं वरुण स्वधावो हृदि स्तोम उपश्रितश्चिदस्तु ।
शं नः क्षेमे शमु योगे नो अस्तु यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ayaṃ su tubhyaṃ varuṇa svadhāvo hṛdi stoma upaśritaścidastu śaṃ naḥ kṣeme śamu yoge no astu yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: O Lord, O Varuna, may this laudation come close to them and lie within thy spirit. May it be well with us in rest and labour. Preserve us ever-more, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
रदत्पथो वरुणः सूर्याय प्रार्णांसि समुद्रिया नदीनाम् ।
सर्गो न सृष्टो अर्वतीॠतायञ्चकार महीरवनीरहभ्यः॥
verses.tr: radatpatho varuṇaḥ sūryāya prārṇāṃsi samudriyā nadīnām sargo na sṛṣṭo arvatīṝtāyañcakāra mahīravanīrahabhyaḥ
verses.en: Varuna cut a pathway out for Surya, and led the watery floods of rivers onward. The Mares, as in a race, speed on in order. He made great channels for the days to follow.

verses.sa:
आत्मा ते वातो रज आ नवीनोत्पशुर्न भूर्णिर्यवसे ससवान् ।
अन्तर्मही बृहती रोदसीमे विश्वा ते धाम वरुण प्रियाणि॥
verses.tr: ātmā te vāto raja ā navīnotpaśurna bhūrṇiryavase sasavān antarmahī bṛhatī rodasīme viśvā te dhāma varuṇa priyāṇi
verses.en: The wind, thy breath, hath sounded through the region like a wild beast that seeks his food in pastures. Within these two, exalted Earth and Heaven, O Varuna, are all the forms thou lovest.

verses.sa:
परि स्पशो वरुणस्य स्मदिष्टा उभे पश्यन्ति रोदसी सुमेके ।
ऋतावानः कवयो यज्ञधीराः प्रचेतसो य इषयन्त मन्म॥
verses.tr: pari spaśo varuṇasya smadiṣṭā ubhe paśyanti rodasī sumeke ṛtāvānaḥ kavayo yajñadhīrāḥ pracetaso ya iṣayanta manma
verses.en: Varuna's spies, sent forth upon their errand, survey the two world-halves well formed and fashioned. Wise are they, holy, skilled in sacrifices, the furtherers of the praise-songs of the prudent.

verses.sa:
उवाच मे वरुणो मेधिराय त्रिः सप्त नामाघ्न्या बिभर्ति ।
विद्वान्पदस्य गुह्या न वोचद्युगाय विप्र उपराय शिक्षन्॥
verses.tr: uvāca me varuṇo medhirāya triḥ sapta nāmāghnyā bibharti vidvānpadasya guhyā na vocadyugāya vipra uparāya śikṣan
verses.en: To me who understand hath Varuna spoken, the names borne by the Cow are three times seven. The sapient God, knowing the place's secret, shall speak as 'twere to teach the race that cometh.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो द्यावो निहिता अन्तरस्मिन्तिस्रो भूमीरुपराः षड्विधानाः ।
गृत्सो राजा वरुणश्चक्र एतं दिवि प्रेङ्खं हिरण्ययं शुभे कम्॥
verses.tr: tisro dyāvo nihitā antarasmintisro bhūmīruparāḥ ṣaḍvidhānāḥ gṛtso rājā varuṇaścakra etaṃ divi preṅkhaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ śubhe kam
verses.en: On him three heavens rest and are supported, and the three earths are there in sixfold order. The wise King Varuna hath made in heaven that Golden Swing to cover it with glory.

verses.sa:
अव सिन्धुं वरुणो द्यौरिव स्थाद्द्रप्सो न श्वेतो मृगस्तुविष्मान् ।
गम्भीरशंसो रजसो विमानः सुपारक्षत्रः सतो अस्य राजा॥
verses.tr: ava sindhuṃ varuṇo dyauriva sthāddrapso na śveto mṛgastuviṣmān gambhīraśaṃso rajaso vimānaḥ supārakṣatraḥ sato asya rājā
verses.en: Like Varuna from heaven he sinks in Sindhu, like a white-shining spark, a strong wild creature. Ruling in depths and meting out the region, great saving power hath he, this world's Controller.

verses.sa:
यो मृळयाति चक्रुषे चिदागो वयं स्याम वरुणे अनागाः ।
अनु व्रतान्यदितेॠधन्तो यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: yo mṛḻayāti cakruṣe cidāgo vayaṃ syāma varuṇe anāgāḥ anu vratānyaditeṝdhanto yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Before this Varuna may we be sinless him who shows mercy even to the sinner- While we are keeping Aditi's ordinances. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
वरुणः, ( ७ पाशविमोचनी) । त्रिष्टुप् ।
प्र शुन्ध्युवं वरुणाय प्रेष्ठां मतिं वसिष्ठ मीळ्हुषे भरस्व ।
य ईमर्वाञ्चं करते यजत्रं सहस्रामघं वृषणं बृहन्तम्॥
verses.tr: varuṇaḥ, ( 7 pāśavimocanī) triṣṭup pra śundhyuvaṃ varuṇāya preṣṭhāṃ matiṃ vasiṣṭha mīḻhuṣe bharasva ya īmarvāñcaṃ karate yajatraṃ sahasrāmaghaṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bṛhantam
verses.en: Present to Varuna thine hymn, Vasistha, bright, most delightful to the Bounteous Giver, Who bringeth on to us the Bull, the lofty, the Holy, laden with a thousand treasures.

verses.sa:
अधा न्वस्य संदृशं जगन्वानग्नेरनीकं वरुणस्य मंसि ।
स्व१र्यदश्मन्नधिपा उ अन्धोऽभि मा वपुर्दृशये निनीयात्॥
verses.tr: adhā nvasya saṃdṛśaṃ jaganvānagneranīkaṃ varuṇasya maṃsi sva1ryadaśmannadhipā u andho'bhi mā vapurdṛśaye ninīyāt
verses.en: And now, as I am come before his presence, I take the face of Varuna for Agni's. So might he bring-Lord also of the darkness-the light in heaven that I may see its beauty!

verses.sa:
आ यद्रुहाव वरुणश्च नावं प्र यत्समुद्रमीरयाव मध्यम् ।
अधि यदपां स्नुभिश्चराव प्र प्रेङ्ख ईङ्खयावहै शुभे कम्॥
verses.tr: ā yadruhāva varuṇaśca nāvaṃ pra yatsamudramīrayāva madhyam adhi yadapāṃ snubhiścarāva pra preṅkha īṅkhayāvahai śubhe kam
verses.en: When Varuna and I embark together and urge our boat into the midst of ocean, We, when we ride o'er ridges of the waters, will swing within that swing and there be happy.

verses.sa:
वसिष्ठं ह वरुणो नाव्याधादृषिं चकार स्वपा महोभिः ।
स्तोतारं विप्रः सुदिनत्वे अह्नां यान्नु द्यावस्ततनन्यादुषासः॥
verses.tr: vasiṣṭhaṃ ha varuṇo nāvyādhādṛṣiṃ cakāra svapā mahobhiḥ stotāraṃ vipraḥ sudinatve ahnāṃ yānnu dyāvastatananyāduṣāsaḥ
verses.en: Varuna placed Vasistha in the vessel, and deftly with his night made him a Rsi. When days shone bright the Sage made him a singer, while the heavens broadened and the Dawns were lengthened.

verses.sa:
क्व१ त्यानि नौ सख्या बभूवुः सचावहे यदवृकं पुरा चित् ।
बृहन्तं मानं वरुण स्वधावः सहस्रद्वारं जगमा गृहं ते॥
verses.tr: kva1 tyāni nau sakhyā babhūvuḥ sacāvahe yadavṛkaṃ purā cit bṛhantaṃ mānaṃ varuṇa svadhāvaḥ sahasradvāraṃ jagamā gṛhaṃ te
verses.en: What hath become of those our ancient friendships, when without enmity we walked together? I, Varuna, thou glorious Lord, have entered thy lofty home, thine house with thousand portals.

verses.sa:
य आपिर्नित्यो वरुण प्रियः सन्त्वामागांसि कृणवत्सखा ते ।
मा त एनस्वन्तो यक्षिन्भुजेम यन्धि ष्मा विप्रः स्तुवते वरूथम्॥
verses.tr: ya āpirnityo varuṇa priyaḥ santvāmāgāṃsi kṛṇavatsakhā te mā ta enasvanto yakṣinbhujema yandhi ṣmā vipraḥ stuvate varūtham
verses.en: If he, thy true ally, hath sinned against thee, still, Varuna, he is the friend thou lovest. Let us not, Living One, as sinners I know thee: give shelter, as a Sage, to him who lauds thee.

verses.sa:
ध्रुवासु त्वासु क्षितिषु क्षियन्तो व्य१स्मत्पाशं वरुणो मुमोचत् ।
अवो वन्वाना अदितेरुपस्थाद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: dhruvāsu tvāsu kṣitiṣu kṣiyanto vya1smatpāśaṃ varuṇo mumocat avo vanvānā aditerupasthādyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: While we abide in these fixed habitations, and from the lap of Aditi win favour, May Varuna untie the bond that binds us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: मो षु वरुण मृन्मयं गृहं राजन्नहं गमम् । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: mo ṣu varuṇa mṛnmayaṃ gṛhaṃ rājannahaṃ gamam mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya
verses.en: Let me not yet, King Varuna, enter into the house of clay: Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa: यदेमि प्रस्फुरन्निव दृतिर्न ध्मातो अद्रिवः । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: yademi prasphuranniva dṛtirna dhmāto adrivaḥ mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya
verses.en: When, Thunderer! I move along tremulous like a wind-blown skin, Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa: क्रत्वः समह दीनता प्रतीपं जगमा शुचे । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: kratvaḥ samaha dīnatā pratīpaṃ jagamā śuce mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya
verses.en: O Bright and Powerful God, through want of strength I erred and went astray Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa: अपां मध्ये तस्थिवांसं तृष्णाविदज्जरितारम् । मृळा सुक्षत्र मृळय॥
verses.tr: apāṃ madhye tasthivāṃsaṃ tṛṣṇāvidajjaritāram mṛḻā sukṣatra mṛḻaya
verses.en: Thirst found thy worshipper though he stood in the midst of water-fjords: Have mercy, spare me, Mighty Lord.

verses.sa:
यत्किं चेदं वरुण दैव्ये जनेऽभिद्रोहं मनुष्या३श्चरामसि ।
अचित्ती यत्तव धर्मा युयोपिम मा नस्तस्मादेनसो देव रीरिषः॥
verses.tr: yatkiṃ cedaṃ varuṇa daivye jane'bhidrohaṃ manuṣyā3ścarāmasi acittī yattava dharmā yuyopima mā nastasmādenaso deva rīriṣaḥ
verses.en: O Varuna, whatever the offence may be which we as men commit against the heavenly host, When through our want of thought we violate thy laws, punish us not, O God, for that iniquity.

verses.sa:
प्र वीरया शुचयो दद्रिरे वामध्वर्युभिर्मधुमन्तः सुतासः ।
वह वायो नियुतो याह्यच्छा पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो मदाय॥
verses.tr: pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya
verses.en: To you pure juice, rich in meath, are offered by priest: through longing for the Pair of Heroes. Drive, Vayu, bring thine harnessed horses hither: drink the pressed Soma till it make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
ईशानाय प्रहुतिं यस्त आनट् शुचिं सोमं शुचिपास्तुभ्यं वायो ।
कृणोषि तं मर्त्येषु प्रशस्तं जातोजातो जायते वाज्यस्य॥
verses.tr: īśānāya prahutiṃ yasta ānaṭ śuciṃ somaṃ śucipāstubhyaṃ vāyo kṛṇoṣi taṃ martyeṣu praśastaṃ jātojāto jāyate vājyasya
verses.en: Whoso to thee, the Mighty, brings oblation, pure Soma unto thee, pure-drinking Vayu, That man thou makest famous among mortals: to him strong sons are born in quick succession.

verses.sa:
राये नु यं जज्ञतू रोदसीमे राये देवी धिषणा धाति देवम् ।
अध वायुं नियुतः सश्चत स्वा उत श्वेतं वसुधितिं निरेके॥
verses.tr: rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke
verses.en: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhisana for our wealth appointeth, His team of harnessed horses waits on Vayu, and, foremost, on the radiant Treasure-bearer.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्नुषसः सुदिना अरिप्रा उरु ज्योतिर्विविदुर्दीध्यानाः ।
गव्यं चिदूर्वमुशिजो वि वव्रुस्तेषामनु प्रदिवः सस्रुरापः॥
verses.tr: ucchannuṣasaḥ sudinā ariprā uru jyotirvividurdīdhyānāḥ gavyaṃ cidūrvamuśijo vi vavrusteṣāmanu pradivaḥ sasrurāpaḥ
verses.en: The spotless Dawns with fair bright days have broken; they found the spacious light when they were shining. Eagerly they disclosed the stall of cattle: floods streamed for them as in the days aforetime.

verses.sa:
ते सत्येन मनसा दीध्यानाः स्वेन युक्तासः क्रतुना वहन्ति ।
इन्द्रवायू वीरवाहं रथं वामीशानयोरभि पृक्षः सचन्ते॥
verses.tr: te satyena manasā dīdhyānāḥ svena yuktāsaḥ kratunā vahanti indravāyū vīravāhaṃ rathaṃ vāmīśānayorabhi pṛkṣaḥ sacante
verses.en: These with their truthful spirit, shining brightly, move on provided with their natural insight. Viands attend the car that beareth Heroes, your car, ye Sovran Pair, Indra and Vayu.

verses.sa:
ईशानासो ये दधते स्वर्णो गोभिरश्वेभिर्वसुभिर्हिरण्यैः ।
इन्द्रवायू सूरयो विश्वमायुरर्वद्भिर्वीरैः पृतनासु सह्युः॥
verses.tr: īśānāso ye dadhate svarṇo gobhiraśvebhirvasubhirhiraṇyaiḥ indravāyū sūrayo viśvamāyurarvadbhirvīraiḥ pṛtanāsu sahyuḥ
verses.en: May these who give us heavenly light, these rulers, with gifts of kine and horses, gold and treasures. These princes, through full life, Indra and Vayu! o'ercome in battle with their steeds and heroes.

verses.sa:
अर्वन्तो न श्रवसो भिक्षमाणा इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।
वाजयन्तः स्ववसे हुवेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Like coursers seeking fame will we Vasisthas, O Indra-Vayu, with our fair laudations. Exerting all our power call you to aid us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
कुविदङ्ग नमसा ये वृधासः पुरा देवा अनवद्यास आसन् ।
ते वायवे मनवे बाधितायाऽवासयन्नुषसं सूर्येण॥
verses.tr: kuvidaṅga namasā ye vṛdhāsaḥ purā devā anavadyāsa āsan te vāyave manave bādhitāyā'vāsayannuṣasaṃ sūryeṇa
verses.en: Were not in sooth, the Gods aforetime blameless, whose pleasure was increased by adoration? For Vayu and for man in his affliction they caused the Morning to arise with Surya.

verses.sa:
उशन्ता दूता न दभाय गोपा मासश्च पाथः शरदश्च पूर्वीः ।
इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिर्वामियाना मार्डीकमीट्टे सुवितं च नव्यम्॥
verses.tr: uśantā dūtā na dabhāya gopā māsaśca pāthaḥ śaradaśca pūrvīḥ indravāyū suṣṭutirvāmiyānā mārḍīkamīṭṭe suvitaṃ ca navyam
verses.en: Guardians infallible, eager as envoys' preserve us safe through many months and autumns. Addressed to you, our fair praise, Indra-Vayu, implores your favour and renewed well-being.

verses.sa:
पीवोअन्नाँ रयिवृधः सुमेधाः श्वेतः सिषक्ति नियुतामभिश्रीः ।
ते वायवे समनसो वि तस्थुर्विश्वेन्नरः स्वपत्यानि चक्रुः॥
verses.tr: pīvoannāṃ rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ te vāyave samanaso vi tasthurviśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ
verses.en: Wise, bright, arranger of his teams, he. seeketh men with rich food whose treasures are abundant. They have arranged them of one mind with Vayu: the men have wrought all noble operations.

verses.sa:
यावत्तरस्तन्वो३ यावदोजो यावन्नरश्चक्षसा दीध्यानाः ।
शुचिं सोमं शुचिपा पातमस्मे इन्द्रवायू सदतं बर्हिरेदम्॥
verses.tr: yāvattarastanvo3 yāvadojo yāvannaraścakṣasā dīdhyānāḥ śuciṃ somaṃ śucipā pātamasme indravāyū sadataṃ barhiredam
verses.en: So far as native power and strength permit you, so far as men behold whose eyes have vision, O ye pure-drinkers, drink with us pure Soma: sit on this sacred grass, Indra and Vayu.

verses.sa:
नियुवाना नियुतः स्पार्हवीरा इन्द्रवायू सरथं यातमर्वाक् ।
इदं हि वां प्रभृतं मध्वो अग्रमध प्रीणाना वि मुमुक्तमस्मे॥
verses.tr: niyuvānā niyutaḥ spārhavīrā indravāyū sarathaṃ yātamarvāk idaṃ hi vāṃ prabhṛtaṃ madhvo agramadha prīṇānā vi mumuktamasme
verses.en: Driving down teams that bear the lovely Heroes, hitherward, Indra-Vayu, come together. To you this prime of savoury juice is offered: here loose your horses and be friendly-minded.

verses.sa:
या वां शतं नियुतो याः सहस्रमिन्द्रवायू विश्ववाराः सचन्ते ।
आभिर्यातं सुविदत्राभिरर्वाक्पातं नरा प्रतिभृतस्य मध्वः॥
verses.tr: yā vāṃ śataṃ niyuto yāḥ sahasramindravāyū viśvavārāḥ sacante ābhiryātaṃ suvidatrābhirarvākpātaṃ narā pratibhṛtasya madhvaḥ
verses.en: Your hundred and your thousand teams, O Indra and Vayu, all-munificent, which attend you, With these most gracious-minded come ye hither, and drink, O Heroes of the meath we offer.

verses.sa:
अर्वन्तो न श्रवसो भिक्षमाणा इन्द्रवायू सुष्टुतिभिर्वसिष्ठाः ।
वाजयन्तः स्ववसे हुवेम यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: arvanto na śravaso bhikṣamāṇā indravāyū suṣṭutibhirvasiṣṭhāḥ vājayantaḥ svavase huvema yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Like coursers seeking fame will we Vasisthas, O Indra-Vayu, with our fair laudations, Exerting all our power, call you to aid us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
आ वायो भूष शुचिपा उप नः सहस्रं ते नियुतो विश्ववार ।
उपो ते अन्धो मद्यमयामि यस्य देव दधिषे पूर्वपेयम्॥
verses.tr: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyam
verses.en: O VAYU, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, Allbounteous Giver. To thee the rapture-bringing juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.

verses.sa:
प्र सोता जीरो अध्वरेष्वस्थात्सोममिन्द्राय वायवे पिबध्यै ।
प्र यद्वां मध्वो अग्रियं भरन्त्यध्वर्यवो देवयन्तः शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: pra sotā jīro adhvareṣvasthātsomamindrāya vāyave pibadhyai pra yadvāṃ madhvo agriyaṃ bharantyadhvaryavo devayantaḥ śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Prompt at the holy rites forth came the presser with Soma-draughts for Indra and for Vayu, When ministering priests with strong devotion bring to you Twain the first taste of the Soma.

verses.sa:
प्र याभिर्यासि दाश्वांसमच्छा नियुद्भिर्वायविष्टये दुरोणे ।
नि नो रयिं सुभोजसं युवस्व नि वीरं गव्यमश्व्यं च राधः॥
verses.tr: pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāṃsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ
verses.en: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his home, O Vayu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth: to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.

verses.sa:
ये वायव इन्द्रमादनास आदेवासो नितोशनासो अर्यः ।
घ्नन्तो वृत्राणि सूरिभिः ष्याम सासह्वांसो युधा नृभिरमित्रान्॥
verses.tr: ye vāyava indramādanāsa ādevāso nitośanāso aryaḥ ghnanto vṛtrāṇi sūribhiḥ ṣyāma sāsahvāṃso yudhā nṛbhiramitrān
verses.en: Near to the Gods and making Indra joyful, devout and offering precious gifts to Vayu, Allied with princes, smiting down the hostile, may we with heroes conquer foes in battle.

verses.sa:
आ नो नियुद्भिः शतिनीभिरध्वरं सहस्रिणीभिरुप याहि यज्ञम् । वा
यो अस्मिन्त्सवने मादयस्व यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam vā yo asmintsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship. Come, Vayu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
शुचिं नु स्तोमं नवजातमद्येन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा जुषेथाम् ।
उभा हि वां सुहवा जोहवीमि ता वाजं सद्य उशते धेष्ठा॥
verses.tr: śuciṃ nu stomaṃ navajātamadyendrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā juṣethām ubhā hi vāṃ suhavā johavīmi tā vājaṃ sadya uśate dheṣṭhā
verses.en: Slayers of enemies, Indra and Agni, accept this day our new-born pure laudation. Again, again I call you prompt to listen, best to give quickly strength to him who craves it.

verses.sa:
ता सानसी शवसाना हि भूतं साकंवृधा शवसा शूशुवांसा ।
क्षयन्तौ रायो यवसस्य भूरेः पृङ्क्तं वाजस्य स्थविरस्य घृष्वेः॥
verses.tr: tā sānasī śavasānā hi bhūtaṃ sākaṃvṛdhā śavasā śūśuvāṃsā kṣayantau rāyo yavasasya bhūreḥ pṛṅktaṃ vājasya sthavirasya ghṛṣveḥ
verses.en: For ye were strong to gain, exceeding mighty, growing together, waxing in your vigour. Lords of the pasture filled with ample riches, bestow upon us strength both fresh and lasting.

verses.sa:
उपो ह यद्विदथं वाजिनो गुर्धीभिर्विप्राः प्रमतिमिच्छमानाः ।
अर्वन्तो न काष्ठां नक्षमाणा इन्द्राग्नी जोहुवतो नरस्ते॥
verses.tr: upo ha yadvidathaṃ vājino gurdhībhirviprāḥ pramatimicchamānāḥ arvanto na kāṣṭhāṃ nakṣamāṇā indrāgnī johuvato naraste
verses.en: Yea when the strong have entered our assembly, and singers seeking with their hymns your favour, They are like steeds who come into the race-course, those men who call aloud on Indra-Agni.

verses.sa:
गीर्भिर्विप्रः प्रमतिमिच्छमान ईट्टे रयिं यशसं पूर्वभाजम् ।
इन्द्राग्नी वृत्रहणा सुवज्रा प्र नो नव्येभिस्तिरतं देष्णैः॥
verses.tr: gīrbhirvipraḥ pramatimicchamāna īṭṭe rayiṃ yaśasaṃ pūrvabhājam indrāgnī vṛtrahaṇā suvajrā pra no navyebhistirataṃ deṣṇaiḥ
verses.en: The singer, seeking with his hymns your favour, begs splendid riches of their first possessor. Further us with new bounties, Indra-Agni, armed with strong thunder, slayers of the foeman.

verses.sa:
सं यन्मही मिथती स्पर्धमाने तनूरुचा शूरसाता यतैते ।
अदेवयुं विदथे देवयुभिः सत्रा हतं सोमसुता जनेन॥
verses.tr: saṃ yanmahī mithatī spardhamāne tanūrucā śūrasātā yataite adevayuṃ vidathe devayubhiḥ satrā hataṃ somasutā janena
verses.en: When two great hosts, arrayed against each other, meet clothed with brightness, in the fierce encounter Stand ye beside the godly, smite the godless; and still assist the men who press the Soma.

verses.sa:
इमामु षु सोमसुतिमुप न एन्द्राग्नी सौमनसाय यातम् ।
नू चिद्धि परिमम्नाथे अस्माना वां शश्वद्भिर्ववृतीय वाजैः॥
verses.tr: imāmu ṣu somasutimupa na endrāgnī saumanasāya yātam nū ciddhi parimamnāthe asmānā vāṃ śaśvadbhirvavṛtīya vājaiḥ
verses.en: To this our Soma-pressing, Indra-Agni, come ye prepared to show your loving-kindness, For not at any time have ye despised us. So may I draw you with all strengthenings hither.

verses.sa:
सो अग्न एना नमसा समिद्धोऽच्छा मित्रं वरुणमिन्द्रं वोचेः ।
यत्सीमागश्चकृमा तत्सु मृळ तदर्यमादितिः शिश्रथन्तु॥
verses.tr: so agna enā namasā samiddho'cchā mitraṃ varuṇamindraṃ voceḥ yatsīmāgaścakṛmā tatsu mṛḻa tadaryamāditiḥ śiśrathantu
verses.en: So Agni, kindled mid this adoration, invite thou Mitra, Varuna, and Indra. Forgive whatever sin we have committed may Aryaman and Aditi remove it.

verses.sa:
एता अग्न आशुषाणास इष्टीर्युवोः सचाभ्यश्याम वाजान् ।
मेन्द्रो नो विष्णुर्मरुतः परि ख्यन्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: etā agna āśuṣāṇāsa iṣṭīryuvoḥ sacābhyaśyāma vājān mendro no viṣṇurmarutaḥ pari khyanyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: While we accelerate these our sacrifices, may we win strength from both of you, O Agni: Ne'er may the Maruts, Indra, Visnu slight us. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: इयं वामस्य मन्मन इन्द्राग्नी पूर्व्यस्तुतिः । अभ्राद्वृष्टिरिवाजनि॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vāmasya manmana indrāgnī pūrvyastutiḥ abhrādvṛṣṭirivājani
verses.en: As rain from out the cloud, for you, Indra and Agni, from my soul This noblest praise hath been produced.

verses.sa: शृणुतं जरितुर्हवमिन्द्राग्नी वनतं गिरः । ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः॥
verses.tr: śṛṇutaṃ jariturhavamindrāgnī vanataṃ giraḥ īśānā pipyataṃ dhiyaḥ
verses.en: Do ye, O Indra-Agni, hear the singer's call: accept his songs. Ye Rulers, grant his heart's desire.

verses.sa: मा पापत्वाय नो नरेन्द्राग्नी माभिशस्तये । मा नो रीरधतं निदे॥
verses.tr: mā pāpatvāya no narendrāgnī mābhiśastaye mā no rīradhataṃ nide
verses.en: Give us not up to poverty, ye Heroes, Indra-Agni, nor To slander and reproach of men.

verses.sa: इन्द्रे अग्ना नमो बृहत्सुवृक्तिमेरयामहे । धिया धेना अवस्यवः॥
verses.tr: indre agnā namo bṛhatsuvṛktimerayāmahe dhiyā dhenā avasyavaḥ
verses.en: To Indra and to Agni we bring reverence, high and holy hymn, And, craving help, soft words with prayer.

verses.sa: ता हि शश्वन्त ईळत इत्था विप्रास ऊतये । सबाधो वाजसातये॥
verses.tr: tā hi śaśvanta īḻata itthā viprāsa ūtaye sabādho vājasātaye
verses.en: For all these holy singers here implore these Twain to succour them, And priests that they may win them strength.

verses.sa: ता वां गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे । मेधसाता सनिष्यवः॥
verses.tr: tā vāṃ gīrbhirvipanyavaḥ prayasvanto havāmahe medhasātā saniṣyavaḥ
verses.en: Eager to laud you, we with songs invoke you, bearing sacred food, Fain for success in sacrifice.

verses.sa: इन्द्राग्नी अवसा गतमस्मभ्यं चर्षणीसहा । मा नो दुःशंस ईशत॥
verses.tr: indrāgnī avasā gatamasmabhyaṃ carṣaṇīsahā mā no duḥśaṃsa īśata
verses.en: Indra and Agni, come to us with favour, ye who conquer men: Let not the wicked master us.

verses.sa: मा कस्य नो अररुषो धूर्तिः प्रणङ्मर्त्यस्य । इन्द्राग्नी शर्म यच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: mā kasya no araruṣo dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅmartyasya indrāgnī śarma yacchatam
verses.en: At no time let the injurious blow of hostile mortal fall on us: O Indra-Agni, shelter us.

verses.sa: गोमद्धिरण्यवद्वसु यद्वामश्वावदीमहे । इन्द्राग्नी तद्वनेमहि॥
verses.tr: gomaddhiraṇyavadvasu yadvāmaśvāvadīmahe indrāgnī tadvanemahi
verses.en: Whatever wealth we crave of you, in gold, in cattle, or in steeds, That, Indra-Agni, let us gain;

verses.sa: यत्सोम आ सुते नर इन्द्राग्नी अजोहवुः । सप्तीवन्ता सपर्यवः॥
verses.tr: yatsoma ā sute nara indrāgnī ajohavuḥ saptīvantā saparyavaḥ
verses.en: When heroes prompt in worship call Indra and Agni, Lords of steeds, Beside the Soma juice effused.

verses.sa: उक्थेभिर्वृत्रहन्तमा या मन्दाना चिदा गिरा । आङ्गूषैराविवासतः॥
verses.tr: ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ
verses.en: Call hither with the song and lauds those who best slay the foemen, those Who take delight in hymns of praise.

verses.sa: ताविद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं दुर्विद्वांसं रक्षस्विनम् । आभोगं हन्मना हतमुदधिं हन्मना हतम्॥
verses.tr: tāvidduḥśaṃsaṃ martyaṃ durvidvāṃsaṃ rakṣasvinam ābhogaṃ hanmanā hatamudadhiṃ hanmanā hatam
verses.en: Slay ye the wicked man whose thought is evil of the demon kind. Slay him who stays the waters, slay the Serpent with your deadly dart.

verses.sa:
प्र क्षोदसा धायसा सस्र एषा सरस्वती धरुणमायसी पूः ।
प्रबाबधाना रथ्येव याति विश्वा अपो महिना सिन्धुरन्याः॥
verses.tr: pra kṣodasā dhāyasā sasra eṣā sarasvatī dharuṇamāyasī pūḥ prabābadhānā rathyeva yāti viśvā apo mahinā sindhuranyāḥ
verses.en: This stream Sarasvati with fostering current comes forth, our sure defense, our fort of iron. As on a car, the flood flows on, surpassing in majesty and might all other waters.

verses.sa:
एकाचेतत्सरस्वती नदीनां शुचिर्यती गिरिभ्य आ समुद्रात् ।
रायश्चेतन्ती भुवनस्य भूरेर्घृतं पयो दुदुहे नाहुषाय॥
verses.tr: ekācetatsarasvatī nadīnāṃ śuciryatī giribhya ā samudrāt rāyaścetantī bhuvanasya bhūrerghṛtaṃ payo duduhe nāhuṣāya
verses.en: Pure in her course from mountains to the ocean, alone of streams Sarasvati hath listened. Thinking of wealth and the great world of creatures, she poured for Nahusa her milk and fatness.

verses.sa:
स वावृधे नर्यो योषणासु वृषा शिशुर्वृषभो यज्ञियासु ।
स वाजिनं मघवद्भ्यो दधाति वि सातये तन्वं मामृजीत॥
verses.tr: sa vāvṛdhe naryo yoṣaṇāsu vṛṣā śiśurvṛṣabho yajñiyāsu sa vājinaṃ maghavadbhyo dadhāti vi sātaye tanvaṃ māmṛjīta
verses.en: Friendly to man he grew among the women, a strong young Steer amid the Holy Ladies. He gives the fleet steed to our wealthy princes, and decks their bodies for success in battle.

verses.sa:
उत स्या नः सरस्वती जुषाणोप श्रवत्सुभगा यज्णे अस्मिन् ।
मितज्ञुभिर्नमस्यैरियाना राया युजा चिदुत्तरा सखिभ्यः॥
verses.tr: uta syā naḥ sarasvatī juṣāṇopa śravatsubhagā yajṇe asmin mitajñubhirnamasyairiyānā rāyā yujā ciduttarā sakhibhyaḥ
verses.en: May this Sarasvati be pleased and listen at this our sacrifice, auspicious Lady, When we with reverence, on our knees, implore her close-knit to wealth, most kind to those she loveth.

verses.sa:
इमा जुह्वाना युष्मदा नमोभिः प्रति स्तोमं सरस्वति जुषस्व ।
तव शर्मन्प्रियतमे दधाना उप स्थेयाम शरणं न वृक्षम्॥
verses.tr: imā juhvānā yuṣmadā namobhiḥ prati stomaṃ sarasvati juṣasva tava śarmanpriyatame dadhānā upa stheyāma śaraṇaṃ na vṛkṣam
verses.en: These offerings have ye made with adoration: say this, Sarasvati, and accept our praises; And, placing us under thy dear protection, may we approach thee, as a tree, for shelter.

verses.sa:
अयमु ते सरस्वति वसिष्ठो द्वारावृतस्य सुभगे व्यावः ।
वर्ध शुभ्रे स्तुवते रासि वाजान्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: ayamu te sarasvati vasiṣṭho dvārāvṛtasya subhage vyāvaḥ vardha śubhre stuvate rāsi vājānyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: For thee, O Blest Sarasvati, Vasistha hath here unbarred the doors d sacred Order. Wax, Bright One, and give strength to him who lauds thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
बृहदु गायिषे वचोऽसुर्या नदीनाम् ।
सरस्वतीमिन्महया सुवृक्तिभिः स्तोमैर्वसिष्ठ रोदसी॥
verses.tr: bṛhadu gāyiṣe vaco'suryā nadīnām sarasvatīminmahayā suvṛktibhiḥ stomairvasiṣṭha rodasī
verses.en: I SING a lofty song, for she is mightiest, most divine of Streams. Sarasvati will I exalt with hymns and lauds, and, O Vasistha, Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa:
उभे यत्ते महिना शुभ्रे अन्धसी अधिक्षियन्ति पूरवः ।
सा नो बोध्यवित्री मरुत्सखा चोद राधो मघोनाम्॥
verses.tr: ubhe yatte mahinā śubhre andhasī adhikṣiyanti pūravaḥ sā no bodhyavitrī marutsakhā coda rādho maghonām
verses.en: When in the fulness of their strength the Purus dwell, Beauteous One, on thy two grassy banks, Favour us thou who hast the Maruts for thy friends: stir up the bounty of our chiefs.

verses.sa:
भद्रमिद्भद्रा कृणवत्सरस्वत्यकवारी चेतति वाजिनीवती ।
गृणाना जमदग्निवत्स्तुवाना च वसिष्ठवत्॥
verses.tr: bhadramidbhadrā kṛṇavatsarasvatyakavārī cetati vājinīvatī gṛṇānā jamadagnivatstuvānā ca vasiṣṭhavat
verses.en: So may Sarasvati auspicious send good luck; she, rich in spoil, is never niggardly in thought, When praised in Jamadagni's way and lauded as Vasistha lauds.

verses.sa: जनीयन्तो न्वग्रवः पुत्रीयन्तः सुदानवः । सरस्वन्तं हवामहे॥
verses.tr: janīyanto nvagravaḥ putrīyantaḥ sudānavaḥ sarasvantaṃ havāmahe
verses.en: We call upon Sarasvan, as unmarried men who long for wives, As liberal men who yearn for sons.

verses.sa: ये ते सरस्व ऊर्मयो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः । तेभिर्नोऽविता भव॥
verses.tr: ye te sarasva ūrmayo madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ tebhirno'vitā bhava
verses.en: Be thou our kind protector, O Sarasvan, with those waves of thine Laden with sweets and dropping oil.

verses.sa: पीपिवांसं सरस्वतः स्तनं यो विश्वदर्शतः । भक्षीमहि प्रजामिषम्॥
verses.tr: pīpivāṃsaṃ sarasvataḥ stanaṃ yo viśvadarśataḥ bhakṣīmahi prajāmiṣam
verses.en: May we enjoy Sarasvan's breast, all-beautiful, that swells with streams, May we gain food and progeny.

verses.sa:
यज्ञे दिवो नृषदने पृथिव्या नरो यत्र देवयवो मदन्ति ।
इन्द्राय यत्र सवनानि सुन्वे गमन्मदाय प्रथमं वयश्च॥
verses.tr: yajñe divo nṛṣadane pṛthivyā naro yatra devayavo madanti indrāya yatra savanāni sunve gamanmadāya prathamaṃ vayaśca
verses.en: Where Heaven and Earth combine in men's assembly, and those who love the Gods delight in worship, Where the libations are effused for Indra, may he come first to drink and make him stronger.

verses.sa:
आ दैव्या वृणीमहेऽवांसि बृहस्पतिर्नो मह आ सखायः ।
यथा भवेम मीळ्हुषे अनागा यो नो दाता परावतः पितेव॥
verses.tr: ā daivyā vṛṇīmahe'vāṃsi bṛhaspatirno maha ā sakhāyaḥ yathā bhavema mīḻhuṣe anāgā yo no dātā parāvataḥ piteva
verses.en: We crave the heavenly grace of Gods to guard us-so may Brhaspati, O friends, exalt us- That he, the Bounteous God, may find us sinless, who giveth from a distance like a father.

verses.sa:
तमु ज्येष्ठं नमसा हविर्भिः सुशेवं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं गृणीषे ।
इन्द्रं श्लोको महि दैव्यः सिषक्तु यो ब्रह्मणो देवकृतस्य राजा॥
verses.tr: tamu jyeṣṭhaṃ namasā havirbhiḥ suśevaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ gṛṇīṣe indraṃ śloko mahi daivyaḥ siṣaktu yo brahmaṇo devakṛtasya rājā
verses.en: That Brahmanaspati, most High and Gracious, I glorify with offerings and with homage. May the great song of praise divine, reach Indra who is the King of prayer the Gods' creation.

verses.sa:
स आ नो योनिं सदतु प्रेष्ठो बृहस्पतिर्विश्ववारो यो अस्ति ।
कामो रायः सुवीर्यस्य तं दात्पर्षन्नो अति सश्चतो अरिष्टान्॥
verses.tr: sa ā no yoniṃ sadatu preṣṭho bṛhaspatirviśvavāro yo asti kāmo rāyaḥ suvīryasya taṃ dātparṣanno ati saścato ariṣṭān
verses.en: May that Brhaspati who brings all blessings, most dearly loved, be seated by our altar. Heroes and wealth we crave; may he bestow them, and bear us safe beyond the men who vex us.

verses.sa:
तमा नो अर्कममृताय जुष्टमिमे धासुरमृतासः पुराजाः ।
शुचिक्रन्दं यजतं पस्त्यानां बृहस्पतिमनर्वाणं हुवेम॥
verses.tr: tamā no arkamamṛtāya juṣṭamime dhāsuramṛtāsaḥ purājāḥ śucikrandaṃ yajataṃ pastyānāṃ bṛhaspatimanarvāṇaṃ huvema
verses.en: To us these Deathless Ones, erst born, have granted this laud of ours which gives the Immortal pleasure. Let us invoke Brhaspati, the foeless, the clear-voiced God, the Holy One of households

verses.sa:
तं शग्मासो अरुषासो अश्वा बृहस्पतिं सहवाहो वहन्ति ।
सहश्चिद्यस्य नीलवत्सधस्थं नभो न रूपमरुषं वसानाः॥
verses.tr: taṃ śagmāso aruṣāso aśvā bṛhaspatiṃ sahavāho vahanti sahaścidyasya nīlavatsadhasthaṃ nabho na rūpamaruṣaṃ vasānāḥ
verses.en: Him, this Brhaspati, his red-hued horses, drawing together, full of strength, bring hither. Robed in red colour like the cloud, they carry the Lord of Might whose friendship gives a dwelling.

verses.sa:
स हि शुचिः शतपत्रः स शुन्ध्युर्हिरण्यवाशीरिषिरः स्वर्षाः ।
बृहस्पतिः स स्वावेश ऋष्वः पुरू सखिभ्य आसुतिं करिष्ठः॥
verses.tr: sa hi śuciḥ śatapatraḥ sa śundhyurhiraṇyavāśīriṣiraḥ svarṣāḥ bṛhaspatiḥ sa svāveśa ṛṣvaḥ purū sakhibhya āsutiṃ kariṣṭhaḥ
verses.en: For he is pure, with hundred wings, refulgent, with sword of gold, impetuous, winning sunlight. Sublime Brhaspati, easy of access granteth his friends most bountiful refreshment.

verses.sa:
देवी देवस्य रोदसी जनित्री बृहस्पतिं वावृधतुर्महित्वा ।
दक्षाय्याय दक्षता सखायः करद्ब्रह्मणे सुतरा सुगाधा॥
verses.tr: devī devasya rodasī janitrī bṛhaspatiṃ vāvṛdhaturmahitvā dakṣāyyāya dakṣatā sakhāyaḥ karadbrahmaṇe sutarā sugādhā
verses.en: Both Heaven and Earth, divine, the Deity's Parents, have made Brhaspati increase in grandeur. Glorify him, O friends, who merits glory: may he give prayer fair way and easy passage.

verses.sa:
इयं वां ब्रह्मणस्पते सुवृक्तिर्ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे अकारि ।
अविष्टं धियो जिगृतं पुरंधीर्जजस्तमर्यो वनुषामरातीः॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ vāṃ brahmaṇaspate suvṛktirbrahmendrāya vajriṇe akāri aviṣṭaṃ dhiyo jigṛtaṃ puraṃdhīrjajastamaryo vanuṣāmarātīḥ
verses.en: This, Brahmanaspati, is your laudation prayer hath been made to thunder wielding Indra. Favour our songs, wake up our thought and spirit: destroy the godless and our foemen's malice.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brhaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवोऽरुणं दुग्धमंशुं जुहोतन वृषभाय क्षितीनाम् ।
गौराद्वेदीयाँ अवपानमिन्द्रो विश्वाहेद्याति सुतसोममिच्छन्॥
verses.tr: adhvaryavo'ruṇaṃ dugdhamaṃśuṃ juhotana vṛṣabhāya kṣitīnām gaurādvedīyāṃ avapānamindro viśvāhedyāti sutasomamicchan
verses.en: Priests, offer to the Lord of all the people the milked-out stalk of Soma, radiant-coloured. No wild-bull knows his drinking-place like Indra who ever seeks him who hath pressed the Soma,

verses.sa:
यद्दधिषे प्रदिवि चार्वन्नं दिवेदिवे पीतिमिदस्य वक्षि ।
उत हृदोत मनसा जुषाण उशन्निन्द्र प्रस्थितान्पाहि सोमान्॥
verses.tr: yaddadhiṣe pradivi cārvannaṃ divedive pītimidasya vakṣi uta hṛdota manasā juṣāṇa uśannindra prasthitānpāhi somān
verses.en: Thou dost desire to drink, each day that passes, the pleasant food which thou hast had aforetime, O Indra, gratified in heart and spirit, drink eagerly the Soma set before thee.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानः सोमं सहसे पपाथ प्र ते माता महिमानमुवाच ।
एन्द्र पप्राथोर्व१न्तरिक्षं युधा देवेभ्यो वरिवश्चकर्थ॥
verses.tr: jajñānaḥ somaṃ sahase papātha pra te mātā mahimānamuvāca endra paprāthorva1ntarikṣaṃ yudhā devebhyo varivaścakartha
verses.en: Thou, newly-born, for strength didst drink the Soma; the Mother told thee of thy future greatness. O Indra, thou hast filled mid-air's wide region, and given the Gods by battle room and freedom.

verses.sa:
यद्योधया महतो मन्यमानान्त्साक्षाम तान्बाहुभिः शाशदानान् ।
यद्वा नृभिर्वृत इन्द्राभियुध्यास्तं त्वयाजिं सौश्रवसं जयेम॥
verses.tr: yadyodhayā mahato manyamānāntsākṣāma tānbāhubhiḥ śāśadānān yadvā nṛbhirvṛta indrābhiyudhyāstaṃ tvayājiṃ sauśravasaṃ jayema
verses.en: When thou hast urged the arrogant to combat, proud in their strength of arm, we will subdue them. Or, Indra, when thou fightest girt by heroes, we in the glorious fray with thee will conquer.

verses.sa:
प्रेन्द्रस्य वोचं प्रथमा कृतानि प्र नूतना मघवा या चकार ।
यदेददेवीरसहिष्ट माया अथाभवत्केवलः सोमो अस्य॥
verses.tr: prendrasya vocaṃ prathamā kṛtāni pra nūtanā maghavā yā cakāra yadedadevīrasahiṣṭa māyā athābhavatkevalaḥ somo asya
verses.en: I will declare the earliest deeds of Indra, and recent acts which Maghavan hath accomplished. When he had conquered godless wiles and magic, Soma became his own entire possession.

verses.sa:
तवेदं विश्वमभितः पशव्यं१ यत्पश्यसि चक्षसा सूर्यस्य ।
गवामसि गोपतिरेक इन्द्र भक्षीमहि ते प्रयतस्य वस्वः॥
verses.tr: tavedaṃ viśvamabhitaḥ paśavyaṃ1 yatpaśyasi cakṣasā sūryasya gavāmasi gopatireka indra bhakṣīmahi te prayatasya vasvaḥ
verses.en: Thine is this world of flocks and herds around thee, which with the eye of Surya thou beholdest. Thou, Indra, art alone the Lord of cattle; may we enjoy the treasure which thou givest.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते युवमिन्द्रश्च वस्वो दिव्यस्येशाथे उत पार्थिवस्य ।
