धत्तं रयिं स्तुवते कीरये चिद्यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspate yuvamindraśca vasvo divyasyeśāthe uta pārthivasya dhattaṃ rayiṃ stuvate kīraye cidyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: Ye Twain are Lords of wealth in earth and heaven, thou, O Brhaspati, and thou, O Indra. Mean though he be, give wealth to him who lauds you. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
परो मात्रया तन्वा वृधान न ते महित्वमन्वश्नुवन्ति ।
उभे ते विद्म रजसी पृथिव्या विष्णो देव त्वं परमस्य वित्से॥
verses.tr: paro mātrayā tanvā vṛdhāna na te mahitvamanvaśnuvanti ubhe te vidma rajasī pṛthivyā viṣṇo deva tvaṃ paramasya vitse
verses.en: Men come not nigh thy majesty who growest beyond all bound and measure with thy body. Both thy two regions of the earth, O Visnu, we know: thou God, knowest the highest also.

verses.sa:
न ते विष्णो जायमानो न जातो देव महिम्नः परमन्तमाप ।
उदस्तभ्ना नाकमृष्वं बृहन्तं दाधर्थ प्राचीं ककुभं पृथिव्याः॥
verses.tr: na te viṣṇo jāyamāno na jāto deva mahimnaḥ paramantamāpa udastabhnā nākamṛṣvaṃ bṛhantaṃ dādhartha prācīṃ kakubhaṃ pṛthivyāḥ
verses.en: None who is born or being born, God Visnu, hath reached the utmost limit of thy grandeur. The vast high vault of heaven hast thou supported, and fixed earth's eastern pinnacle securely.

verses.sa:
इरावती धेनुमती हि भूतं सूयवसिनी मनुषे दशस्या ।
व्यस्तभ्ना रोदसी विष्णवेते दाधर्थ पृथिवीमभितो मयूखैः॥
verses.tr: irāvatī dhenumatī hi bhūtaṃ sūyavasinī manuṣe daśasyā vyastabhnā rodasī viṣṇavete dādhartha pṛthivīmabhito mayūkhaiḥ
verses.en: Rich in sweet food be ye, and rich in milch-kine, with fertile pastures, fain to do men service. Both these worlds, Visnu, hast thou stayed asunder, and firmly fixed the earth with pegs around it.

verses.sa:
उरुं यज्ञाय चक्रथुरु लोकं जनयन्ता सूर्यमुषासमग्निम् ।
दासस्य चिद्वृषशिप्रस्य माया जघ्नथुर्नरा पृतनाज्येषु॥
verses.tr: uruṃ yajñāya cakrathuru lokaṃ janayantā sūryamuṣāsamagnim dāsasya cidvṛṣaśiprasya māyā jaghnathurnarā pṛtanājyeṣu
verses.en: Ye have made spacious room for sacrificing by generating Surya, Dawn, and Agni. O Heroes, ye have conquered in your battles even the bull-jawed Dasa's wiles and magic.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राविष्णू दृंहिताः शम्बरस्य नव पुरो नवतिं च श्नथिष्टम् ।
शतं वर्चिनः सहस्रं च साकं हथो अप्रत्यसुरस्य वीरान्॥
verses.tr: indrāviṣṇū dṛṃhitāḥ śambarasya nava puro navatiṃ ca śnathiṣṭam śataṃ varcinaḥ sahasraṃ ca sākaṃ hatho apratyasurasya vīrān
verses.en: Ye have destroyed, thou, Indra, and thou Visnu, Sambara's nine-and-ninety fenced castles. Ye Twain smote down a hundred times a thousand resistless heroes of the royal Varcin.

verses.sa:
इयं मनीषा बृहती बृहन्तोरुक्रमा तवसा वर्धयन्ती ।
ररे वां स्तोमं विदथेषु विष्णो पिन्वतमिषो वृजनेष्विन्द्र॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ manīṣā bṛhatī bṛhantorukramā tavasā vardhayantī rare vāṃ stomaṃ vidatheṣu viṣṇo pinvatamiṣo vṛjaneṣvindra
verses.en: This is the lofty hymn of praise, exalting the Lords of Mighty Stride, the strong and lofty. I laud you in the solemn synods, Visnu: pour ye food on us in our camps, O Indra.

verses.sa:
वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् ।
वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: O Visnu, unto thee my lips cry Vasat! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee. May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
नू मर्तो दयते सनिष्यन्यो विष्णव उरुगायाय दाशत् ।
प्र यः सत्राचा मनसा यजात एतावन्तं नर्यमाविवासात्॥
verses.tr: nū marto dayate saniṣyanyo viṣṇava urugāyāya dāśat pra yaḥ satrācā manasā yajāta etāvantaṃ naryamāvivāsāt
verses.en: Ne'ER doth the man repent, who, seeking profit, bringeth his gift to the far-striding Visnu. He who adoreth him with all his spirit winneth himself so great a benefactor.

verses.sa:
त्वं विष्णो सुमतिं विश्वजन्यामप्रयुतामेवयावो मतिं दाः ।
पर्चो यथा नः सुवितस्य भूरेरश्वावतः पुरुश्चन्द्रस्य रायः॥
verses.tr: tvaṃ viṣṇo sumatiṃ viśvajanyāmaprayutāmevayāvo matiṃ dāḥ parco yathā naḥ suvitasya bhūreraśvāvataḥ puruścandrasya rāyaḥ
verses.en: Thou, Visnu, constant in thy courses, gavest good-will to all men, and a hymn that lasteth, That thou mightst move us to abundant comfort of very splendid wealth with store of horses.

verses.sa:
त्रिर्देवः पृथिवीमेष एतां वि चक्रमे शतर्चसं महित्वा ।
प्र विष्णुरस्तु तवसस्तवीयान्त्वेषं ह्यस्य स्थविरस्य नाम॥
verses.tr: trirdevaḥ pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ vi cakrame śatarcasaṃ mahitvā pra viṣṇurastu tavasastavīyāntveṣaṃ hyasya sthavirasya nāma
verses.en: Three times strode forth this God in all his grandeur over this earth bright with a hundred splendours. Foremost be Visnu, stronger than the strongest: for glorious is his name who lives for ever.

verses.sa:
वि चक्रमे पृथिवीमेष एतां क्षेत्राय विष्णुर्मनुषे दशस्यन् ।
ध्रुवासो अस्य कीरयो जनास उरुक्षितिं सुजनिमा चकार॥
verses.tr: vi cakrame pṛthivīmeṣa etāṃ kṣetrāya viṣṇurmanuṣe daśasyan dhruvāso asya kīrayo janāsa urukṣitiṃ sujanimā cakāra
verses.en: Over this earth with mighty step strode Visnu, ready to give it for a home to Manu. In him the humble people trust for safety: he, nobly born, hath made them spacious dwellings.

verses.sa:
प्र तत्ते अद्य शिपिविष्ट नामाऽर्यः शंसामि वयुनानि विद्वान् ।
तं त्वा गृणामि तवसमतव्यान्क्षयन्तमस्य रजसः पराके॥
verses.tr: pra tatte adya śipiviṣṭa nāmā'ryaḥ śaṃsāmi vayunāni vidvān taṃ tvā gṛṇāmi tavasamatavyānkṣayantamasya rajasaḥ parāke
verses.en: To-day I laud this name, O gipivista, I, skilled in rules, the name of thee the Noble. Yea, I the poor and weak praise thee the Mighty who dwellest in the realm beyond this region.

verses.sa:
किमित्ते विष्णो परिचक्ष्यं भूत्प्र यद्ववक्षे शिपिविष्टो अस्मि ।
मा वर्पो अस्मदप गूह एतद्यदन्यरूपः समिथे बभूथ॥
verses.tr: kimitte viṣṇo paricakṣyaṃ bhūtpra yadvavakṣe śipiviṣṭo asmi mā varpo asmadapa gūha etadyadanyarūpaḥ samithe babhūtha
verses.en: What was there to be blamed in thee, O Visnu, when thou declaredst, I am Sipivista? Hide not this form from us, nor keep it secret, since thou didst wear another shape in battle.

verses.sa:
वषट् ते विष्णवास आ कृणोमि तन्मे जुषस्व शिपिविष्ट हव्यम् ।
वर्धन्तु त्वा सुष्टुतयो गिरो मे यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: vaṣaṭ te viṣṇavāsa ā kṛṇomi tanme juṣasva śipiviṣṭa havyam vardhantu tvā suṣṭutayo giro me yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: O Visnu, unto thee my lips cry Vasat! Let this mine offering, Sipivista, please thee. May these my songs of eulogy exalt thee. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो वाचः प्र वद ज्योतिरग्रा या एतद्दुह्रे मधुदोघमूधः ।
स वत्सं कृण्वन्गर्भमोषधीनां सद्यो जातो वृषभो रोरवीति॥
verses.tr: tisro vācaḥ pra vada jyotiragrā yā etadduhre madhudoghamūdhaḥ sa vatsaṃ kṛṇvangarbhamoṣadhīnāṃ sadyo jāto vṛṣabho roravīti
verses.en: Speak forth three words, the words which light precedeth, which milk this udder that produceth nectar. Quickly made manifest, the Bull hath bellowed, engendering the germ of plants, the Infant.

verses.sa:
यो वर्धन ओषधीनां यो अपां यो विश्वस्य जगतो देव ईशे ।
स त्रिधातु शरणं शर्म यंसत्त्रिवर्तु ज्योतिः स्वभिष्ट्य१स्मे॥
verses.tr: yo vardhana oṣadhīnāṃ yo apāṃ yo viśvasya jagato deva īśe sa tridhātu śaraṇaṃ śarma yaṃsattrivartu jyotiḥ svabhiṣṭya1sme
verses.en: Giver of growth to plants, the God who ruleth over the waters and all moving creatures, Vouchsafe us triple shelter for our refuge, and threefold light to succour and befriend us.

verses.sa:
स्तरीरु त्वद्भवति सूत उ त्वद्यथावशं तन्वं चक्र एषः ।
पितुः पयः प्रति गृभ्णाति माता तेन पिता वर्धते तेन पुत्रः॥
verses.tr: starīru tvadbhavati sūta u tvadyathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ cakra eṣaḥ pituḥ payaḥ prati gṛbhṇāti mātā tena pitā vardhate tena putraḥ
verses.en: Now he is sterile, now begetteth offspring, even as he willeth doth he change his figure. The Father's genial flow bedews the Mother; therewith the Sire, therewith the son is nourished.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वानि भुवनानि तस्थुस्तिस्रो द्यावस्त्रेधा सस्रुरापः ।
त्रयः कोशास उपसेचनासो मध्वः श्चोतन्त्यभितो विरप्शम्॥
verses.tr: yasminviśvāni bhuvanāni tasthustisro dyāvastredhā sasrurāpaḥ trayaḥ kośāsa upasecanāso madhvaḥ ścotantyabhito virapśam
verses.en: In him all living creatures have their being, and the three heavens with triply flowing waters. Three reservoirs that sprinkle down their treasure shed their sweet streams around him with a murmur.

verses.sa:
इदं वचः पर्जन्याय स्वराजे हृदो अस्त्वन्तरं तज्जुजोषत् ।
मयोभुवो वृष्टयः सन्त्वस्मे सुपिप्पला ओषधीर्देवगोपाः॥
verses.tr: idaṃ vacaḥ parjanyāya svarāje hṛdo astvantaraṃ tajjujoṣat mayobhuvo vṛṣṭayaḥ santvasme supippalā oṣadhīrdevagopāḥ
verses.en: May this my song to Sovran Lord Parjanya come near unto his heart and give him pleasure. May we obtain the showers that bring enjoyment, and God-protected plants with goodly fruitage.

verses.sa:
स रेतोधा वृषभः शश्वतीनां तस्मिन्नात्मा जगतस्तस्थुषश्च ।
तन्म ऋतं पातु शतशारदाय यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः॥
verses.tr: sa retodhā vṛṣabhaḥ śaśvatīnāṃ tasminnātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca tanma ṛtaṃ pātu śataśāradāya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
verses.en: He is the Bull of all, and their impregner lie holds the life of all things fixed and moving. May this rite save me till my hundredth autumn. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sa: पर्जन्याय प्र गायत दिवस्पुत्राय मीळ्हुषे । स नो यवसमिच्छतु॥
verses.tr: parjanyāya pra gāyata divasputrāya mīḻhuṣe sa no yavasamicchatu
verses.en: Sing forth and laud Parjanya, son of Heaven, who sends the gift of rain May he provide our pasturage.

verses.sa: यो गर्भमोषधीनां गवां कृणोत्यर्वताम् । पर्जन्यः पुरुषीणाम्॥
verses.tr: yo garbhamoṣadhīnāṃ gavāṃ kṛṇotyarvatām parjanyaḥ puruṣīṇām
verses.en: Parjanya is the God who forms in kine, in mares, in plants of earth, And womankind, the germ of life.

verses.sa: तस्मा इदास्ये हविर्जुहोता मधुमत्तमम् । इळां नः संयतं करत्॥
verses.tr: tasmā idāsye havirjuhotā madhumattamam iḻāṃ naḥ saṃyataṃ karat
verses.en: Offer and pour into his mouth oblation rich in savoury juice: May he for ever give us food.

verses.sa:
संवत्सरं शशयाना ब्राह्मणा व्रतचारिणः ।
वाचं पर्जन्यजिन्वितां प्र मण्डूका अवादिषुः॥
verses.tr: saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ vācaṃ parjanyajinvitāṃ pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ
verses.en: They who lay quiet for a year, the Brahmans who fulfil their vows, The Frogs have lifted up their voice, the voice Parjanya hath inspired.

verses.sa:
दिव्या आपो अभि यदेनमायन्दृतिं न शुष्कं सरसी शयानम् ।
गवामह न मायुर्वत्सिनीनां मण्डूकानां वग्नुरत्रा समेति॥
verses.tr: divyā āpo abhi yadenamāyandṛtiṃ na śuṣkaṃ sarasī śayānam gavāmaha na māyurvatsinīnāṃ maṇḍūkānāṃ vagnuratrā sameti
verses.en: What time on these, as on a dry skin lying in the pool's bed, the floods of heaven descended, The music of the Frogs comes forth in concert like the cows lowing with their calves beside them.

verses.sa:
यदीमेनाँ उशतो अभ्यवर्षीत्तृष्यावतः प्रावृष्यागतायाम् ।
अख्खलीकृत्या पितरं न पुत्रो अन्यो अन्यमुप वदन्तमेति॥
verses.tr: yadīmenāṃ uśato abhyavarṣīttṛṣyāvataḥ prāvṛṣyāgatāyām akhkhalīkṛtyā pitaraṃ na putro anyo anyamupa vadantameti
verses.en: When at the coming of the Rains the water has poured upon them as they yearned and thirsted, One seeks another as he talks and greets him with cries of pleasure as a son his father.

verses.sa:
अन्यो अन्यमनु गृभ्णात्येनोरपां प्रसर्गे यदमन्दिषाताम् ।
मण्डूको यदभिवृष्टः कनिष्कन्पृश्निः सम्पृङ्क्ते हरितेन वाचम्॥
verses.tr: anyo anyamanu gṛbhṇātyenorapāṃ prasarge yadamandiṣātām maṇḍūko yadabhivṛṣṭaḥ kaniṣkanpṛśniḥ sampṛṅkte haritena vācam
verses.en: Each of these twain receives the other kindly, while they are revelling in the flow of waters, When the Frog moistened by the rain springs forward, and Green and Spotty both combine their voices.

verses.sa:
यदेषामन्यो अन्यस्य वाचं शाक्तस्येव वदति शिक्षमाणः ।
सर्वं तदेषां समृधेव पर्व यत्सुवाचो वदथनाध्यप्सु॥
verses.tr: yadeṣāmanyo anyasya vācaṃ śāktasyeva vadati śikṣamāṇaḥ sarvaṃ tadeṣāṃ samṛdheva parva yatsuvāco vadathanādhyapsu
verses.en: When one of these repeats the other's language, as he who learns the lesson of the teacher, Your every limb seems to be growing larger as ye converse with eloquence on the waters.

verses.sa:
गोमायुरेको अजमायुरेकः पृश्निरेको हरित एक एषाम् ।
समानं नाम बिभ्रतो विरूपाः पुरुत्रा वाचं पिपिशुर्वदन्तः॥
verses.tr: gomāyureko ajamāyurekaḥ pṛśnireko harita eka eṣām samānaṃ nāma bibhrato virūpāḥ purutrā vācaṃ pipiśurvadantaḥ
verses.en: Onc is Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat the other, one Frog is Green and one of them is Spotty. They bear one common name, and yet they vary, and, talking, modulate the voice diversely.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणासो अतिरात्रे न सोमे सरो न पूर्णमभितो वदन्तः ।
संवत्सरस्य तदहः परि ष्ठ यन्मण्डूकाः प्रावृषीणं बभूव॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇāso atirātre na some saro na pūrṇamabhito vadantaḥ saṃvatsarasya tadahaḥ pari ṣṭha yanmaṇḍūkāḥ prāvṛṣīṇaṃ babhūva
verses.en: As Brahmans, sitting round the brimful vessel, talk at the Soma-rite of Atiratra, So, Frogs, ye gather round the pool to honour this day of all the year, the first of Rain-time.

verses.sa:
ब्राह्मणासः सोमिनो वाचमक्रत ब्रह्म कृण्वन्तः परिवत्सरीणम् ।
अध्वर्यवो घर्मिणः सिष्विदाना आविर्भवन्ति गुह्या न के चित्॥
verses.tr: brāhmaṇāsaḥ somino vācamakrata brahma kṛṇvantaḥ parivatsarīṇam adhvaryavo gharmiṇaḥ siṣvidānā āvirbhavanti guhyā na ke cit
verses.en: These Brahmans with the Soma juice, performing their year-long rite, have lifted up their voices; And these Adhvaryus, sweating with their kettles, come forth and show themselves, and none are hidden.

verses.sa:
देवहितिं जुगुपुर्द्वादशस्य ऋतुं नरो न प्र मिनन्त्येते ।
संवत्सरे प्रावृष्यागतायां तप्ता घर्मा अश्नुवते विसर्गम्॥
verses.tr: devahitiṃ jugupurdvādaśasya ṛtuṃ naro na pra minantyete saṃvatsare prāvṛṣyāgatāyāṃ taptā gharmā aśnuvate visargam
verses.en: They keep the twelve month's God-appointed order, and never do the men neglect the season. Soon as the Rain-time in the year returneth, these who were heated kettles gain their freedom.

verses.sa:
गोमायुरदादजमायुरदात्पृश्निरदाद्धरितो नो वसूनि ।
गवां मण्डूका ददतः शतानि सहस्रसावे प्र तिरन्त आयुः॥
verses.tr: gomāyuradādajamāyuradātpṛśniradāddharito no vasūni gavāṃ maṇḍūkā dadataḥ śatāni sahasrasāve pra tiranta āyuḥ
verses.en: Cow-bellow and Goat-bleat have granted riches, and Green and Spotty have vouchsafed us treasure. The Frogs who give us cows in hundreds lengthen our lives in this most fertilizing season.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा तपतं रक्ष उब्जतं न्यर्पयतं वृषणा तमोवृधः ।
परा शृणीतमचितो न्योषतं हतं नुदेथां नि शिशीतमत्रिणः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā tapataṃ rakṣa ubjataṃ nyarpayataṃ vṛṣaṇā tamovṛdhaḥ parā śṛṇītamacito nyoṣataṃ hataṃ nudethāṃ ni śiśītamatriṇaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, burn, destroy the demon foe, send downward, O ye Bulls, those who add gloom to gloom. Annihilate the fools, slay them and burn them up: chase them away from us, pierce the voracious ones.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा समघशंसमभ्य१घं तपुर्ययस्तु चरुरग्निवाँ इव ।
ब्रह्मद्विषे क्रव्यादे घोरचक्षसे द्वेषो धत्तमनवायं किमीदिने॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā samaghaśaṃsamabhya1ghaṃ tapuryayastu caruragnivāṃ iva brahmadviṣe kravyāde ghoracakṣase dveṣo dhattamanavāyaṃ kimīdine
verses.en: Indra and Soma, let sin round the wicked boil like as a caldron set amid the flames of fire. Against the foe of prayer, devourer of raw flesh, the vile fiend fierce of eye, keep ye perpetual hate.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृतो वव्रे अन्तरनारम्भणे तमसि प्र विध्यतम् ।
यथा नातः पुनरेकश्चनोदयत्तद्वामस्तु सहसे मन्युमच्छवः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā duṣkṛto vavre antaranārambhaṇe tamasi pra vidhyatam yathā nātaḥ punarekaścanodayattadvāmastu sahase manyumacchavaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, plunge the wicked in the depth, yea, cast them into darkness that hath no support, So that not one of them may ever thence return: so may your wrathful might prevail and conquer them.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवो वधं सं पृथिव्या अघशंसाय तर्हणम् ।
उत्तक्षतं स्वर्यं१ पर्वतेभ्यो येन रक्षो वावृधानं निजूर्वथः॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divo vadhaṃ saṃ pṛthivyā aghaśaṃsāya tarhaṇam uttakṣataṃ svaryaṃ1 parvatebhyo yena rakṣo vāvṛdhānaṃ nijūrvathaḥ
verses.en: Indra and Soma, hurl your deadly crushing bolt down on the wicked fiend from heaven and from the earth. Yea, forge out of the mountains your celestial dart wherewith ye burn to death the waxing demon race.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा वर्तयतं दिवस्पर्यग्नितप्तेभिर्युवमश्महन्मभिः ।
तपुर्वधेभिरजरेभिरत्रिणो नि पर्शाने विध्यतं यन्तु निस्वरम्॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā vartayataṃ divasparyagnitaptebhiryuvamaśmahanmabhiḥ tapurvadhebhirajarebhiratriṇo ni parśāne vidhyataṃ yantu nisvaram
verses.en: Indra and Soma, cast ye downward out of heaven your deadly darts of stone burning with fiery flame, Eternal, scorching darts; plunge the voracious ones within the depth, and let them sink without a sound.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रासोमा परि वां भूतु विश्वत इयं मतिः कक्ष्याश्वेव वाजिना ।
यां वां होत्रां परिहिनोमि मेधयेमा ब्रह्माणि नृपतीव जिन्वतम्॥
verses.tr: indrāsomā pari vāṃ bhūtu viśvata iyaṃ matiḥ kakṣyāśveva vājinā yāṃ vāṃ hotrāṃ parihinomi medhayemā brahmāṇi nṛpatīva jinvatam
verses.en: Indra and Soma, let this hymn control you both, even as the girth encompasses two vigorous steeds- The song of praise which I with wisdom offer you: do ye, as Lords of men, animate these my prayers.

verses.sa:
प्रति स्मरेथां तुजयद्भिरेवैर्हतं द्रुहो रक्षसो भङ्गुरावतः ।
इन्द्रासोमा दुष्कृते मा सुगं भूद्यो नः कदा चिदभिदासति द्रुहा॥
verses.tr: prati smarethāṃ tujayadbhirevairhataṃ druho rakṣaso bhaṅgurāvataḥ indrāsomā duṣkṛte mā sugaṃ bhūdyo naḥ kadā cidabhidāsati druhā
verses.en: In your impetuous manner think ye both thereon: destroy these evil beings, slay the treacherous fiends. Indra and Soma, let the wicked have no bliss who evermore assails us with malignity.

verses.sa:
यो मा पाकेन मनसा चरन्तमभिचष्टे अनृतेभिर्वचोभिः ।
आप इव काशिना संगृभीता असन्नस्त्वासत इन्द्र वक्ता॥
verses.tr: yo mā pākena manasā carantamabhicaṣṭe anṛtebhirvacobhiḥ āpa iva kāśinā saṃgṛbhītā asannastvāsata indra vaktā
verses.en: Whoso accuses me with words of falsehood when I pursue my way with guileless spirit, May he, the speaker of untruth, be, Indra, like water which the hollowed hand compresses.

verses.sa:
ये पाकशंसं विहरन्त एवैर्ये वा भद्रं दूषयन्ति स्वधाभिः ।
अहये वा तान्प्रददातु सोम आ वा दधातु निॠतेरुपस्थे॥
verses.tr: ye pākaśaṃsaṃ viharanta evairye vā bhadraṃ dūṣayanti svadhābhiḥ ahaye vā tānpradadātu soma ā vā dadhātu niṝterupasthe
verses.en: Those who destroy, as is their wont, the simple, and with their evil natures harm the righteous, May Soma give them over to the serpent, or to the lap of Nirrti consign them.

verses.sa:
यो नो रसं दिप्सति पित्वो अग्ने यो अश्वानां यो गवां यस्तनूनाम् ।
रिपुः स्तेनः स्तेयकृद्दभ्रमेतु नि ष हीयतां तन्वा३ तना च॥
verses.tr: yo no rasaṃ dipsati pitvo agne yo aśvānāṃ yo gavāṃ yastanūnām ripuḥ stenaḥ steyakṛddabhrametu ni ṣa hīyatāṃ tanvā3 tanā ca
verses.en: The fiend, O Agni, who designs to injure the essence of our food, kine, steeds, or bodies, May he, the adversary, thief, and robber, sink to destruction, both himself and offspring.

verses.sa:
परः सो अस्तु तन्वा३ तना च तिस्रः पृथिवीरधो अस्तु विश्वाः ।
प्रति शुष्यतु यशो अस्य देवा यो नो दिवा दिप्सति यश्च नक्तम्॥
verses.tr: paraḥ so astu tanvā3 tanā ca tisraḥ pṛthivīradho astu viśvāḥ prati śuṣyatu yaśo asya devā yo no divā dipsati yaśca naktam
verses.en: May he be swept away, himself and children: may all the three earths press him down beneath them. May his fair glory, O ye Gods, be blighted, who in the day or night would fain destroy us.

verses.sa:
सुविज्ञानं चिकितुषे जनाय सच्चासच्च वचसी पस्पृधाते ।
तयोर्यत्सत्यं यतरदृजीयस्तदित्सोमोऽवति हन्त्यासत्॥
verses.tr: suvijñānaṃ cikituṣe janāya saccāsacca vacasī paspṛdhāte tayoryatsatyaṃ yataradṛjīyastaditsomo'vati hantyāsat
verses.en: The prudent finds it easy to distinguish the true and false: their words oppose each other. Of these two that which is the true and honest, Soma protects, and brings the false to nothing.

verses.sa:
न वा उ सोमो वृजिनं हिनोति न क्षत्रियं मिथुया धारयन्तम् ।
हन्ति रक्षो हन्त्यासद्वदन्तमुभाविन्द्रस्य प्रसितौ शयाते॥
verses.tr: na vā u somo vṛjinaṃ hinoti na kṣatriyaṃ mithuyā dhārayantam hanti rakṣo hantyāsadvadantamubhāvindrasya prasitau śayāte
verses.en: Never doth Soma aid and guide the wicked or him who falsely claims the Warrior's title. He slays the fiend and him who speaks untruly: both lie entangled in the noose of Indra.

verses.sa:
यदि वाहमनृतदेव आस मोघं वा देवाँ अप्यूहे अग्ने ।
किमस्मभ्यं जातवेदो हृणीषे द्रोघवाचस्ते निॠथं सचन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: yadi vāhamanṛtadeva āsa moghaṃ vā devāṃ apyūhe agne kimasmabhyaṃ jātavedo hṛṇīṣe droghavācaste niṝthaṃ sacantām
verses.en: As if I worshipped deities of falsehood, or thought vain thoughts about the Gods, O Agni. Why art thou angry with us, Jatavedas? Destruction fall on those who lie against thee!

verses.sa:
अद्या मुरीय यदि यातुधानो अस्मि यदि वायुस्ततप पूरुषस्य ।
अधा स वीरैर्दशभिर्वि यूया यो मा मोघं यातुधानेत्याह॥
verses.tr: adyā murīya yadi yātudhāno asmi yadi vāyustatapa pūruṣasya adhā sa vīrairdaśabhirvi yūyā yo mā moghaṃ yātudhānetyāha
verses.en: So may I die this day if I have harassed any man's life or if I be a demon. Yea, may he lose all his ten sons together who with false tongue hath called me Yatudhana.

verses.sa:
यो मायातुं यातुधानेत्याह यो वा रक्षाः शुचिरस्मीत्याह ।
इन्द्रस्तं हन्तु महता वधेन विश्वस्य जन्तोरधमस्पदीष्ट॥
verses.tr: yo māyātuṃ yātudhānetyāha yo vā rakṣāḥ śucirasmītyāha indrastaṃ hantu mahatā vadhena viśvasya jantoradhamaspadīṣṭa
verses.en: May Indra slay him with a mighty weapon, and let the vilest of all creatures perish, The fiend who says that he is pure, who calls me a demon though devoid of demon nature.

verses.sa:
प्र या जिगाति खर्गलेव नक्तमप द्रुहा तन्वं१ गूहमाना ।
वव्राँ अनन्ताँ अव सा पदीष्ट ग्रावाणो घ्नन्तु रक्षस उपब्दैः॥
verses.tr: pra yā jigāti khargaleva naktamapa druhā tanvaṃ1 gūhamānā vavrāṃ anantāṃ ava sā padīṣṭa grāvāṇo ghnantu rakṣasa upabdaiḥ
verses.en: She too who wanders like an owl at night-time, hiding her body in her guile and malice, May she fall downward into endless caverns. May press-stones with loud ring destroy the demons.

verses.sa:
वि तिष्ठध्वं मरुतो विक्ष्वि१च्छत गृभायत रक्षसः सं पिनष्टन ।
वयो ये भूत्वी पतयन्ति नक्तभिर्ये वा रिपो दधिरे देवे अध्वरे॥
verses.tr: vi tiṣṭhadhvaṃ maruto vikṣvi1cchata gṛbhāyata rakṣasaḥ saṃ pinaṣṭana vayo ye bhūtvī patayanti naktabhirye vā ripo dadhire deve adhvare
verses.en: Spread out, ye Maruts, search among the people: seize ye and grind the Raksasas to pieces, Who fly abroad, transformed to birds, at night-time, or sully and pollute our holy worship.

verses.sa:
प्र वर्तय दिवो अश्मानमिन्द्र सोमशितं मघवन्त्सं शिशाधि ।
प्राक्तादपाक्तादधरादुदक्तादभि जहि रक्षसः पर्वतेन॥
verses.tr: pra vartaya divo aśmānamindra somaśitaṃ maghavantsaṃ śiśādhi prāktādapāktādadharādudaktādabhi jahi rakṣasaḥ parvatena
verses.en: Hurl down from heaven thy bolt of stone, O Indra: sharpen it, Maghavan, made keen by Soma. Forward, behind, and from above and under, smite down the demons with thy rocky weapon.

verses.sa:
एत उ त्ये पतयन्ति श्वयातव इन्द्रं दिप्सन्ति दिप्सवोऽदाभ्यम् ।
शिशीते शक्रः पिशुनेभ्यो वधं नूनं सृजदशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: eta u tye patayanti śvayātava indraṃ dipsanti dipsavo'dābhyam śiśīte śakraḥ piśunebhyo vadhaṃ nūnaṃ sṛjadaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ
verses.en: They fly, the demon dogs, and, bent on mischief, fain would they harm indomitable Indra. Sakra makes sharp his weapon for the wicked: now, let him cast his bolt at fiendish wizards.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो यातूनामभवत्पराशरो हविर्मथीनामभ्या३विवासताम् ।
अभीदु शक्रः परशुर्यथा वनं पात्रेव भिन्दन्त्सत एति रक्षसः॥
verses.tr: indro yātūnāmabhavatparāśaro havirmathīnāmabhyā3vivāsatām abhīdu śakraḥ paraśuryathā vanaṃ pātreva bhindantsata eti rakṣasaḥ
verses.en: Indra hath ever been the fiends' destroyer who spoil oblations of the Gods' invokers: Yea, Sakra, like an axe that splits the timber, attacks and smashes them like earthen vessels.

verses.sa:
उलूकयातुं शुशुलूकयातुं जहि श्वयातुमुत कोकयातुम् ।
सुपर्णयातुमुत गृध्रयातुं दृषदेव प्र मृण रक्ष इन्द्र॥
verses.tr: ulūkayātuṃ śuśulūkayātuṃ jahi śvayātumuta kokayātum suparṇayātumuta gṛdhrayātuṃ dṛṣadeva pra mṛṇa rakṣa indra
verses.en: Destroy the fiend shaped like an owl or owlet, destroy him in the form of dog or cuckoo. Destroy him shaped as eagle or as vulture as with a stone, O Indra, crush the demon.

verses.sa:
मा नो रक्षो अभि नड्यातुमावतामपोच्छतु मिथुना या किमीदिना ।
पृथिवी नः पार्थिवात्पात्वंहसोऽन्तरिक्षं दिव्यात्पात्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: mā no rakṣo abhi naḍyātumāvatāmapocchatu mithunā yā kimīdinā pṛthivī naḥ pārthivātpātvaṃhaso'ntarikṣaṃ divyātpātvasmān
verses.en: Let not the fiend of witchcraft-workers reach us: may Dawn drive off the couples of Kimidins. Earth keep us safe from earthly woe and trouble: from grief that comes from heaven mid-air preserve us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र जहि पुमांसं यातुधानमुत स्त्रियं मायया शाशदानाम् ।
विग्रीवासो मूरदेवा ऋदन्तु मा ते दृशन्त्सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम्॥
verses.tr: indra jahi pumāṃsaṃ yātudhānamuta striyaṃ māyayā śāśadānām vigrīvāso mūradevā ṛdantu mā te dṛśantsūryamuccarantam
verses.en: Slay the male demon, Indra! slay the female, joying and triumphing in arts of magic. Let the fools' gods with bent necks fall and perish, and see no more the Sun when he arises.

verses.sa: प्रति चक्ष्व वि चक्ष्वेन्द्रश्च सोम जागृतम् । रक्षोभ्यो वधमस्यतमशनिं यातुमद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: prati cakṣva vi cakṣvendraśca soma jāgṛtam rakṣobhyo vadhamasyatamaśaniṃ yātumadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Look each one hither, look around Indra and Soma, watch ye well.
